hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — The State had submitted its proposal to the Union Government on March 23, 2023 , seeking inclusion of the legislation in the Ninth Schedule.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

hinglishTracks.en: The Legislative Assembly also passed a resolution on December 18, 2025, urging the Centre to provide constitutional protection to the enhanced reservation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — The Legislative Assembly also passed a resolution on December 18, 2025, urging the Centre to provide constitutional protection to the enhanced reservation.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: The Union Government had acknowledged the receipt of Karnataka’s proposal in a written reply in the Lok Sabha on July 25, 2026, but said inclusion in the Ninth Schedule was not considered appropriate at that stage as the matter was pending before the High Court.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — The Union Government had acknowledged the receipt of Karnataka’s proposal in a written reply in the Lok Sabha on July 25, 2026, but said inclusion in the Ninth Schedule was not considered appropriate at that stage as the matter was pending before the High Court.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

hinglishTracks.en: Parameshwara has also called for consultations with the National Commissions for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes to address the constitutional and procedural issues concerning the legislation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — Parameshwara has also called for consultations with the National Commissions for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes to address the constitutional and procedural issues concerning the legislation.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: He has sought coordinated action by the Ministries of Law and Justice, Social Justice and Empowerment, Tribal Affairs, and Home Affairs to expedite the matter.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — He has sought coordinated action by the Ministries of Law and Justice, Social Justice and Empowerment, Tribal Affairs, and Home Affairs to expedite the matter.।

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Karnataka Deputy CM Parameshwara writes to Modi, Shah seeking inclusion of State’s SC/ST reservation law in Ninth Schedule on the lines of Tamil Nadu

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 03:27:13 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent, Mr. Parameshwara said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and a constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara has urged the Union government to initiate a constitutional amendment to include Karnataka’s Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation) Act, 2022 , in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution to protect the enhanced reservation provided to the two communities. Karnataka to explore legal options to challenge High Court verdict striking down reservation enhancement In letters dated November 12 to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment Virendra Kumar, Mr. Parameshwara sought urgent intervention and a time-bound decision on the State’s proposal. The appeal follows the Karnataka High Court’s judgment striking down the enhanced reservation of 17% for SCs and 7% for STs, taking the total reservation in education and public employment to 56%. Karnataka has since filed a Special Leave Petition before the Supreme Court. In a post on X, Dr. Parameshwara said constitutional protection for the enhanced reservation was essential following the High Court judgment. Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent — brought under the Ninth Schedule through the 76th Constitutional Amendment in 1994 — he said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and urged the Centre to initiate the necessary constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities. I have written to Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi, Union Home Minister Shri @AmitShah and Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment @Drvirendrakum13 , urging their immediate intervention to include Karnataka's SC/ST Reservation Act, 2022, in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution. Following the recent High Court judgment, it is essential to secure constitutional protection for the enhanced reservation of 17% for Scheduled Castes and 7% for Scheduled Tribes. Tamil Nadu's 69% reservation framework provides a clear precedent. Karnataka deserves equal consideration. I have urged the Union Government to initiate the necessary constitutional amendment and take a time-bound decision to safeguard the rights and opportunities of our SC/ST communities. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.15ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.3ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಜಾರಿಗೊಳಿಸಲಾದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ (ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸೇವೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೇಮಕಾತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಹುದ್ದೆಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ) ಕಾಯ್ದೆ, 2022 ಅನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುವಂತೆ ಕೋರಿ ಗೌರವಾನ್ವಿತ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿ, ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಅಮಿತ್‌ ಶಾ ಹಾಗೂ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಡಾ.ವೀರೇಂದ್ರ ಕುಮಾರ್‌ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ಸುಮಾರು ಏಳು ದಶಕಗಳಿಂದ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಬದಲಾಗದೆ ಉಳಿದಿತ್ತು. ಈ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದಿರುವಿಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ನ್ಯಾಯಮೂರ್ತಿ ಎಚ್.ಎನ್. ನಾಗಮೋಹನ್ ದಾಸ್ ಆಯೋಗದ ಶಿಫಾರಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಈ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದೂ ಆಯೋಗ ಶಿಫಾರಸು ಮಾಡಿತ್ತು. ಆದರೆ, ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಶೇ.56ಕ್ಕೆ ಏರಿಕೆಯಾಗಿರುವುದು ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಲಾದ ಶೇ.50ರ ಮಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಮೀರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬ ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಹೈಕೋರ್ಟ್ 2026ರ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 12ರಂದು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳದ ನಿಬಂಧನೆಗಳನ್ನು ರದ್ದುಗೊಳಿಸಿದೆ. ಈ ತೀರ್ಪಿನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸುಪ್ರೀಂ ಕೋರ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲ್ಮನವಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದೆ. 1994ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 76ನೇ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಅದೇ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಶೇ.17 ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.7ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬೇಕು. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರವು 2023ರ ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 23ರಂದೇ ಈ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿತ್ತು. 2025ರ ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್ 18ರಂದು ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ನಿರ್ಣಯ ಅಂಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ನಿಕಟಪೂರ್ವ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಸಿದ್ದರಾಮಯ್ಯ ಅವರು 2026ರ ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 16ರಂದು ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದು ಇದೇ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪುನರುಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದ್ದರು. ಈ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮಧ್ಯಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ಕೋರಿ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೇನೆ. 1. ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕು. 2. ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಾದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಮಸೂದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಸತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂಡಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ತುರ್ತಾಗಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಬೇಕು. 3. ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಆಯೋಗ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಆಯೋಗಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಿ, ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಗುರುತಿಸಿರುವ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಹರಿಸಲು ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. 4. ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕಾನೂನು ಮತ್ತು ನ್ಯಾಯ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ ಹಾಗೂ ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯಗಳು ಸಮನ್ವಯದಿಂದ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿ, ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. 5. ದೇಶದ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವಾಸ್ತವಗಳು, ವಿವಿಧ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಅನುಭವಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಸಮಾನತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಶೇ.50ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಮಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅನ್ವಯದ ಕುರಿತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಕ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಬೇಕು. ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಿರುವಂತೆ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.24ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ದೊರೆಯಬೇಕೆಂಬುದು ನಮ್ಮ ಆಗ್ರಹವಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ವಿಚಾರವು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಪಕ್ಷಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಡಾ. ಬಿ.ಆರ್. ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಅವರ ಆಶಯದಂತೆ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕವಾಗಿ ಅವಕಾಶವಂಚಿತರಾದ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವುದು ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರ ಭವಿಷ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಈ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಚಾರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗಿನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಕೈಗೊಂಡು ಅಗತ್ಯ ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಜರುಗಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಮನವಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ. The enhanced reservation was recommended by a commission headed by retired Karnataka High Court judge H.N. Nagamohan Das. The State subsequently enacted the Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions and of Appointments or Posts in the Services under the State) Act, 2022. The legislation received the Governor’s assent on January 11, 2023, and came into effect retrospectively from November 1, 2022, the letter stated. The State had submitted its proposal to the Union Government on March 23, 2023 , seeking inclusion of the legislation in the Ninth Schedule. The Legislative Assembly also passed a resolution on December 18, 2025, urging the Centre to provide constitutional protection to the enhanced reservation. The Union Government had acknowledged the receipt of Karnataka’s proposal in a written reply in the Lok Sabha on July 25, 2026, but said inclusion in the Ninth Schedule was not considered appropriate at that stage as the matter was pending before the High Court.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Parameshwara has also called for consultations with the National Commissions for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes to address the constitutional and procedural issues concerning the legislation. He has sought coordinated action by the Ministries of Law and Justice, Social Justice and Empowerment, Tribal Affairs, and Home Affairs to expedite the matter.

articles.summary: 1. Core Context & Background: Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent, Mr. Parameshwara said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and a constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities.
articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent, Mr. Parameshwara said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and a constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara has urged the Union government to initiate a constitutional amendment to include Karnataka’s Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation) Act, 2022 , in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution to protect the enhanced reservation provided to the two communities. Karnataka to explore legal options to challenge High Court verdict striking down reservation enhancement In letters dated November 12 to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment Virendra Kumar, Mr. Parameshwara sought urgent intervention and a time-bound decision on the State’s proposal. The appeal follows the Karnataka High Court’s judgment striking down the enhanced reservation of 17% for SCs and 7% for STs, taking the total reservation in education and public employment to 56%. Karnataka has since filed a Special Leave Petition before the Supreme Court. In a post on X, Dr. Parameshwara said constitutional protection for the enhanced reservation was essential following the High Court judgment. Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent — brought under the Ninth Schedule through the 76th Constitutional Amendment in 1994 — he said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and urged the Centre to initiate the necessary constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities. I have written to Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi, Union Home Minister Shri @AmitShah and Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment @Drvirendrakum13 , urging their immediate intervention to include Karnataka's SC/ST Reservation Act, 2022, in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution. Following the recent High Court judgment, it is essential to secure constitutional protection for the enhanced reservation of 17% for Scheduled Castes and 7% for Scheduled Tribes. Tamil Nadu's 69% reservation framework provides a clear precedent. Karnataka deserves equal consideration. I have urged the Union Government to initiate the necessary constitutional amendment and take a time-bound decision to safeguard the rights and opportunities of our SC/ST communities. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.15ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.3ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಜಾರಿಗೊಳಿಸಲಾದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ (ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸೇವೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೇಮಕಾತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಹುದ್ದೆಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ) ಕಾಯ್ದೆ, 2022 ಅನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುವಂತೆ ಕೋರಿ ಗೌರವಾನ್ವಿತ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿ, ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಅಮಿತ್‌ ಶಾ ಹಾಗೂ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಡಾ.ವೀರೇಂದ್ರ ಕುಮಾರ್‌ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ಸುಮಾರು ಏಳು ದಶಕಗಳಿಂದ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಬದಲಾಗದೆ ಉಳಿದಿತ್ತು. ಈ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದಿರುವಿಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ನ್ಯಾಯಮೂರ್ತಿ ಎಚ್.ಎನ್. ನಾಗಮೋಹನ್ ದಾಸ್ ಆಯೋಗದ ಶಿಫಾರಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಈ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದೂ ಆಯೋಗ ಶಿಫಾರಸು ಮಾಡಿತ್ತು. ಆದರೆ, ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಶೇ.56ಕ್ಕೆ ಏರಿಕೆಯಾಗಿರುವುದು ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಲಾದ ಶೇ.50ರ ಮಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಮೀರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬ ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಹೈಕೋರ್ಟ್ 2026ರ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 12ರಂದು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳದ ನಿಬಂಧನೆಗಳನ್ನು ರದ್ದುಗೊಳಿಸಿದೆ. ಈ ತೀರ್ಪಿನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸುಪ್ರೀಂ ಕೋರ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲ್ಮನವಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದೆ. 1994ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 76ನೇ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಅದೇ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಶೇ.17 ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.7ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬೇಕು. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರವು 2023ರ ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 23ರಂದೇ ಈ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿತ್ತು. 2025ರ ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್ 18ರಂದು ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ನಿರ್ಣಯ ಅಂಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ನಿಕಟಪೂರ್ವ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಸಿದ್ದರಾಮಯ್ಯ ಅವರು 2026ರ ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 16ರಂದು ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದು ಇದೇ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪುನರುಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದ್ದರು. ಈ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮಧ್ಯಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ಕೋರಿ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೇನೆ. 1. ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕು. 2. ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಾದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಮಸೂದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಸತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂಡಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ತುರ್ತಾಗಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಬೇಕು. 3. ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಆಯೋಗ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಆಯೋಗಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಿ, ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಗುರುತಿಸಿರುವ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಹರಿಸಲು ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. 4. ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕಾನೂನು ಮತ್ತು ನ್ಯಾಯ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ ಹಾಗೂ ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯಗಳು ಸಮನ್ವಯದಿಂದ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿ, ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. 5. ದೇಶದ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವಾಸ್ತವಗಳು, ವಿವಿಧ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಅನುಭವಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಸಮಾನತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಶೇ.50ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಮಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅನ್ವಯದ ಕುರಿತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಕ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಬೇಕು. ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಿರುವಂತೆ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.24ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ದೊರೆಯಬೇಕೆಂಬುದು ನಮ್ಮ ಆಗ್ರಹವಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ವಿಚಾರವು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಪಕ್ಷಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಡಾ. ಬಿ.ಆರ್. ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಅವರ ಆಶಯದಂತೆ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕವಾಗಿ ಅವಕಾಶವಂಚಿತರಾದ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವುದು ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರ ಭವಿಷ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಈ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಚಾರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗಿನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಕೈಗೊಂಡು ಅಗತ್ಯ ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಜರುಗಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಮನವಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ. The enhanced reservation was recommended by a commission headed by retired Karnataka High Court judge H.N. Nagamohan Das. The State subsequently enacted the Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions and of Appointments or Posts in the Services under the State) Act, 2022. The legislation received the Governor’s assent on January 11, 2023, and came into effect retrospectively from November 1, 2022, the letter stated. The State had submitted its proposal to the Union Government on March 23, 2023 , seeking inclusion of the legislation in the Ninth Schedule. The Legislative Assembly also passed a resolution on December 18, 2025, urging the Centre to provide constitutional protection to the enhanced reservation. The Union Government had acknowledged the receipt of Karnataka’s proposal in a written reply in the Lok Sabha on July 25, 2026, but said inclusion in the Ninth Schedule was not considered appropriate at that stage as the matter was pending before the High Court.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Parameshwara has also called for consultations with the National Commissions for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes to address the constitutional and procedural issues concerning the legislation. He has sought coordinated action by the Ministries of Law and Justice, Social Justice and Empowerment, Tribal Affairs, and Home Affairs to expedite the matter.

articles.title: Keralam Government to buy new vehicles for Ministers and Chief Secretary
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The General Administration Department has issued orders for the purchase of 24 Toyota Innova Hycross ZX(O) Strong Hybrid vehicles which include 22 for the use of the Ministers and Chief Secretary Bishwananth Sinha and two for the use of State guests

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The State Government has decided to purchase 24 new cars for the official use of the Ministers and the Chief Secretary on the grounds that the existing vehicles have “considerably deteriorated in their mechanical condition due to prolonged use.” The General Administration Department has issued orders for the purchase of 24 Toyota Innova Hycross (ZX(O) Strong Hybrid) vehicles which include 22 for the use of the Ministers and Chief Secretary Bishwananth Sinha and two for the use of State guests. The procurement is estimated to cost ₹9.60 crore, but the actual expenditure would be determined based on the prevailing rates and applicable charges at the time of procurement, the GAD order noted. The decision has sparked a debate as Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan, on taking charge in May this year, had decided to use a car that was already in use, saying that the Government would forego unnecessary expenditure amid financial stress. He had also decided to do away with the Chief Minister’s motorcade. In September, the Minister for Local Bodies K. M. Shaji’s decision to use a luxury sports utility vehicle, purportedly borrowed from a businessperson friend of his, as his official vehicle had courted controversy. According to the November 12 order, the Tourism Department has been entrusted with the task of procuring the vehicles. The vehicles presently being used by most of the Ministers for official purposes have become old and have considerably deteriorated in their mechanical condition due to prolonged use, the GAD order noted. “They require frequent repairs and maintenance, resulting in increased expenditure and affecting their reliability and availability for official duties. The need for suitable and well-maintained vehicles for the Ministers to attend official engagements, meetings, field visits and various government functions also necessitates the periodic replacement of the existing vehicles,” it said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Vehicles presently available with the government for protocol purposes are also inadequate to meet the growing requirements arising from the visits of VIPs, foreign dignitaries and other distinguished guests to the State, the Department noted.

articles.title: From glory to gloom: Manchester United's fall leaves Keralam fans heartbroken
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Once a refuge from life’s hardships, Manchester United has become a test of endurance for its Keralam fans

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Glory Glory Manchester United, goes the iconic terrace anthem of English Premier League (EPL) giants Manchester United. These days, though, there is anything but glory about the once-mighty European powerhouse, which sits in the relegation zone this season, much to the dismay of its formidable fan base. For fans who have been put through the wringer, with the team managing only one win in 10 games and languishing 18th in the 20-team table, the sacking of manager Michael Carrick has come as the harbinger of yet another painful rebuilding process. Argentine Mauricio Pochettino, who previously coached the U.S. national team, has been appointed his successor. “There is nothing more painful in the world at present than being a Manchester United fan. It is frustrating to watch the club in action, with the players unable to string together even four decent passes,” laments former Indian international N.P. Pradeep, who nonetheless hopes the club will turn the corner at some point. Manchester United, one of the most popular football clubs in the world, has had 13 managers, including interim managers and caretakers, since the legendary Alex Ferguson retired in 2013 after guiding the club to its record 13th EPL title. The years since have been nightmarish for fans, barring a few bright moments, including a Europa League title and a couple of FA Cups. “This season has been really bad, with just one win. It is infuriating to watch the team play despite having a good squad, not to mention the trolls from rival fans. Hopefully, things will improve, as sometimes happens under a new manager,” observes another former Indian player, Mohammed Rafi. Naveen James, a legal professional and an ardent United fan, once went sleepless when Cristiano Ronaldo, the club legend, walked away during his second stint after criticising the way it was being run. Today, he claims to be ‘totally numb’ to the team’s state. “I was fortunate to watch seven blissful seasons under Sir Alex and will relish those memories for the rest of my life. Gone are the days when I lost sleep when United lost. I have become used to mediocrity and try to extract maximum positivity from the rare wins,” he says.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Narendar Bhat is as fanatical a United fan as they come, with Manchester United themes dominating his personal accessories. “Earlier, watching United was the biggest relief, helping me escape the hardships of life. But now it has become a torture. I still continue to watch the team’s games, but have resigned myself to the fact that another defeat is always just around the corner,” he bemoans.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 From glory to gloom: Manchester United's fall leaves Keralam fans heartbroken

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 03:06:42 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Once a refuge from life’s hardships, Manchester United has become a test of endurance for its Keralam fans

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Glory Glory Manchester United, goes the iconic terrace anthem of English Premier League (EPL) giants Manchester United. These days, though, there is anything but glory about the once-mighty European powerhouse, which sits in the relegation zone this season, much to the dismay of its formidable fan base. For fans who have been put through the wringer, with the team managing only one win in 10 games and languishing 18th in the 20-team table, the sacking of manager Michael Carrick has come as the harbinger of yet another painful rebuilding process. Argentine Mauricio Pochettino, who previously coached the U.S. national team, has been appointed his successor. “There is nothing more painful in the world at present than being a Manchester United fan. It is frustrating to watch the club in action, with the players unable to string together even four decent passes,” laments former Indian international N.P. Pradeep, who nonetheless hopes the club will turn the corner at some point. Manchester United, one of the most popular football clubs in the world, has had 13 managers, including interim managers and caretakers, since the legendary Alex Ferguson retired in 2013 after guiding the club to its record 13th EPL title. The years since have been nightmarish for fans, barring a few bright moments, including a Europa League title and a couple of FA Cups. “This season has been really bad, with just one win. It is infuriating to watch the team play despite having a good squad, not to mention the trolls from rival fans. Hopefully, things will improve, as sometimes happens under a new manager,” observes another former Indian player, Mohammed Rafi. Naveen James, a legal professional and an ardent United fan, once went sleepless when Cristiano Ronaldo, the club legend, walked away during his second stint after criticising the way it was being run. Today, he claims to be ‘totally numb’ to the team’s state. “I was fortunate to watch seven blissful seasons under Sir Alex and will relish those memories for the rest of my life. Gone are the days when I lost sleep when United lost. I have become used to mediocrity and try to extract maximum positivity from the rare wins,” he says.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Narendar Bhat is as fanatical a United fan as they come, with Manchester United themes dominating his personal accessories. “Earlier, watching United was the biggest relief, helping me escape the hardships of life. But now it has become a torture. I still continue to watch the team’s games, but have resigned myself to the fact that another defeat is always just around the corner,” he bemoans.

articles.title: SC/ST quota enhancement: Karnataka recommends inclusion of law in 9th Schedule
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Chief Secretary Vandita Sharma has written to the Home Secretary, Government of India

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Karnataka government has recommended to the Centre to bring the new legislation enhancing reservation to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes under the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution. The inclusion of the law in the Ninth Schedule will fortify it against any legal challenge. The Cabinet in February decided to send the proposal to the Centre . Chief Secretary Vandita Sharma has written to the Home Secretary, Government of India, on the inclusion of The Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions and of Appointments or Posts in the Services Under the State) Act, 2022, that enhances reservation for SCs from 15% to 17% and for STs from 3% to 7%, in the Ninth Schedule. The legislation was passed in the winter session of the legislature in Belagavi in December last. The Congress had been attacking the government for not bringing the law under the Ninth Schedule to protect it from legal scrutiny and termed the government move an “eyewash” to attract SC/ST votes ahead of the Assembly elections. The State government’s move comes days ahead of the schedule of the Assembly elections being declared.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Karnataka / Reservation / Indian National Congress

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The growth in India’s merchandise exports in October, the fastest in five years and faster than import growth, indicates that volumes of exports are growing along with prices

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s merchandise exports rose to an all-time high of $49.5 billion in October 2026, bringing down the country’s overall trade deficit, official data released on Friday showed. While a large part of this growth was due to petroleum products, Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said diversification of exports to various locations helped improve the numbers. India’s total exports, including goods and services, stood at $89.99 billion in October 2026, up nearly 30% from last October. The overall trade deficit shrank from $25.1 billion last October to $20.1 billion year-on-year. “In the month of October, the exports of merchandise exports have registered a new peak of $49.47 billion,” Mr. Agrawal said at a press briefing. “This is the highest-ever monthly merchandise export value, along with the highest monthly growth of 45.03% in the last five years.” Merchandise imports rose to a record high of $89.35 billion in October 2026, up 16.5% YoY. Total imports stood at $110.1 billion, a 16.6% increase. According to trade experts, goods exports growing faster than merchandise imports shows that while the rise in global prices contributed to the increase in the value of India’s exports, there was also an increase in the underlying export volumes. “The particularly encouraging part of this growth is that this is not in any particular sector, this is not in any particular geography, it is broad-based across countries and regions,” Mr. Agrawal added. “43 of our 50 top export destinations posted positive growth in October 2026 as compared to 2025.” The data show that India’s exports to 12 out of its top 20 export destinations grew by double digits or more.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Agrawal pointed out that India’s exports to its free trade agreement (FTA) partners had grown strongly.

India’s total exports, including goods and services, stood at $89.99 billion in October 2026, up nearly 30% from last October. The overall trade deficit shrank from $25.1 billion last October to $20.1 billion year-on-year. “In the month of October, the exports of merchandise exports have registered a new peak of $49.47 billion,” Mr. Agrawal said at a press briefing. “This is the highest-ever monthly merchandise export value, along with the highest monthly growth of 45.03% in the last five years.” Merchandise imports rose to a record high of $89.35 billion in October 2026, up 16.5% YoY. fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Rampur Bushahr’s Lavi Fair in Himachal Pradesh traces a Himalayan journey from wool and barter to women entrepreneurs and digital payments

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: What Disneyland is to children today, Lavi Fair in Rampur Bushahr, in Himachal Pradesh’s Shimla district, was to my family in the 1980s. I recall wandering through the fair as an eight-year-old, watching an old man smoking a chillum beside heaps of black sheep fleece and stacks of white woollen pattus (traditional garments of Kinnaur and Kullu women). Mother and her friends carefully chose shawls for their daughters’ and future daughters-in-law’s trousseaux. Years later, I received a beautiful black sheep wool and pashmina shawl for my wedding. Wool finds pride of place at the fair. The name Lavi is linked to “Loe”, a sheet of woollen cloth and the practice of shearing sheep.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Netherlands currently has a minority government by a coalition of three parties holding 66 seats in the 150-member Tweede Kamer, the lower house

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Story so far: The Dutch government came close to a collapse this week over its Tax Plan for 2027 as members of the three-party ruling coalition disagreed over an amendment to the plan. Though the plan was passed in the lowest-possible majority in the House of Representatives on Thursday (November 12, 2026) night and the government subsequently defeated a no-confidence motion, the developments have brought a rift in the coalition out in the open and threaten the future of the government led by Rob Jetten just nine-months into its 4-year term. The Netherlands currently has a minority government by a coalition of three parties holding 66 seats in the 150-member Tweede Kamer, the lower house. The centrist D66 led by Prime Minister Jetten, the youngest premier in the country’s history, is the single largest party with 26 seats and is joined by centre-right parties People’s Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD) and Christian Democratic Appeal (CDA), with 22 and 18 seats respectively. The government came to power in February, 117 days after a snap election in October last year necessitated by the collapse of Dick Schoof’s right-wing government as far-right leader of Freedom Party Geert Wilders withdrew his support. The months following the election that failed to produce a clear winner saw parties across political spectrum and ideologies negotiate to form a government to no effect, paving the way for the centrist parties to make do with a minority administration.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Netherlands / economy, business and finance / The Hindu Explains

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #16 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 How did a tax proposal lead the Dutch government to the verge of collapse? | Explained

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 11:20:40 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Netherlands currently has a minority government by a coalition of three parties holding 66 seats in the 150-member Tweede Kamer, the lower house

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Story so far: The Dutch government came close to a collapse this week over its Tax Plan for 2027 as members of the three-party ruling coalition disagreed over an amendment to the plan. Though the plan was passed in the lowest-possible majority in the House of Representatives on Thursday (November 12, 2026) night and the government subsequently defeated a no-confidence motion, the developments have brought a rift in the coalition out in the open and threaten the future of the government led by Rob Jetten just nine-months into its 4-year term. The Netherlands currently has a minority government by a coalition of three parties holding 66 seats in the 150-member Tweede Kamer, the lower house. The centrist D66 led by Prime Minister Jetten, the youngest premier in the country’s history, is the single largest party with 26 seats and is joined by centre-right parties People’s Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD) and Christian Democratic Appeal (CDA), with 22 and 18 seats respectively. The government came to power in February, 117 days after a snap election in October last year necessitated by the collapse of Dick Schoof’s right-wing government as far-right leader of Freedom Party Geert Wilders withdrew his support. The months following the election that failed to produce a clear winner saw parties across political spectrum and ideologies negotiate to form a government to no effect, paving the way for the centrist parties to make do with a minority administration.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Netherlands / economy, business and finance / The Hindu Explains

articles.title: India needs to create high-quality jobs, increase productivity growth: IMF
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In its October World Economic Outlook, the IMF had upgraded India’s medium-term potential growth to 6.8% from its earlier estimate of 6.5%

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India would need higher productivity growth, stronger private investment and faster creation of high-quality jobs to achieve the medium-term potential growth of 6.8%, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) said on Thursday (November 12, 2026). In its October World Economic Outlook, the IMF had upgraded India’s medium-term potential growth to 6.8% from its earlier estimate of 6.5%. The upgrade took into account a few factors, including favourable demographics, a large and growing domestic economy or domestic market for goods, and continued momentum on structural reforms, Julie Kozack, Communications Director, IMF, told reporters in Washington. “But in general, like in many countries, we are encouraging India to take continuing reforms, particularly to focus on how productivity growth can be increased,” she said in response to a question from PTI . The IMF official said that to further the medium-term potential, India would need higher productivity growth, stronger private investment, and faster creation of high-quality jobs. Ms. Kozack said these issues will come up during the Article 4 consultations with India. Last month, the IMF raised India’s growth forecast for fiscal year 2027 and fiscal year 2028 to 7%, from the 6.4% and 6.7% projections respectively made in July. “India does remain a key growth engine for the world. The economy has strong fundamentals and has shown considerable resilience,” Ms. Kozack said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India / employment / economy, business and finance / economy (general)

📰 India needs to create high-quality jobs, increase productivity growth: IMF

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 08:33:15 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: In its October World Economic Outlook, the IMF had upgraded India’s medium-term potential growth to 6.8% from its earlier estimate of 6.5%

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India would need higher productivity growth, stronger private investment and faster creation of high-quality jobs to achieve the medium-term potential growth of 6.8%, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) said on Thursday (November 12, 2026). In its October World Economic Outlook, the IMF had upgraded India’s medium-term potential growth to 6.8% from its earlier estimate of 6.5%. The upgrade took into account a few factors, including favourable demographics, a large and growing domestic economy or domestic market for goods, and continued momentum on structural reforms, Julie Kozack, Communications Director, IMF, told reporters in Washington. “But in general, like in many countries, we are encouraging India to take continuing reforms, particularly to focus on how productivity growth can be increased,” she said in response to a question from PTI . The IMF official said that to further the medium-term potential, India would need higher productivity growth, stronger private investment, and faster creation of high-quality jobs. Ms. Kozack said these issues will come up during the Article 4 consultations with India. Last month, the IMF raised India’s growth forecast for fiscal year 2027 and fiscal year 2028 to 7%, from the 6.4% and 6.7% projections respectively made in July. “India does remain a key growth engine for the world. The economy has strong fundamentals and has shown considerable resilience,” Ms. Kozack said.

articles.title: CAG widens purview of power sector audit, starting with DISCOMs; consumer satisfaction in focus
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Officials stated that DISCOMs would be evaluated for their performance over a five-year period, following by transmission, generation, renewable energy and RDSS.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) is undertaking a comprehensive audit of the power sector, beginning with distribution companies (discoms), where consumer satisfaction, power trading and financial sustainability emerging as key focus areas. The exercise will subsequently cover transmission, generation, renewable energy and the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS), with each segment’s operational and financial performance being assessed over the preceding five years, according to officials familiar with the development. Discoms will be the first to be audited, with the ongoing phase covering their performance between FY21 and FY26. As many as 39 discoms across the country, along with five departmental undertakings, will be assessed. Privately owned discoms, however, will remain outside the scope of the exercise. The audit commenced in July this year, with the report expected to be finalised around the middle of the next financial year. The audit of the transmission segment is scheduled to begin with FY27. Moving beyond conventional financial and operational assessments, the CAG has directed auditors to engage directly with electricity consumers, local experts and influential groups.. “We told our auditors that it (the audit) must not be limited to a stakeholder consultation exercise, we must engage with consumers of electricity,” an official said. The exercise will capture the experiences of around 10,000 consumers across industrial, agricultural and domestic categories, with particular emphasis on the reliability and quality of power supply. Power trading and procurement costs will constitute another major area of scrutiny. Officials pointed out that the share of short-term power procurement in states’ overall power purchase basket has risen from around 7-8% five years ago to nearly 14% currently, with power exchanges accounting for more than 56% of such transactions. “Ultimately, the cost at which the power is purchased would impact the end consumer of the electricity, and it also impacts financials of the entities concerned,” officials said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The audit will also examine key operational indicators, including aggregate technical and commercial (AT&C) losses, billing and collection efficiency, alongside the financial health and long-term viability of discoms.

As many as 39 discoms across the country, along with five departmental undertakings, will be assessed. Privately owned discoms, however, will remain outside the scope of the exercise. The audit commenced in July this year, with the report expected to be finalised around the middle of the next financial year. The audit of the transmission segment is scheduled to begin with FY27. Moving beyond conventional financial and operational assessments, the CAG has directed auditors to engage directly with electricity consumers, local experts and influential groups.. “We told our auditors that it (the audit) must not be limited to a stakeholder consultation exercise, we must engage with consumers of electricity,” an official said. The exercise will capture the experiences of around 10,000 consumers across industrial, agricultural and domestic categories, with particular emphasis on the reliability and quality of power supply. Power trading and procurement costs will constitute another major area of scrutiny. Officials pointed out that the share of short-term power procurement in states’ overall power purchase basket has risen from around 7-8% five years ago to nearly 14% currently, with power exchanges accounting for more than 56% of such transactions. “Ultimately, the cost at which the power is purchased would impact the end consumer of the electricity, and it also impacts financials of the entities concerned,” officials said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The audit will also examine key operational indicators, including aggregate technical and commercial (AT&C) losses, billing and collection efficiency, alongside the financial health and long-term viability of discoms.

articles.title: South Sudan postpones first national elections until February
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The legislative and presidential elections had been scheduled for December 22, after already being delayed several times. The United Nations had warned that a vote could set off widespread conflict

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: South Sudan, the world’s newest country, on Saturday (November 14, 2026) postponed its first national elections from December to February amid growing ethnic and political battles. The legislative and presidential elections had been scheduled for December 22, after already being delayed several times. The United Nations had warned that a vote could set off widespread conflict. The electoral commission issued a new calendar on social media, giving a new voting date of February 11, with results to be announced four days later. Commission secretary general Ahon Malou Lueth confirmed the change to AFP but would not give a reason or other details. President Salva Kiir’s government forces and followers of detained former Vice President Riek Machar have been involved in escalating, deadly confrontations in recent months. Other ethnic tensions and cattle-rustling battles have also complicated the picture in one of the world’s poorest countries. South Sudan became independent from Sudan in 2011, but Mr. Kiir’s and Mr. Machar’s forces fought a civil war from 2013 to 2018 that killed at least 400,000 people. Mr. Machar has been under house arrest since March 2025, accused of “crimes against humanity”. The new election date was announced on the day that voter registration was due to start, with more than 3,100 centres set up across the country. Not all the necessary equipment had arrived at the centres, officials said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The UN Commission on Human Rights in South Sudan has issued several warnings about conditions in the country, including the displacement of tens of thousands of people, the deadly battles and the disruption of international humanitarian operations.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The legislative and presidential elections had been scheduled for December 22, after already being delayed several times. The United Nations had warned that a vote could set off widespread conflict
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: South Sudan, the world’s newest country, on Saturday (November 14, 2026) postponed its first national elections from December to February amid growing ethnic and political battles. The legislative and presidential elections had been scheduled for December 22, after already being delayed several times. The United Nations had warned that a vote could set off widespread conflict. The electoral commission issued a new calendar on social media, giving a new voting date of February 11, with results to be announced four days later. Commission secretary general Ahon Malou Lueth confirmed the change to AFP but would not give a reason or other details. President Salva Kiir’s government forces and followers of detained former Vice President Riek Machar have been involved in escalating, deadly confrontations in recent months. Other ethnic tensions and cattle-rustling battles have also complicated the picture in one of the world’s poorest countries. South Sudan became independent from Sudan in 2011, but Mr. Kiir’s and Mr. Machar’s forces fought a civil war from 2013 to 2018 that killed at least 400,000 people. Mr. Machar has been under house arrest since March 2025, accused of “crimes against humanity”. The new election date was announced on the day that voter registration was due to start, with more than 3,100 centres set up across the country. Not all the necessary equipment had arrived at the centres, officials said.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The UN Commission on Human Rights in South Sudan has issued several warnings about conditions in the country, including the displacement of tens of thousands of people, the deadly battles and the disruption of international humanitarian operations.

articles.title: Riots in France: How anti-Government protests spiralled out of control
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The French authorities’ heavy-handed response, including thousands of arrests, police beatings and curbs on marches, has added to the volatile mix of grievances fuelling an anti-Government groundswell that shows no sign of abating before next year’s presidential election

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Smashed windows and ransacked shops. Bloodied teenage protesters. A city hall on fire. Such scenes shocked France as rioting erupted last month during nationwide protests over high living costs and strained public services. Government officials have repeatedly blamed far-left radicals and “opportunistic delinquents,” who they say took advantage of mostly peaceful demonstrations ​to attack symbols of State authority and capitalism across France. But the authorities’ heavy-handed response, including thousands of arrests, police beatings and curbs on marches, has added to the volatile mix of grievances fuelling an anti-Government groundswell that shows no sign of abating before next year’s presidential election, Reuters found. Reuters journalists reviewed dozens of videos of the violence, attended ‌the court hearings of 26 people accused of taking part and interviewed over 50 Government officials, police officers, attorneys, protesters and witnesses to understand how a movement that began in September with small protests over conditions in State schools spiralled ​into some of the worst civil unrest in years. Police tactics have faced scrutiny since the start due to the life-changing injuries suffered by some young people, including blown-off hands and lost eyes. United Nations and other human rights experts have also raised concerns about ⁠the arrest of nearly 7,000 minors during sometimes-violent school blockades, which they said was disproportionate. Images of riot police baton-charging teenagers fanned support for the students from a diverse array of protesters, including parents, teachers, left-wing politicians and trade unionists, who joined their marches. “We have rights,” said Emilie Berthier de Grandry, 42, who has attended four demonstrations in Paris with her 15-year-old son, Aaron, dressed in an inflatable shark costume. “We’re not going to let ourselves be pushed around.” Nationwide demonstrations on October 17 also brought a resurgence of so-called yellow-vest protesters, an anti-establishment movement that faced off against President Emmanuel Macron’s Government in 2018-2019 over high fuel prices.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The violent outbursts were so intense that day that police lost control of ‌entire neighbourhoods to rioters and looters in France’s three largest cities: Paris, Marseille and Lyon. Every week since then, people have taken to the streets across France to voice their anger at police and the Government.

Core Context & Background: The French authorities’ heavy-handed response, including thousands of arrests, police beatings and curbs on marches, has added to the volatile mix of grievances fuelling an anti-Government groundswell that shows no sign of abating before next year’s presidential election
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Smashed windows and ransacked shops. Bloodied teenage protesters. A city hall on fire. Such scenes shocked France as rioting erupted last month during nationwide protests over high living costs and strained public services. Government officials have repeatedly blamed far-left radicals and “opportunistic delinquents,” who they say took advantage of mostly peaceful demonstrations ​to attack symbols of State authority and capitalism across France. But the authorities’ heavy-handed response, including thousands of arrests, police beatings and curbs on marches, has added to the volatile mix of grievances fuelling an anti-Government groundswell that shows no sign of abating before next year’s presidential election, Reuters found. Reuters journalists reviewed dozens of videos of the violence, attended ‌the court hearings of 26 people accused of taking part and interviewed over 50 Government officials, police officers, attorneys, protesters and witnesses to understand how a movement that began in September with small protests over conditions in State schools spiralled ​into some of the worst civil unrest in years. Police tactics have faced scrutiny since the start due to the life-changing injuries suffered by some young people, including blown-off hands and lost eyes. United Nations and other human rights experts have also raised concerns about ⁠the arrest of nearly 7,000 minors during sometimes-violent school blockades, which they said was disproportionate. Images of riot police baton-charging teenagers fanned support for the students from a diverse array of protesters, including parents, teachers, left-wing politicians and trade unionists, who joined their marches. “We have rights,” said Emilie Berthier de Grandry, 42, who has attended four demonstrations in Paris with her 15-year-old son, Aaron, dressed in an inflatable shark costume. “We’re not going to let ourselves be pushed around.” Nationwide demonstrations on October 17 also brought a resurgence of so-called yellow-vest protesters, an anti-establishment movement that faced off against President Emmanuel Macron’s Government in 2018-2019 over high fuel prices.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The violent outbursts were so intense that day that police lost control of ‌entire neighbourhoods to rioters and looters in France’s three largest cities: Paris, Marseille and Lyon. Every week since then, people have taken to the streets across France to voice their anger at police and the Government.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: It demanded that Israel “cease the exploitation, damage, cause of loss or depletion and endangerment of the natural resources in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and in the occupied Syrian Golan

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has voted in favour of a UN General Assembly draft resolution that reaffirms the inalienable rights of the Palestinian people and the population of the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources and demands that Israel cease the exploitation and damage of these resources. The 193-Member UN General Assembly voted overwhelmingly on Wednesday (November 11, 2026) in favour of the resolution ‘Permanent sovereignty of the Palestinian people in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and of the Arab population in the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources’ proposed by Uruguay. India voted in favour of the resolution along with 150 other UN Member States, while Israel and the U.S. were among the seven nations that voted against the draft, which got 11 abstentions. The resolution reaffirmed the inalienable rights of the Palestinian people and of the population of the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources, including land, water and energy resources. It demanded that Israel “cease the exploitation, damage, cause of loss or depletion and endangerment of the natural resources in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and in the occupied Syrian Golan. It stressed that the wall and settlements being constructed by Israel in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including in and around East Jerusalem, are contrary to international law and seriously deprive the Palestinian people of their natural resources. It also called for full compliance with the legal obligations affirmed in the July 2004 advisory opinion of the International Court of Justice and relevant UN resolutions. The resolution called upon Israel to comply strictly with its obligations under international law, including international humanitarian law, and immediately and completely cease all policies and measures aimed at altering the character and status of the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem. It further called upon Israel to halt all actions, including those perpetrated by Israeli settlers, that harm the environment, including the dumping of waste materials in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and the occupied Syrian Golan.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: It also called upon Israel to cease its destruction of vital infrastructure, including water pipelines, sewage networks and electricity networks, and to cease its demolition and confiscation of Palestinian homes and civilian infrastructure, agricultural lands and water wells.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has voted in favour of a UN General Assembly draft resolution that reaffirms the inalienable rights of the Palestinian people and the population of the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources and demands that Israel cease the exploitation and damage of these resources. The 193-Member UN General Assembly voted overwhelmingly on Wednesday (November 11, 2026) in favour of the resolution ‘Permanent sovereignty of the Palestinian people in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and of the Arab population in the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources’ proposed by Uruguay. India voted in favour of the resolution along with 150 other UN Member States, while Israel and the U.S. were among the seven nations that voted against the draft, which got 11 abstentions. The resolution reaffirmed the inalienable rights of the Palestinian people and of the population of the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources, including land, water and energy resources. It demanded that Israel “cease the exploitation, damage, cause of loss or depletion and endangerment of the natural resources in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and in the occupied Syrian Golan. It stressed that the wall and settlements being constructed by Israel in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including in and around East Jerusalem, are contrary to international law and seriously deprive the Palestinian people of their natural resources. It also called for full compliance with the legal obligations affirmed in the July 2004 advisory opinion of the International Court of Justice and relevant UN resolutions. The resolution called upon Israel to comply strictly with its obligations under international law, including international humanitarian law, and immediately and completely cease all policies and measures aimed at altering the character and status of the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem. It further called upon Israel to halt all actions, including those perpetrated by Israeli settlers, that harm the environment, including the dumping of waste materials in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and the occupied Syrian Golan.

articles.title: Piyush Goyal in Egypt: Both sides to discuss increasing cooperation in infra, manufacturing, logistics
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Egypt's strategic geographical location offers significant opportunities for Indian businesses to strengthen their presence in the country and access markets across Africa, the Middle East and Europe

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal will begin a two-day visit to Egypt on Sunday (November 15, 2026), focusing on ways to strengthen bilateral trade and investment ties and explore opportunities for cooperation in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, industrial development, manufacturing, infrastructure, ports and logistics, an official statement said. Egypt's strategic geographical location offers significant opportunities for Indian businesses to strengthen their presence in the country and access markets across Africa, the Middle East and Europe. The two sides are also expected to discuss measures to facilitate greater participation of businesses in each other's markets, strengthen institutional mechanisms, address trade-related concerns and promote investment partnerships, the commerce ministry said on Saturday (November 14). "Opportunities for cooperation in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, industrial development, manufacturing, infrastructure, ports and logistics, and regional value chains are also expected to feature in the discussions," it added. A high-level Indian business delegation comprising over 140 CEOs and senior industry representatives from diverse sectors are accompanying the minister to participate in the India-Egypt Joint Business Council (JBC), and Joint Trade Committee (JTC) meetings. The seventh session of the JTC will be co-chaired by Mr. Goyal and Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade of Egypt Mohamed Farid Saleh on Sunday (November 15). The trade committee meeting will provide an opportunity to review the progress of bilateral trade and investment relations and discuss measures to further diversify and expand the bilateral trade basket. "Discussions are expected to cover market access issues, non-tariff barriers, trade remedies, agricultural and food products, pharmaceuticals and healthcare, engineering goods, chemicals and petrochemicals, fertilisers, textiles, MSMEs, customs cooperation, services, renewable energy, green hydrogen, transport and logistics," it said. The JBC Meeting and Business Forum will provide platforms for direct engagement between business leaders and industry stakeholders from both countries to explore opportunities for enhancing bilateral trade and investment, fostering joint ventures, promoting technology partnerships and strengthening industrial collaboration.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: During the visit, Mr. Goyal will also hold bilateral meetings with senior Egyptian Ministers to exchange views on further strengthening bilateral economic and commercial relations, particularly in the areas of trade, investment and industrial cooperation.

📰 Piyush Goyal in Egypt: Both sides to discuss increasing cooperation in infra, manufacturing, logistics

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 12:59:16 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Egypt's strategic geographical location offers significant opportunities for Indian businesses to strengthen their presence in the country and access markets across Africa, the Middle East and Europe

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal will begin a two-day visit to Egypt on Sunday (November 15, 2026), focusing on ways to strengthen bilateral trade and investment ties and explore opportunities for cooperation in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, industrial development, manufacturing, infrastructure, ports and logistics, an official statement said. Egypt's strategic geographical location offers significant opportunities for Indian businesses to strengthen their presence in the country and access markets across Africa, the Middle East and Europe. The two sides are also expected to discuss measures to facilitate greater participation of businesses in each other's markets, strengthen institutional mechanisms, address trade-related concerns and promote investment partnerships, the commerce ministry said on Saturday (November 14). "Opportunities for cooperation in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, industrial development, manufacturing, infrastructure, ports and logistics, and regional value chains are also expected to feature in the discussions," it added. A high-level Indian business delegation comprising over 140 CEOs and senior industry representatives from diverse sectors are accompanying the minister to participate in the India-Egypt Joint Business Council (JBC), and Joint Trade Committee (JTC) meetings. The seventh session of the JTC will be co-chaired by Mr. Goyal and Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade of Egypt Mohamed Farid Saleh on Sunday (November 15). The trade committee meeting will provide an opportunity to review the progress of bilateral trade and investment relations and discuss measures to further diversify and expand the bilateral trade basket. "Discussions are expected to cover market access issues, non-tariff barriers, trade remedies, agricultural and food products, pharmaceuticals and healthcare, engineering goods, chemicals and petrochemicals, fertilisers, textiles, MSMEs, customs cooperation, services, renewable energy, green hydrogen, transport and logistics," it said. The JBC Meeting and Business Forum will provide platforms for direct engagement between business leaders and industry stakeholders from both countries to explore opportunities for enhancing bilateral trade and investment, fostering joint ventures, promoting technology partnerships and strengthening industrial collaboration.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: During the visit, Mr. Goyal will also hold bilateral meetings with senior Egyptian Ministers to exchange views on further strengthening bilateral economic and commercial relations, particularly in the areas of trade, investment and industrial cooperation.

articles.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after hourslong global outage
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ‌technology giant said it was “monitoring the backlog of email messages ‌accrued during this ​event” before considering the issue with ⁠the enterprise services resolved.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Microsoft said on Saturday (November 14, 2026) that services were fully restored after a massive outage that lasted for hours. “We have completed our efforts to address the underlying issue of the incident and restored service to the remaining impacted customers and regions,” the company said in an update on X. Users reported that Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams and AI assistant Copilot, were interrupted. Downdetector, an online tracker, said it received outage reports from users in more than 70 countries and territories. The outage affected governments, courts, healthcare services, businesses, airlines and banks in many places. Governments including those of Japan, Singapore and Australia reported that the hours-long episode had impacted some of their operations. Over 430 million people use Microsoft 365 apps, Microsoft said on its website. Problems started appearing around midday Thursday in the U.S. The Redmond, Washington-based company apologised on Friday for the disruptions and said the outage was “not related to cyber” or artificial intelligence agents.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: It said the incident “was introduced by an issue during an earlier network capacity upgrade that surfaced” following a recent network change.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Microsoft says services fully restored after hourslong global outage

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 03:28:34 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The ‌technology giant said it was “monitoring the backlog of email messages ‌accrued during this ​event” before considering the issue with ⁠the enterprise services resolved.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Microsoft said on Saturday (November 14, 2026) that services were fully restored after a massive outage that lasted for hours. “We have completed our efforts to address the underlying issue of the incident and restored service to the remaining impacted customers and regions,” the company said in an update on X. Users reported that Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams and AI assistant Copilot, were interrupted. Downdetector, an online tracker, said it received outage reports from users in more than 70 countries and territories. The outage affected governments, courts, healthcare services, businesses, airlines and banks in many places. Governments including those of Japan, Singapore and Australia reported that the hours-long episode had impacted some of their operations. Over 430 million people use Microsoft 365 apps, Microsoft said on its website. Problems started appearing around midday Thursday in the U.S. The Redmond, Washington-based company apologised on Friday for the disruptions and said the outage was “not related to cyber” or artificial intelligence agents.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: It said the incident “was introduced by an issue during an earlier network capacity upgrade that surfaced” following a recent network change.

articles.title: Samsung announces Google co-developed smart glasses pricing and sale details
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Equipped with a high-definition camera, open-ear speakers, and directional microphones, the eyewear helps users interact naturally with the world around them

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Samsung has officially unveiled its new lineup of intelligent eyewear , bringing hands-free artificial intelligence into everyday fashion. Developed in partnership with Google, Gentle Monster and Warby Parker, the smart glasses integrate Google’s Gemini AI directly into stylish frames built for daily wear. Set to launch on December 10, 2026, in the U.S. and South Korea, with pre-orders starting today, the collection features 30 distinct frame styles. Weighing around 41 grams, the frames combine Warby Parker’s classic look with Gentle Monster’s bold design aesthetics. The smart glasses run on Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 platform. Equipped with a 12 MP HD camera, open-ear speakers, and directional microphones, the eyewear helps users interact naturally with the world around them. Wearers can ask Gemini to identify objects and landmarks, translate menus instantly or follow step-by-step navigation via Google Maps. For workplace efficiency, the glasses can capture meeting whiteboards, generate key summaries and automatically sync them into Samsung Notes. The system also organises, summarises, and reads aloud incoming notifications. To address privacy concerns, the eyewear design includes visible recording lights and audio chimes whenever the camera captures images or video. Additionally, the software claims to automatically blur bystanders’ faces during visual queries, while open-ear speakers are tuned to limit sound leakage. The eyewear claims up to nine hours of battery life on a single charge, extending up to 72 hours with its charging case. The U.S. pricing starts at $395 for Warby Parker models, while Gentle Monster frames range from $449 to $489.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: technology (general) / gadgets (general) / accessories

articles.title: SpaceX launches 15th Starship flight with hopes of achieving first round trip
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Starship expected to descend from space after completing 14 orbits around Earth, setting up its debut catch landing for ​Saturday afternoon; the Super Heavy booster was diverted from its return flight path to a fixed point over the Gulf of Mexico before exploding a short distance ‌over the sea surface

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: SpaceX launched the 15th flight of its Starship spacecraft from Texas on Friday (November 13, 2026) on a mission the company hopes will ‌be the first round-trip rocket voyage to orbit and back to the very spot where it left Earth, ​a key test of Elon Musk’s effort to build a fully reusable rocket system. Plans call for Starship’s uncrewed upper-stage vessel to re-enter ⁠the atmosphere after nearly a day in orbit and return to its launch tower on Saturday (November 14, 2026) for an engine-controlled touchdown assisted by the giant mechanical arms of a pioneering catch-landing mechanism. SpaceX had intended to use the same return-flight and “chopstick”-arm technology to recover Starship’s lower-stage booster rocket shortly after the two parts of the spacecraft separated within ‌minutes of the launch. But the Super Heavy booster, for reasons not immediately clear, was diverted from its return flight path to a fixed point over the Gulf of Mexico and momentarily hovered in the air before exploding a short distance ‌over the sea surface. The booster for SpaceX's mega rocket Starship explodes after a catch attempt was aborted during a test flight from Starbase, Texas. | Photo Credit: AP SpaceX mission controllers hoped to have better luck in steering Starship’s upper stage back to home base at the ‌end ⁠of its flight. The vehicle reached orbit about 27 minutes after launch, SpaceX said. Bringing the top portion ⁠of the spacecraft intact back to the platform where it was launched would mark a breakthrough in the ambitions of Musk, who founded SpaceX in 2002, to reduce spaceflight costs by developing a fully recyclable rocket system. The combined vehicle, consisting of the main Starship cargo-and-crew vessel perched atop its Super Heavy booster rocket and standing 40 stories high, roared off its ​launch pad from SpaceX’s South Texas Starbase complex along the ‌Gulf of Mexico near Brownsville. The flight marked Starship’s 15th test flight since 2023 and the second to carry a batch of operational Starlink satellites to orbit. That makes the mission both a revenue-generating endeavor for SpaceX’s satellite-connectivity business and a high-stakes test for a rocket ship still under development. Starship 15 began releasing its cargo of 26 satellites about 36 minutes into its flight in a payload-delivery operation expected to take ‌less than an hour to complete, the company said in a livestream presentation of the mission.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Musk’s space and AI business ​views Starship as key to expanding its network of Starlink internet satellites and, in the future, deploying a swarm of orbital AI data-processing centers dubbed Starmind, as the company positions itself to become a high-tech infrastructure provider.

📰 SpaceX launches 15th Starship flight with hopes of achieving first round trip

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 09:47:31 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Starship expected to descend from space after completing 14 orbits around Earth, setting up its debut catch landing for ​Saturday afternoon; the Super Heavy booster was diverted from its return flight path to a fixed point over the Gulf of Mexico before exploding a short distance ‌over the sea surface

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: SpaceX launched the 15th flight of its Starship spacecraft from Texas on Friday (November 13, 2026) on a mission the company hopes will ‌be the first round-trip rocket voyage to orbit and back to the very spot where it left Earth, ​a key test of Elon Musk’s effort to build a fully reusable rocket system. Plans call for Starship’s uncrewed upper-stage vessel to re-enter ⁠the atmosphere after nearly a day in orbit and return to its launch tower on Saturday (November 14, 2026) for an engine-controlled touchdown assisted by the giant mechanical arms of a pioneering catch-landing mechanism. SpaceX had intended to use the same return-flight and “chopstick”-arm technology to recover Starship’s lower-stage booster rocket shortly after the two parts of the spacecraft separated within ‌minutes of the launch. But the Super Heavy booster, for reasons not immediately clear, was diverted from its return flight path to a fixed point over the Gulf of Mexico and momentarily hovered in the air before exploding a short distance ‌over the sea surface. The booster for SpaceX's mega rocket Starship explodes after a catch attempt was aborted during a test flight from Starbase, Texas. | Photo Credit: AP SpaceX mission controllers hoped to have better luck in steering Starship’s upper stage back to home base at the ‌end ⁠of its flight. The vehicle reached orbit about 27 minutes after launch, SpaceX said. Bringing the top portion ⁠of the spacecraft intact back to the platform where it was launched would mark a breakthrough in the ambitions of Musk, who founded SpaceX in 2002, to reduce spaceflight costs by developing a fully recyclable rocket system. The combined vehicle, consisting of the main Starship cargo-and-crew vessel perched atop its Super Heavy booster rocket and standing 40 stories high, roared off its ​launch pad from SpaceX’s South Texas Starbase complex along the ‌Gulf of Mexico near Brownsville. The flight marked Starship’s 15th test flight since 2023 and the second to carry a batch of operational Starlink satellites to orbit. That makes the mission both a revenue-generating endeavor for SpaceX’s satellite-connectivity business and a high-stakes test for a rocket ship still under development. Starship 15 began releasing its cargo of 26 satellites about 36 minutes into its flight in a payload-delivery operation expected to take ‌less than an hour to complete, the company said in a livestream presentation of the mission.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Musk’s space and AI business ​views Starship as key to expanding its network of Starlink internet satellites and, in the future, deploying a swarm of orbital AI data-processing centers dubbed Starmind, as the company positions itself to become a high-tech infrastructure provider.
