fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: It demanded that Israel “cease the exploitation, damage, cause of loss or depletion and endangerment of the natural resources in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and in the occupied Syrian Golan

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has voted in favour of a UN General Assembly draft resolution that reaffirms the inalienable rights of the Palestinian people and the population of the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources and demands that Israel cease the exploitation and damage of these resources. The 193-Member UN General Assembly voted overwhelmingly on Wednesday (November 11, 2026) in favour of the resolution ‘Permanent sovereignty of the Palestinian people in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and of the Arab population in the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources’ proposed by Uruguay. India voted in favour of the resolution along with 150 other UN Member States, while Israel and the U.S. were among the seven nations that voted against the draft, which got 11 abstentions. The resolution reaffirmed the inalienable rights of the Palestinian people and of the population of the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources, including land, water and energy resources. It demanded that Israel “cease the exploitation, damage, cause of loss or depletion and endangerment of the natural resources in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and in the occupied Syrian Golan. It stressed that the wall and settlements being constructed by Israel in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including in and around East Jerusalem, are contrary to international law and seriously deprive the Palestinian people of their natural resources. It also called for full compliance with the legal obligations affirmed in the July 2004 advisory opinion of the International Court of Justice and relevant UN resolutions. The resolution called upon Israel to comply strictly with its obligations under international law, including international humanitarian law, and immediately and completely cease all policies and measures aimed at altering the character and status of the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem. It further called upon Israel to halt all actions, including those perpetrated by Israeli settlers, that harm the environment, including the dumping of waste materials in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and the occupied Syrian Golan.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: It also called upon Israel to cease its destruction of vital infrastructure, including water pipelines, sewage networks and electricity networks, and to cease its demolition and confiscation of Palestinian homes and civilian infrastructure, agricultural lands and water wells.

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has voted in favour of a UN General Assembly draft resolution that reaffirms the inalienable rights of the Palestinian people and the population of the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources and demands that Israel cease the exploitation and damage of these resources. The 193-Member UN General Assembly voted overwhelmingly on Wednesday (November 11, 2026) in favour of the resolution ‘Permanent sovereignty of the Palestinian people in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and of the Arab population in the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources’ proposed by Uruguay. India voted in favour of the resolution along with 150 other UN Member States, while Israel and the U.S. were among the seven nations that voted against the draft, which got 11 abstentions. The resolution reaffirmed the inalienable rights of the Palestinian people and of the population of the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources, including land, water and energy resources. It demanded that Israel “cease the exploitation, damage, cause of loss or depletion and endangerment of the natural resources in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and in the occupied Syrian Golan. It stressed that the wall and settlements being constructed by Israel in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including in and around East Jerusalem, are contrary to international law and seriously deprive the Palestinian people of their natural resources. It also called for full compliance with the legal obligations affirmed in the July 2004 advisory opinion of the International Court of Justice and relevant UN resolutions. The resolution called upon Israel to comply strictly with its obligations under international law, including international humanitarian law, and immediately and completely cease all policies and measures aimed at altering the character and status of the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem. It further called upon Israel to halt all actions, including those perpetrated by Israeli settlers, that harm the environment, including the dumping of waste materials in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and the occupied Syrian Golan.
• 3. articles.title: Piyush Goyal in Egypt: Both sides to discuss increasing cooperation in infra, manufacturing, logistics
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Egypt's strategic geographical location offers significant opportunities for Indian businesses to strengthen their presence in the country and access markets across Africa, the Middle East and Europe

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal will begin a two-day visit to Egypt on Sunday (November 15, 2026), focusing on ways to strengthen bilateral trade and investment ties and explore opportunities for cooperation in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, industrial development, manufacturing, infrastructure, ports and logistics, an official statement said. Egypt's strategic geographical location offers significant opportunities for Indian businesses to strengthen their presence in the country and access markets across Africa, the Middle East and Europe. The two sides are also expected to discuss measures to facilitate greater participation of businesses in each other's markets, strengthen institutional mechanisms, address trade-related concerns and promote investment partnerships, the commerce ministry said on Saturday (November 14). "Opportunities for cooperation in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, industrial development, manufacturing, infrastructure, ports and logistics, and regional value chains are also expected to feature in the discussions," it added. A high-level Indian business delegation comprising over 140 CEOs and senior industry representatives from diverse sectors are accompanying the minister to participate in the India-Egypt Joint Business Council (JBC), and Joint Trade Committee (JTC) meetings. The seventh session of the JTC will be co-chaired by Mr. Goyal and Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade of Egypt Mohamed Farid Saleh on Sunday (November 15). The trade committee meeting will provide an opportunity to review the progress of bilateral trade and investment relations and discuss measures to further diversify and expand the bilateral trade basket. "Discussions are expected to cover market access issues, non-tariff barriers, trade remedies, agricultural and food products, pharmaceuticals and healthcare, engineering goods, chemicals and petrochemicals, fertilisers, textiles, MSMEs, customs cooperation, services, renewable energy, green hydrogen, transport and logistics," it said. The JBC Meeting and Business Forum will provide platforms for direct engagement between business leaders and industry stakeholders from both countries to explore opportunities for enhancing bilateral trade and investment, fostering joint ventures, promoting technology partnerships and strengthening industrial collaboration.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: During the visit, Mr. Goyal will also hold bilateral meetings with senior Egyptian Ministers to exchange views on further strengthening bilateral economic and commercial relations, particularly in the areas of trade, investment and industrial cooperation.

📰 Piyush Goyal in Egypt: Both sides to discuss increasing cooperation in infra, manufacturing, logistics

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Egypt's strategic geographical location offers significant opportunities for Indian businesses to strengthen their presence in the country and access markets across Africa, the Middle East and Europe

Egypt's strategic geographical location offers significant opportunities for Indian businesses to strengthen their presence in the country and access markets across Africa, the Middle East and Europe. The two sides are also expected to discuss measures to facilitate greater participation of businesses in each other's markets, strengthen institutional mechanisms, address trade-related concerns and promote investment partnerships, the commerce ministry said on Saturday (November 14). "Opportunities for cooperation in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, industrial development, manufacturing, infrastructure, ports and logistics, and regional value chains are also expected to feature in the discussions," it added. A high-level Indian business delegation comprising over 140 CEOs and senior industry representatives from diverse sectors are accompanying the minister to participate in the India-Egypt Joint Business Council (JBC), and Joint Trade Committee (JTC) meetings. The seventh session of the JTC will be co-chaired by Mr. Goyal and Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade of Egypt Mohamed Farid Saleh on Sunday (November 15). The trade committee meeting will provide an opportunity to review the progress of bilateral trade and investment relations and discuss measures to further diversify and expand the bilateral trade basket. "Discussions are expected to cover market access issues, non-tariff barriers, trade remedies, agricultural and food products, pharmaceuticals and healthcare, engineering goods, chemicals and petrochemicals, fertilisers, textiles, MSMEs, customs cooperation, services, renewable energy, green hydrogen, transport and logistics," it said. The JBC Meeting and Business Forum will provide platforms for direct engagement between business leaders and industry stakeholders from both countries to explore opportunities for enhancing bilateral trade and investment, fostering joint ventures, promoting technology partnerships and strengthening industrial collaboration.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: During the visit, Mr. Goyal will also hold bilateral meetings with senior Egyptian Ministers to exchange views on further strengthening bilateral economic and commercial relations, particularly in the areas of trade, investment and industrial cooperation.

articles.title: No locus standi: Indian envoy hits back at USCIRF for remarks on Sharjeel Imam
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF) shared Sharjeel Imam’s profile on X, describing him as “a Muslim man detained in India for his religious freedom advocacy”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Indian Ambassador Vinay Mohan Kwatra has asked an American advisory body to introspect on its own prejudices and stop lecturing others, after the bipartisan agency flagged arrests in India allegedly on religious grounds. Mr. Kwatra’s sharp retort on Friday (November 13, 2026) came after the U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF) shared Sharjeel Imam’s profile on X , describing him as “a Muslim man detained in India for his religious freedom advocacy”. Former Jawaharlal Nehru University scholar Imam has been booked under UAPA (Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act) on allegations of being among the masterminds of the February 2020 riots that left 53 people dead and more than 700 injured. The violence erupted during protests against the Citizenship (Amendment) Act (CAA), 2019, and the National Register of Citizens (NRC). USCRIF has no locus standi to sit in judgment over the constitutional rights of Indian citizens. Its habitual partisan, ill-informed, and jaundiced assessments cannot diminish India's constitutional commitment to religious freedom and equal rights for all faiths. India flourishes defying the agenda-driven partisan narratives of the USCIRF. Taking the same liberty that USCIRF so readily assumes, a word of advice: introspect on your own prejudices and stop lecturing others. “USCIRF has no locus standi to sit in judgment over the constitutional rights of Indian citizens,” Kwatra said “Its habitual partisan, ill-informed, and jaundiced assessments cannot diminish India’s constitutional commitment to religious freedom and equal rights for all faiths,” he said. He said India flourishes, defying the agenda-driven partisan narratives of the USCIRF. “Taking the same liberty that USCIRF so readily assumes, a word of advice: introspect on your own prejudices and stop lecturing others,” Mr. Kwatra said. India describes USCIRF as a biased organisation that lacks credibility.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Established by the U.S. government in 1998 after the inaction of the International Religious Freedom Act, the recommendations of USCIRF are non-binding on the U.S. State Department.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 No locus standi: Indian envoy hits back at USCIRF for remarks on Sharjeel Imam

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 12:02:35 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF) shared Sharjeel Imam’s profile on X, describing him as “a Muslim man detained in India for his religious freedom advocacy”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Indian Ambassador Vinay Mohan Kwatra has asked an American advisory body to introspect on its own prejudices and stop lecturing others, after the bipartisan agency flagged arrests in India allegedly on religious grounds. Mr. Kwatra’s sharp retort on Friday (November 13, 2026) came after the U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF) shared Sharjeel Imam’s profile on X , describing him as “a Muslim man detained in India for his religious freedom advocacy”. Former Jawaharlal Nehru University scholar Imam has been booked under UAPA (Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act) on allegations of being among the masterminds of the February 2020 riots that left 53 people dead and more than 700 injured. articles.title: Samsung announces Google co-developed pricing and sale details of its smart glasses
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Equipped with a high-definition camera, open-ear speakers, and directional microphones, the eyewear helps users interact naturally with the world around them

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Samsung has officially unveiled its new lineup of intelligent eyewear , bringing hands-free artificial intelligence into everyday fashion. Developed in partnership with Google, Gentle Monster and Warby Parker, the smart glasses integrate Google’s Gemini AI directly into stylish frames built for daily wear. Set to launch on December 10, 2026, in the U.S. and South Korea, with pre-orders starting today, the collection features 30 distinct frame styles. Weighing around 41 grams, the frames combine Warby Parker’s classic look with Gentle Monster’s bold design aesthetics. The smart glasses run on Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 platform. Equipped with a 12 MP HD camera, open-ear speakers, and directional microphones, the eyewear helps users interact naturally with the world around them. Wearers can ask Gemini to identify objects and landmarks, translate menus instantly or follow step-by-step navigation via Google Maps. For workplace efficiency, the glasses can capture meeting whiteboards, generate key summaries and automatically sync them into Samsung Notes. The system also organises, summarises, and reads aloud incoming notifications. To address privacy concerns, the eyewear design includes visible recording lights and audio chimes whenever the camera captures images or video. Additionally, the software claims to automatically blur bystanders’ faces during visual queries, while open-ear speakers are tuned to limit sound leakage. The eyewear claims up to nine hours of battery life on a single charge, extending up to 72 hours with its charging case. The U.S. pricing starts at $395 for Warby Parker models, while Gentle Monster frames range from $449 to $489.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: technology (general) / gadgets (general) / accessories

articles.title: Series of security lapses led to burglary at Tanishq showroom in Madurai
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A burglary attempt was made earlier this month as well, but it went unnoticed by the showroom authorities

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A series of security lapses by those manning the newly inaugurated Tanishq showroom in Madurai led to the nocturnal burglary of gold and diamond jewellery worth several crores , which went unnoticed for a while, on the intervening night of Wednesday (November 11, 2026) and Thursday (November 12). While many jewellery showrooms adopt the practice of emptying their showcases and securing the valuables inside safety lockers after working hours, in this showroom, the ornaments were left in the display cases, even during the night, as the locker facility was still under construction. This allowed a lone burglar to lay his hands on the valuables without much difficulty. The biggest lapse was the failure to turn on the anti-burglary alarm that could have alerted officials about the intruder in the dead of the night. “The log showed that the alarm was switched off on Wednesday morning as the employees reported for duty. It should have been switched on again [on Wednesday night] before the employees locked the shutters,” the Commissioner of Police, S. Rajenthiran, said. The police were also critical of the urgency with which the showroom was inaugurated, even as construction work on the building was incomplete. The showroom operator had wanted to commence sales before Deepavali to tap the potential of the festive season. However, the incomplete work left the iron scaffolding intact on the outside wall even as high-value ornaments were kept in the showroom. “It is the scaffolding that had facilitated the burglar in gaining quick and easy access to the terrace of the tall, three-storey building,” the Commissioner added.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The officials also failed to take note of the vulnerability posed by an opening near the terrace, through which someone could easily sneak into the lift shaft. The burglar had breached it with ease by removing some screws, the police said.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: A burglary attempt was made earlier this month as well, but it went unnoticed by the showroom authorities
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A series of security lapses by those manning the newly inaugurated Tanishq showroom in Madurai led to the nocturnal burglary of gold and diamond jewellery worth several crores , which went unnoticed for a while, on the intervening night of Wednesday (November 11, 2026) and Thursday (November 12). While many jewellery showrooms adopt the practice of emptying their showcases and securing the valuables inside safety lockers after working hours, in this showroom, the ornaments were left in the display cases, even during the night, as the locker facility was still under construction. This allowed a lone burglar to lay his hands on the valuables without much difficulty. The biggest lapse was the failure to turn on the anti-burglary alarm that could have alerted officials about the intruder in the dead of the night. “The log showed that the alarm was switched off on Wednesday morning as the employees reported for duty. It should have been switched on again [on Wednesday night] before the employees locked the shutters,” the Commissioner of Police, S. Rajenthiran, said. The police were also critical of the urgency with which the showroom was inaugurated, even as construction work on the building was incomplete. The showroom operator had wanted to commence sales before Deepavali to tap the potential of the festive season. However, the incomplete work left the iron scaffolding intact on the outside wall even as high-value ornaments were kept in the showroom. “It is the scaffolding that had facilitated the burglar in gaining quick and easy access to the terrace of the tall, three-storey building,” the Commissioner added.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The officials also failed to take note of the vulnerability posed by an opening near the terrace, through which someone could easily sneak into the lift shaft. The burglar had breached it with ease by removing some screws, the police said.

articles.title: CFTRI initiative aims to standardise micronutrient testing in fortified rice
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: NutriQA-2026 focuses on reducing variations in laboratory results and strengthening quality assurance across the country

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A one-day national colloquium on “Harmonization of Micronutrient Testing and Laboratory Quality Assurance for Food Fortification (NutriQA–2026)” was organised at CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute (CSIR-CFTRI), Mysuru, on Friday (November 13, 2026). The colloquium brought together eminent technical experts, representatives from Technical Support Units (TSUs), National Food Laboratories (NFLs), private testing laboratories, scientists and laboratory professionals to deliberate on strengthening analytical capabilities and harmonizing laboratory practices for food fortification. Dr. Giridhar Parvatam, Director, CSIR-CFTRI; Prof. Jatindra Kumar Sahu, IIT Delhi; and Dr. S. Nagarajan, Head, Food Safety and Analytical Quality Control Laboratory (FSAQCL), CSIR-CFTRI were present. In his address, Dr. Giridhar Parvatam highlighted the importance of strengthening analytical quality control and quality assurance systems to ensure the reliability of micronutrient testing in fortified foods. He emphasised the need for harmonised analytical methods, standardised laboratory protocols, competency-based training and collaborative efforts among laboratories to minimise inter-laboratory variations and generate accurate and reproducible results. CSIR-CFTRI, in association with NIFTEM-Kundli, has been actively involved in capacity-building initiatives over the past three years to strengthen analytical competencies in the determination of vitamin B9, vitamin B12 and iron in fortified rice. The initiative is supported by IIT Delhi through funding from the Gates Foundation. Through these efforts, the institute has been contributing to strengthening the quality assurance framework for rice fortification by imparting technical training and promoting standardized analytical practices among government and private laboratory personnel across the country, a press release said. The colloquium featured three technical sessions delivered by eminent experts in the field. Dr. Lalitha R. Gowda, former Chief Scientist and former Head, FSAQCL, CSIR-CFTRI; Dr. A. Jayadeep, former Chief Scientist and former Head, FSAQCL, CSIR-CFTRI; and Prof. Sirimavo Nair, The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda (MSU), Vadodara, Gujarat, shared their technical expertise and insights on various aspects of micronutrient testing, laboratory quality assurance, and qualitative performance criteria. A significant component of NutriQA–2026 was the pre-consultation workshop on Quality Assurance – Fine-Tuning the Training of Trainers (ToT) Training Guide. The workshop facilitated group discussions among experts and participants on different thematic areas related to laboratory quality assurance. The deliberations focused on reviewing and refining the Master Trainer Guide and Training Toolkit Checklist to ensure uniformity in training delivery, practical demonstrations, analytical procedures and competency assessment across participating laboratories, it said. The discussions also addressed practical challenges associated with the determination of iron, vitamin B9 and vitamin B12 in premixes, fortified rice kernels (FRK) and fortified rice. The participants deliberated on harmonising sampling and analytical protocols, standardising quantitative testing procedures and strengthening competency assessment mechanisms.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The colloquium provided an important platform for knowledge exchange, technical deliberations and collaborative recommendations towards establishing a robust and sustainable network of competent laboratories across India. The initiative aims to minimise inter-laboratory variability and ensure accurate, reproducible and comparable analytical results, thereby strengthening confidence in the country’s food fortification programmes, according to the CSIR-CFTRI.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 CFTRI initiative aims to standardise micronutrient testing in fortified rice

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 01:58:33 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: NutriQA-2026 focuses on reducing variations in laboratory results and strengthening quality assurance across the country

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A one-day national colloquium on “Harmonization of Micronutrient Testing and Laboratory Quality Assurance for Food Fortification (NutriQA–2026)” was organised at CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute (CSIR-CFTRI), Mysuru, on Friday (November 13, 2026). The colloquium brought together eminent technical experts, representatives from Technical Support Units (TSUs), National Food Laboratories (NFLs), private testing laboratories, scientists and laboratory professionals to deliberate on strengthening analytical capabilities and harmonizing laboratory practices for food fortification. Dr. Giridhar Parvatam, Director, CSIR-CFTRI; Prof. Jatindra Kumar Sahu, IIT Delhi; and Dr. S. Nagarajan, Head, Food Safety and Analytical Quality Control Laboratory (FSAQCL), CSIR-CFTRI were present. In his address, Dr. Giridhar Parvatam highlighted the importance of strengthening analytical quality control and quality assurance systems to ensure the reliability of micronutrient testing in fortified foods. He emphasised the need for harmonised analytical methods, standardised laboratory protocols, competency-based training and collaborative efforts among laboratories to minimise inter-laboratory variations and generate accurate and reproducible results. CSIR-CFTRI, in association with NIFTEM-Kundli, has been actively involved in capacity-building initiatives over the past three years to strengthen analytical competencies in the determination of vitamin B9, vitamin B12 and iron in fortified rice. The initiative is supported by IIT Delhi through funding from the Gates Foundation. Through these efforts, the institute has been contributing to strengthening the quality assurance framework for rice fortification by imparting technical training and promoting standardized analytical practices among government and private laboratory personnel across the country, a press release said. The colloquium featured three technical sessions delivered by eminent experts in the field. Dr. Lalitha R. Gowda, former Chief Scientist and former Head, FSAQCL, CSIR-CFTRI; Dr. A. Jayadeep, former Chief Scientist and former Head, FSAQCL, CSIR-CFTRI; and Prof. Sirimavo Nair, The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda (MSU), Vadodara, Gujarat, shared their technical expertise and insights on various aspects of micronutrient testing, laboratory quality assurance, and qualitative performance criteria. A significant component of NutriQA–2026 was the pre-consultation workshop on Quality Assurance – Fine-Tuning the Training of Trainers (ToT) Training Guide. The workshop facilitated group discussions among experts and participants on different thematic areas related to laboratory quality assurance. The deliberations focused on reviewing and refining the Master Trainer Guide and Training Toolkit Checklist to ensure uniformity in training delivery, practical demonstrations, analytical procedures and competency assessment across participating laboratories, it said. The discussions also addressed practical challenges associated with the determination of iron, vitamin B9 and vitamin B12 in premixes, fortified rice kernels (FRK) and fortified rice. The participants deliberated on harmonising sampling and analytical protocols, standardising quantitative testing procedures and strengthening competency assessment mechanisms.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The colloquium provided an important platform for knowledge exchange, technical deliberations and collaborative recommendations towards establishing a robust and sustainable network of competent laboratories across India. The initiative aims to minimise inter-laboratory variability and ensure accurate, reproducible and comparable analytical results, thereby strengthening confidence in the country’s food fortification programmes, according to the CSIR-CFTRI.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Quantitative (Adjective)
आंकड़ों और संख्या पर आधारित — जिसे ठोस नंबरों और डेटा में मापा जा सके।
✓ Syn: Measurable, Numerical, Empirical  |  ✖ Ant: Qualitative, Subjective, Unmeasurable
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Harmonization (Noun)
सामंजस्य — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Harmonization' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "CFTRI initiative aims to standardise micronutrient testing in fortified rice", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. NutriQA-2026 focuses on reducing variations in laboratory results and strengthening quality assurance across the country.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'CFTRI initiative aims to standardise micronutrie' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'CFTRI initiative aims to standardise micronut' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'CFTRI initiative aims to standardise micronut' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "NutriQA-2026 focuses on reducing variations in laboratory results and strengthening quality assurance across the country." (Hinglish Arth: NutriQA-2026 प्रयोगशाला परिणामों में भिन्नता को कम करने और देश भर में गुणवत्ता आश्वासन को मजबूत करने पर केंद्रित है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "CFTRI initiative aims to standardise micronutrient testing in fortified rice"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The initiative aims to minimise inter-laboratory variability and ensure accurate, reproducible and comparable analytical results, thereby...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The initiative aims to minimise inter-laboratory variability and ensure accurate, reproducible and comparable analytical results, thereby..." (Hinglish Arth: इस पहल का उद्देश्य अंतर-प्रयोगशाला परिवर्तनशीलता को कम करना और सटीक, प्रतिलिपि प्रस्तुत करने योग्य और तुलनीय विश्लेषणात्मक परिणाम सुनिश्चित करना है, जिससे देश के खाद्य सुदृढ़ीकरण कार्यक्रमों में विश्वास मजबूत हो सके।)

Jayadeep, former Chief Scientist and former Head, FSAQCL, CSIR-CFTRI; and Prof. Sirimavo Nair, The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda (MSU), Vadodara, Gujarat, shared their technical expertise and insights on various aspects of micronutrient testing, laboratory quality assurance, and qualitative performance criteria. A significant component of NutriQA–2026 was the pre-consultation workshop on Quality Assurance – Fine-Tuning the Training of Trainers (ToT) Training Guide. The workshop facilitated group discussions among experts and participants on different thematic areas related to laboratory quality assurance. The deliberations focused on reviewing and refining the Master Trainer Guide and Training Toolkit Checklist to ensure uniformity in training delivery, practical demonstrations, analytical procedures and competency assessment across participating laboratories, it said. The discussions also addressed practical challenges associated with the determination of iron, vitamin B9 and vitamin B12 in premixes, fortified rice kernels (FRK) and fortified rice. The participants deliberated on harmonising sampling and analytical protocols, standardising quantitative testing procedures and strengthening competency assessment mechanisms.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The colloquium provided an important platform for knowledge exchange, technical deliberations and collaborative recommendations towards establishing a robust and sustainable network of competent laboratories across India. The initiative aims to minimise inter-laboratory variability and ensure accurate, reproducible and comparable analytical results, thereby strengthening confidence in the country’s food fortification programmes, according to the CSIR-CFTRI.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Mr Gandhi said every gig worker would receive ₹5 lakh in accident insurance and ₹10 lakh in health insurance. A social security contribution mechanism under which 1% of every transaction, including deliveries and cab rides, would be contributed towards the workers’ future security

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi announced a series of social security measures for gig workers in Telangana, including accident insurance of ₹5 lakh, health insurance of ₹10 lakh, dedicated Wi-Fi-enabled rest zones and a mechanism to ensure that 1% of every transaction is credited towards their social security. Addressing gig workers, Mr. Gandhi said the Congress government in Telangana was fulfilling its promise to protect workers engaged in the platform-based economy and ensure that they received their fair share of the benefits generated by their labour. Describing the 21st century as the age of data, Mr. Gandhi pointed out that while companies such as Google, Facebook, WhatsApp, and Uber operated on data, gig workers had so far been denied access to information about their own work. Under the proposed legislation, workers would be able to access complete details of their transactions, deliveries, working hours, and payments through their mobile phones. “The data belongs to you, the labour is yours, but you were not even allowed to see your own data,” he said. He said the government would also establish dedicated, Wi-Fi-enabled rest zones in Hyderabad and other cities to enable delivery personnel and other gig workers to park their vehicles, rest and relax during working hours. Announcing insurance benefits, Mr Gandhi said every gig worker would receive ₹5 lakh in accident insurance and ₹10 lakh in health insurance. A social security contribution mechanism under which 1% of every transaction, including deliveries and cab rides, would be contributed towards the workers’ future security. Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi, Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy along with Gig Workers launches the Telangana Gig Workers Social Security and Welfare Scheme at Hitech City, Hyderabad on Saturday, as part of the Bharat Summit. | Photo Credit: Nagara Gopal The amount would be collected from companies and routed through the Gig Workers’ Board before being transferred directly to the workers’ bank accounts, he said. Drawing a political distinction between the Congress and the BJP-RSS, Mr. Gandhi alleged that the latter wanted to turn gig workers into bonded labourers while allowing large corporate houses and platform companies to reap the benefits. In contrast, the Congress believed that workers were the foundation of the country’s economy and should be treated as partners.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Do not be afraid. The Telangana Government, Rahul Gandhi, Revanth Reddy, and the Congress team stand with you. We want to make you partners and ensure protection for you and your families,” he said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Rahul Gandhi promises social security, insurance cover for gig workers in Telangana

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 01:31:45 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Mr Gandhi said every gig worker would receive ₹5 lakh in accident insurance and ₹10 lakh in health insurance. A social security contribution mechanism under which 1% of every transaction, including deliveries and cab rides, would be contributed towards the workers’ future security

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi announced a series of social security measures for gig workers in Telangana, including accident insurance of ₹5 lakh, health insurance of ₹10 lakh, dedicated Wi-Fi-enabled rest zones and a mechanism to ensure that 1% of every transaction is credited towards their social security. Addressing gig workers, Mr. Gandhi said the Congress government in Telangana was fulfilling its promise to protect workers engaged in the platform-based economy and ensure that they received their fair share of the benefits generated by their labour. Describing the 21st century as the age of data, Mr. Gandhi pointed out that while companies such as Google, Facebook, WhatsApp, and Uber operated on data, gig workers had so far been denied access to information about their own work. Under the proposed legislation, workers would be able to access complete details of their transactions, deliveries, working hours, and payments through their mobile phones. “The data belongs to you, the labour is yours, but you were not even allowed to see your own data,” he said. He said the government would also establish dedicated, Wi-Fi-enabled rest zones in Hyderabad and other cities to enable delivery personnel and other gig workers to park their vehicles, rest and relax during working hours. Announcing insurance benefits, Mr Gandhi said every gig worker would receive ₹5 lakh in accident insurance and ₹10 lakh in health insurance. A social security contribution mechanism under which 1% of every transaction, including deliveries and cab rides, would be contributed towards the workers’ future security. Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi, Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy along with Gig Workers launches the Telangana Gig Workers Social Security and Welfare Scheme at Hitech City, Hyderabad on Saturday, as part of the Bharat Summit. | Photo Credit: Nagara Gopal The amount would be collected from companies and routed through the Gig Workers’ Board before being transferred directly to the workers’ bank accounts, he said. Drawing a political distinction between the Congress and the BJP-RSS, Mr. Gandhi alleged that the latter wanted to turn gig workers into bonded labourers while allowing large corporate houses and platform companies to reap the benefits. In contrast, the Congress believed that workers were the foundation of the country’s economy and should be treated as partners.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Do not be afraid. The Telangana Government, Rahul Gandhi, Revanth Reddy, and the Congress team stand with you. We want to make you partners and ensure protection for you and your families,” he said.

✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Contribution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Information' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Rahul Gandhi promises social security, insurance cover for gig workers in Telangana", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Mr Gandhi said every gig worker would receive ₹5 lakh in accident insurance and ₹10 lakh in health insurance.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Rahul Gandhi promises social security, insurance' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Rahul Gandhi promises social security, insura' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Rahul Gandhi promises social security, insura' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Mr Gandhi said every gig worker would receive ₹5 lakh in accident insurance and ₹10 lakh in health insurance." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Rahul Gandhi promises social security, insurance cover for gig workers in Telangana"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. We want to make you partners and ensure protection for you and your families,” he said.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: TMC’s Abhishek appears at police station for questioning over social media post
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: An FIR was registered against the TMC MP following a complaint about his social media post in May that allegedly targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and Gujaratis during the Assembly poll period

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: TMC national general secretary Abhishek Banerjee appeared before the police in Kolkata on Saturday (November 14, 2026) for questioning in connection with a case concerning an old social media post, an officer said. An FIR was registered against the TMC MP following a complaint about his social media post in May that allegedly targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and Gujaratis during the Assembly poll period. The complaint, filed on May 27, alleged that the remarks were irresponsible and could potentially hurt community sentiments. Police served Mr. Banerjee a notice directing him to appear for questioning. The MP is being questioned at Bhowanipur police station, the officer said. He has also been summoned by Girish Park police station in the city on November 20 in connection with another social media post.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Kolkata / West Bengal / All India Trinamool Congress

articles.title: U.S. FAA ground stop updates: Flights resume as hours-long halt lifted; Trump admin. blames 'overloaded' systems
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Trump administration rules out foul play, Transportation Secretary says major communications outage caused by decades old technology

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tens of thousands of fliers were forced to change their plans when the FAA issued a ground stop ‌that lasted four hours and led to the cancellations of more than 6,600 flights, with 8,600 delayed, according to FlightRadar24. It was just the third nationwide stop issued by ‌the Federal Aviation Administration this century. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed the problems not on malicious actors ‌but ⁠on a failure of aging network technology in the radar and communications system used ⁠for air traffic control. At the Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport, where information displays were almost completely filled with flights marked “Delayed” or “Cancelled,” some travellers appeared resigned as they wondered how long the delays would last and how their travel plans would be affected. NBA, NHL and college teams were left stranded as they tried to reach their destinations. Meanwhile, NFL teams were left to wonder whether the issue would be resolved in time to travel to their games this weekend. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said NCAA teams will be prioritised ahead of football games on Saturday (November 14, 2026). “I would encourage those football teams to reach out to the FAA, to schedule their flight times and make sure they can move” to make their kickoff, he said. Cargo flights were also delayed by the ground stop. FedEx, the world’s largest cargo airline, said it was prepared to activate contingency plans to keep any possible disruptions at a minimum.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: U.S. airlines move about 61,000 tons (55,340 metric tonnes) of goods — from letters to packages — to and from more than 220 countries daily, according to the industry trade group Airlines for America.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 U.S. FAA ground stop updates: Flights resume as hours-long halt lifted; Trump admin. blames 'overloaded' systems

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 11:59:38 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Trump administration rules out foul play, Transportation Secretary says major communications outage caused by decades old technology

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tens of thousands of fliers were forced to change their plans when the FAA issued a ground stop ‌that lasted four hours and led to the cancellations of more than 6,600 flights, with 8,600 delayed, according to FlightRadar24. It was just the third nationwide stop issued by ‌the Federal Aviation Administration this century. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed the problems not on malicious actors ‌but ⁠on a failure of aging network technology in the radar and communications system used ⁠for air traffic control. At the Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport, where information displays were almost completely filled with flights marked “Delayed” or “Cancelled,” some travellers appeared resigned as they wondered how long the delays would last and how their travel plans would be affected. NBA, NHL and college teams were left stranded as they tried to reach their destinations. Meanwhile, NFL teams were left to wonder whether the issue would be resolved in time to travel to their games this weekend. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said NCAA teams will be prioritised ahead of football games on Saturday (November 14, 2026). “I would encourage those football teams to reach out to the FAA, to schedule their flight times and make sure they can move” to make their kickoff, he said. Cargo flights were also delayed by the ground stop. FedEx, the world’s largest cargo airline, said it was prepared to activate contingency plans to keep any possible disruptions at a minimum.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: U.S. airlines move about 61,000 tons (55,340 metric tonnes) of goods — from letters to packages — to and from more than 220 countries daily, according to the industry trade group Airlines for America.

articles.title: KVASU signs MoU with UAE university for veterinary education, research
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The MoU provides for faculty exchanges for teaching, research and healthcare management, besides joint continuing veterinary education programmes, workshops and conferences in areas of mutual interest

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (KVASU) at Pookode in Wayanad has signed a five-year Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with UAE-based Gulf Medical University (GMU) to promote collaboration in veterinary education and research through its Thumbay College of Veterinary Medicine (TCVM). The agreement envisages student and faculty exchanges, clinical training, internships, veterinary shadowing programmes and summer elective placements. Students from both institutions will have opportunities to undergo clinical training and internships at their respective clinics and hospitals, subject to institutional capacity and academic requirements. The two institutions will also explore collaborative research programmes through the Thumbay Research Institute for Precision Medicine. The MoU provides for faculty exchanges for teaching, research and healthcare management, besides joint continuing veterinary education programmes, workshops and conferences in areas of mutual interest. Another component of the agreement is the possibility of KVASU faculty members who meet GMU’s eligibility criteria being granted adjunct faculty status at TCVM. Such appointments will be formalised through separate agreements. The collaboration will be guided by the One Health approach, which recognises the interconnected health of humans, animals and ecosystems. A coordination committee comprising one representative from each institution will be constituted to oversee the collaboration. The committee would submit reports on joint activities every six months. The MoU was signed by Dr. Manda Venkataramana, Chancellor of GMU, and Dr. Sabin George, Registrar of KVASU.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Officials said the MoU would remain in force for five years and might be renewed following a review of the mutual benefits. It does not entail any immediate financial commitment for either institution. The academic and financial implications of individual programmes will be determined through separate agreements.

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 KVASU signs MoU with UAE university for veterinary education, research

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 03:30:48 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The MoU provides for faculty exchanges for teaching, research and healthcare management, besides joint continuing veterinary education programmes, workshops and conferences in areas of mutual interest

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (KVASU) at Pookode in Wayanad has signed a five-year Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with UAE-based Gulf Medical University (GMU) to promote collaboration in veterinary education and research through its Thumbay College of Veterinary Medicine (TCVM). The agreement envisages student and faculty exchanges, clinical training, internships, veterinary shadowing programmes and summer elective placements. Students from both institutions will have opportunities to undergo clinical training and internships at their respective clinics and hospitals, subject to institutional capacity and academic requirements. The two institutions will also explore collaborative research programmes through the Thumbay Research Institute for Precision Medicine. The MoU provides for faculty exchanges for teaching, research and healthcare management, besides joint continuing veterinary education programmes, workshops and conferences in areas of mutual interest. Another component of the agreement is the possibility of KVASU faculty members who meet GMU’s eligibility criteria being granted adjunct faculty status at TCVM. Such appointments will be formalised through separate agreements. The collaboration will be guided by the One Health approach, which recognises the interconnected health of humans, animals and ecosystems. A coordination committee comprising one representative from each institution will be constituted to oversee the collaboration. The committee would submit reports on joint activities every six months. The MoU was signed by Dr. Manda Venkataramana, Chancellor of GMU, and Dr. Sabin George, Registrar of KVASU.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Officials said the MoU would remain in force for five years and might be renewed following a review of the mutual benefits. It does not entail any immediate financial commitment for either institution. The academic and financial implications of individual programmes will be determined through separate agreements.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Representative (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Representative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Collaboration (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Collaboration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "KVASU signs MoU with UAE university for veterinary education, research", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The MoU provides for faculty exchanges for teaching, research and healthcare management, besides joint continuing veterinary education programmes,...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'KVASU signs MoU with UAE university for veterina' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'KVASU signs MoU with UAE university for veter' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'KVASU signs MoU with UAE university for veter' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The MoU provides for faculty exchanges for teaching, research and healthcare management, besides joint continuing veterinary education programmes,..."
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "KVASU signs MoU with UAE university for veterinary education, research"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The academic and financial implications of individual programmes will be determined through separate agreements.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The academic and financial implications of individual programmes will be determined through separate agreements."

articles.title: Avian influenza confirmed in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore; over 1,500 chickens culled
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: On November 5, a carcass sample was despatched to NIHSAD Bhopal, which confirmed H5N1 on November 13

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (H5N1) has been confirmed in chicken samples collected from a poultry farm at Kattiyankuppam village in Kurinjipadi taluk of Cuddalore district. “The National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD), Bhopal, had confirmed the H5N1 avian influenza virus in samples collected from a poultry carcass on November 5, 2026,” District Collector Sibi Adhithya Senthil Kumar told The Hindu . The confirmation has triggered a full-scale containment operation, with the Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services Department culling all birds in the affected farm and within a one-kilometre radius of the epicentre. According to Mr. Senthil Kumar: “As many as 35,647 bird deaths were recorded in the affected belt till November 13, since the first case of sudden mortality was reported from a farm at Thamanampatti village in Thiyagavalli Panchayat on October 30.” He added, “Veterinary teams that visited the farm on the day of the first report collected samples and sent them to the Poultry Disease Diagnostic Laboratory (PDDL) in Namakkal.” As deaths mounted in neighbouring farms, further samples were routed to Poultry Disease Diagnosis and Surveillance Laboratory (PDDL) Erode and the Central University Laboratory (CUL) at Madhavaram in Chennai. On November 5, a carcass sample was despatched to NIHSAD Bhopal, which confirmed H5N1 on November 13, he said. Following the standard operating procedure under the National Action Plan, the district was divided into compartments to restrict the spread of the disease. “Initially, we sent only one sample. But a total of 15 farms are affected, of which all the birds in 10 farms have already been wiped out. So only five farms remain, and we are going to cull all [the birds] anyway. As many as nine Rapid Response Teams have been deployed for this purpose,” the Collector said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: So far, 1,550 birds have been humanely culled, and the department is working to cull 100% of the birds in the epicentre farm and within the 1-km radius, in accordance with the Government of India guidelines, 2021.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Avian influenza confirmed in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore; over 1,500 chickens culled

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 03:29:03 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: On November 5, a carcass sample was despatched to NIHSAD Bhopal, which confirmed H5N1 on November 13

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (H5N1) has been confirmed in chicken samples collected from a poultry farm at Kattiyankuppam village in Kurinjipadi taluk of Cuddalore district. “The National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD), Bhopal, had confirmed the H5N1 avian influenza virus in samples collected from a poultry carcass on November 5, 2026,” District Collector Sibi Adhithya Senthil Kumar told The Hindu . The confirmation has triggered a full-scale containment operation, with the Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services Department culling all birds in the affected farm and within a one-kilometre radius of the epicentre. According to Mr. Senthil Kumar: “As many as 35,647 bird deaths were recorded in the affected belt till November 13, since the first case of sudden mortality was reported from a farm at Thamanampatti village in Thiyagavalli Panchayat on October 30.” He added, “Veterinary teams that visited the farm on the day of the first report collected samples and sent them to the Poultry Disease Diagnostic Laboratory (PDDL) in Namakkal.” As deaths mounted in neighbouring farms, further samples were routed to Poultry Disease Diagnosis and Surveillance Laboratory (PDDL) Erode and the Central University Laboratory (CUL) at Madhavaram in Chennai. On November 5, a carcass sample was despatched to NIHSAD Bhopal, which confirmed H5N1 on November 13, he said. Following the standard operating procedure under the National Action Plan, the district was divided into compartments to restrict the spread of the disease. “Initially, we sent only one sample. But a total of 15 farms are affected, of which all the birds in 10 farms have already been wiped out. So only five farms remain, and we are going to cull all [the birds] anyway. As many as nine Rapid Response Teams have been deployed for this purpose,” the Collector said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: So far, 1,550 birds have been humanely culled, and the department is working to cull 100% of the birds in the epicentre farm and within the 1-km radius, in accordance with the Government of India guidelines, 2021.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Confirmation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Confirmation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Surveillance (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Surveillance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Containment (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Containment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Avian influenza confirmed in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore; over 1,500 chickens culled", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. On November 5, a carcass sample was despatched to NIHSAD Bhopal, which confirmed H5N1 on November 13.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Avian influenza confirmed in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddal' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Avian influenza confirmed in Tamil Nadu’s Cud' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Avian influenza confirmed in Tamil Nadu’s Cud' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "On November 5, a carcass sample was despatched to NIHSAD Bhopal, which confirmed H5N1 on November 13."
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Avian influenza confirmed in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore; over 1,500 chickens culled"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. So far, 1,550 birds have been humanely culled, and the department is working to cull 100% of the birds in the epicentre farm and within the 1-km...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "So far, 1,550 birds have been humanely culled, and the department is working to cull 100% of the birds in the epicentre farm and within the 1-km..."

articles.title: Karnataka Deputy CM Parameshwara writes to Modi, Shah seeking inclusion of State’s SC/ST reservation law in Ninth Schedule on the lines of Tamil Nadu
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent, Mr. Parameshwara said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and a constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara has urged the Union government to initiate a constitutional amendment to include Karnataka’s Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation) Act, 2022 , in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution to protect the enhanced reservation provided to the two communities. Karnataka to explore legal options to challenge High Court verdict striking down reservation enhancement In letters dated November 12 to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment Virendra Kumar, Mr. Parameshwara sought urgent intervention and a time-bound decision on the State’s proposal. The appeal follows the Karnataka High Court’s judgment striking down the enhanced reservation of 17% for SCs and 7% for STs, taking the total reservation in education and public employment to 56%. Karnataka has since filed a Special Leave Petition before the Supreme Court. In a post on X, Dr. Parameshwara said constitutional protection for the enhanced reservation was essential following the High Court judgment. Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent — brought under the Ninth Schedule through the 76th Constitutional Amendment in 1994 — he said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and urged the Centre to initiate the necessary constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities. I have written to Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi, Union Home Minister Shri @AmitShah and Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment @Drvirendrakum13 , urging their immediate intervention to include Karnataka's SC/ST Reservation Act, 2022, in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution. Following the recent High Court judgment, it is essential to secure constitutional protection for the enhanced reservation of 17% for Scheduled Castes and 7% for Scheduled Tribes. Tamil Nadu's 69% reservation framework provides a clear precedent. Karnataka deserves equal consideration. I have urged the Union Government to initiate the necessary constitutional amendment and take a time-bound decision to safeguard the rights and opportunities of our SC/ST communities. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.15ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.3ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಜಾರಿಗೊಳಿಸಲಾದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ (ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸೇವೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೇಮಕಾತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಹುದ್ದೆಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ) ಕಾಯ್ದೆ, 2022 ಅನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುವಂತೆ ಕೋರಿ ಗೌರವಾನ್ವಿತ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿ, ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಹೈಕೋರ್ಟ್ 2026ರ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 12ರಂದು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳದ ನಿಬಂಧನೆಗಳನ್ನು ರದ್ದುಗೊಳಿಸಿದೆ. ಈ ತೀರ್ಪಿನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸುಪ್ರೀಂ ಕೋರ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲ್ಮನವಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದೆ. 1994ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 76ನೇ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಅದೇ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಶೇ.17 ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.7ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬೇಕು. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರವು 2023ರ ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 23ರಂದೇ ಈ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿತ್ತು. 2025ರ ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್ 18ರಂದು ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ನಿರ್ಣಯ ಅಂಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ನಿಕಟಪೂರ್ವ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಸಿದ್ದರಾಮಯ್ಯ ಅವರು 2026ರ ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 16ರಂದು ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದು ಇದೇ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪುನರುಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದ್ದರು. ಈ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮಧ್ಯಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ಕೋರಿ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೇನೆ. 1. ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕು. 2. ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಾದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಮಸೂದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಸತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂಡಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ತುರ್ತಾಗಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಬೇಕು. 3. ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಆಯೋಗ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಆಯೋಗಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಿ, ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಗುರುತಿಸಿರುವ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಹರಿಸಲು ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. 4. ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕಾನೂನು ಮತ್ತು ನ್ಯಾಯ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ ಹಾಗೂ ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯಗಳು ಸಮನ್ವಯದಿಂದ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿ, ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. 5. ದೇಶದ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವಾಸ್ತವಗಳು, ವಿವಿಧ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಅನುಭವಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಸಮಾನತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಶೇ.50ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಮಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅನ್ವಯದ ಕುರಿತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಕ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಬೇಕು. ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಿರುವಂತೆ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.24ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ದೊರೆಯಬೇಕೆಂಬುದು ನಮ್ಮ ಆಗ್ರಹವಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ವಿಚಾರವು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಪಕ್ಷಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಡಾ. ಬಿ.ಆರ್. ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಅವರ ಆಶಯದಂತೆ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕವಾಗಿ ಅವಕಾಶವಂಚಿತರಾದ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವುದು ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರ ಭವಿಷ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಈ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಚಾರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗಿನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಕೈಗೊಂಡು ಅಗತ್ಯ ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಜರುಗಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಮನವಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ. The enhanced reservation was recommended by a commission headed by retired Karnataka High Court judge H.N. Nagamohan Das. The State subsequently enacted the Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions and of Appointments or Posts in the Services under the State) Act, 2022. The legislation received the Governor’s assent on January 11, 2023, and came into effect retrospectively from November 1, 2022, the letter stated. The State had submitted its proposal to the Union Government on March 23, 2023 , seeking inclusion of the legislation in the Ninth Schedule. The Legislative Assembly also passed a resolution on December 18, 2025, urging the Centre to provide constitutional protection to the enhanced reservation. The Union Government had acknowledged the receipt of Karnataka’s proposal in a written reply in the Lok Sabha on July 25, 2026, but said inclusion in the Ninth Schedule was not considered appropriate at that stage as the matter was pending before the High Court.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Parameshwara has also called for consultations with the National Commissions for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes to address the constitutional and procedural issues concerning the legislation. He has sought coordinated action by the Ministries of Law and Justice, Social Justice and Empowerment, Tribal Affairs, and Home Affairs to expedite the matter.

hinglishTracks.en: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.15ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.3ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಜಾರಿಗೊಳಿಸಲಾದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ (ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸೇವೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೇಮಕಾತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಹುದ್ದೆಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ) ಕಾಯ್ದೆ, 2022 ಅನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುವಂತೆ ಕೋರಿ ಗೌರವಾನ್ವಿತ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿ, ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಅಮಿತ್‌ ಶಾ ಹಾಗೂ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಡಾ.ವೀರೇಂದ್ರ ಕುಮಾರ್‌ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದೇನೆ.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.15ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.3ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಜಾರಿಗೊಳಿಸಲಾದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ (ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸೇವೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೇಮಕಾತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಹುದ್ದೆಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ) ಕಾಯ್ದೆ, 2022 ಅನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುವಂತೆ ಕೋರಿ ಗೌರವಾನ್ವಿತ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿ, ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಅಮಿತ್‌ ಶಾ ಹಾಗೂ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಡಾ.ವೀರೇಂದ್ರ ಕುಮಾರ್‌ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದೇನೆ.।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ಸುಮಾರು ಏಳು ದಶಕಗಳಿಂದ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಬದಲಾಗದೆ ಉಳಿದಿತ್ತು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಈ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದಿರುವಿಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ನ್ಯಾಯಮೂರ್ತಿ ಎಚ್.ಎನ್.
