hinglishTracks.en: ನಾಗಮೋಹನ್ ದಾಸ್ ಆಯೋಗದ ಶಿಫಾರಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ನಾಗಮೋಹನ್ ದಾಸ್ ಆಯೋಗದ ಶಿಫಾರಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಈ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದೂ ಆಯೋಗ ಶಿಫಾರಸು ಮಾಡಿತ್ತು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ಈ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದೂ ಆಯೋಗ ಶಿಫಾರಸು ಮಾಡಿತ್ತು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಆದರೆ, ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಶೇ.56ಕ್ಕೆ ಏರಿಕೆಯಾಗಿರುವುದು ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಲಾದ ಶೇ.50ರ ಮಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಮೀರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬ ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಹೈಕೋರ್ಟ್ 2026ರ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 12ರಂದು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳದ ನಿಬಂಧನೆಗಳನ್ನು ರದ್ದುಗೊಳಿಸಿದೆ.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ಆದರೆ, ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಶೇ.56ಕ್ಕೆ ಏರಿಕೆಯಾಗಿರುವುದು ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಲಾದ ಶೇ.50ರ ಮಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಮೀರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬ ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಹೈಕೋರ್ಟ್ 2026ರ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 12ರಂದು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳದ ನಿಬಂಧನೆಗಳನ್ನು ರದ್ದುಗೊಳಿಸಿದೆ.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಈ ತೀರ್ಪಿನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸುಪ್ರೀಂ ಕೋರ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲ್ಮನವಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದೆ.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ಈ ತೀರ್ಪಿನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸುಪ್ರೀಂ ಕೋರ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲ್ಮನವಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದೆ.।

hinglishTracks.en: 1994ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 76ನೇ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — 1994ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 76ನೇ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಅದೇ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಶೇ.17 ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.7ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬೇಕು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ಅದೇ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಶೇ.17 ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.7ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬೇಕು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರವು 2023ರ ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 23ರಂದೇ ಈ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿತ್ತು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರವು 2023ರ ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 23ರಂದೇ ಈ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿತ್ತು.।

hinglishTracks.en: 2025ರ ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್ 18ರಂದು ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ನಿರ್ಣಯ ಅಂಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 2025ರ ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್ 18ರಂದು ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ನಿರ್ಣಯ ಅಂಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ನಿಕಟಪೂರ್ವ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಸಿದ್ದರಾಮಯ್ಯ ಅವರು 2026ರ ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 16ರಂದು ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದು ಇದೇ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪುನರುಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದ್ದರು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ನಿಕಟಪೂರ್ವ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಸಿದ್ದರಾಮಯ್ಯ ಅವರು 2026ರ ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 16ರಂದು ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದು ಇದೇ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪುನರುಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದ್ದರು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಈ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮಧ್ಯಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ಕೋರಿ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೇನೆ.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ಈ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮಧ್ಯಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ಕೋರಿ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೇನೆ.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಾದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಮಸೂದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಸತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂಡಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ತುರ್ತಾಗಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಬೇಕು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಾದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಮಸೂದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಸತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂಡಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ತುರ್ತಾಗಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಬೇಕು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಆಯೋಗ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಆಯೋಗಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಿ, ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಗುರುತಿಸಿರುವ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಹರಿಸಲು ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಆಯೋಗ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಆಯೋಗಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಿ, ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಗುರುತಿಸಿರುವ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಹರಿಸಲು ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕಾನೂನು ಮತ್ತು ನ್ಯಾಯ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ ಹಾಗೂ ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯಗಳು ಸಮನ್ವಯದಿಂದ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿ, ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕಾನೂನು ಮತ್ತು ನ್ಯಾಯ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ ಹಾಗೂ ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯಗಳು ಸಮನ್ವಯದಿಂದ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿ, ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ದೇಶದ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವಾಸ್ತವಗಳು, ವಿವಿಧ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಅನುಭವಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಸಮಾನತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಶೇ.50ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಮಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅನ್ವಯದ ಕುರಿತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಕ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಬೇಕು.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ದೇಶದ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವಾಸ್ತವಗಳು, ವಿವಿಧ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಅನುಭವಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಸಮಾನತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಶೇ.50ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಮಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅನ್ವಯದ ಕುರಿತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಕ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಬೇಕು.।

hinglishTracks.en: ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಿರುವಂತೆ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.24ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ದೊರೆಯಬೇಕೆಂಬುದು ನಮ್ಮ ಆಗ್ರಹವಾಗಿದೆ.

hinglishTracks.en: ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಡಾ.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಡಾ.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಅವರ ಆಶಯದಂತೆ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕವಾಗಿ ಅವಕಾಶವಂಚಿತರಾದ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವುದು ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಅವರ ಆಶಯದಂತೆ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕವಾಗಿ ಅವಕಾಶವಂಚಿತರಾದ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವುದು ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.।

hinglishTracks.en: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರ ಭವಿಷ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಈ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಚಾರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗಿನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಕೈಗೊಂಡು ಅಗತ್ಯ ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಜರುಗಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಮನವಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರ ಭವಿಷ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಈ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಚಾರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗಿನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಕೈಗೊಂಡು ಅಗತ್ಯ ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಜರುಗಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಮನವಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ.।

hinglishTracks.en: The enhanced reservation was recommended by a commission headed by retired Karnataka High Court judge H.N.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — The enhanced reservation was recommended by a commission headed by retired Karnataka High Court judge H.N.।

hinglishTracks.en: Nagamohan Das.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — Nagamohan Das.।

hinglishTracks.en: The State subsequently enacted the Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions and of Appointments or Posts in the Services under the State) Act, 2022.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — The State subsequently enacted the Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions and of Appointments or Posts in the Services under the State) Act, 2022.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: The legislation received the Governor’s assent on January 11, 2023, and came into effect retrospectively from November 1, 2022, the letter stated.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — The legislation received the Governor’s assent on January 11, 2023, and came into effect retrospectively from November 1, 2022, the letter stated.।

hinglishTracks.en: The State had submitted its proposal to the Union Government on March 23, 2023 , seeking inclusion of the legislation in the Ninth Schedule.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — The State had submitted its proposal to the Union Government on March 23, 2023 , seeking inclusion of the legislation in the Ninth Schedule.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

hinglishTracks.en: The Legislative Assembly also passed a resolution on December 18, 2025, urging the Centre to provide constitutional protection to the enhanced reservation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — The Legislative Assembly also passed a resolution on December 18, 2025, urging the Centre to provide constitutional protection to the enhanced reservation.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: The Union Government had acknowledged the receipt of Karnataka’s proposal in a written reply in the Lok Sabha on July 25, 2026, but said inclusion in the Ninth Schedule was not considered appropriate at that stage as the matter was pending before the High Court.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — The Union Government had acknowledged the receipt of Karnataka’s proposal in a written reply in the Lok Sabha on July 25, 2026, but said inclusion in the Ninth Schedule was not considered appropriate at that stage as the matter was pending before the High Court.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

hinglishTracks.en: Parameshwara has also called for consultations with the National Commissions for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes to address the constitutional and procedural issues concerning the legislation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — Parameshwara has also called for consultations with the National Commissions for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes to address the constitutional and procedural issues concerning the legislation.। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: He has sought coordinated action by the Ministries of Law and Justice, Social Justice and Empowerment, Tribal Affairs, and Home Affairs to expedite the matter.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — He has sought coordinated action by the Ministries of Law and Justice, Social Justice and Empowerment, Tribal Affairs, and Home Affairs to expedite the matter.।

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Karnataka Deputy CM Parameshwara writes to Modi, Shah seeking inclusion of State’s SC/ST reservation law in Ninth Schedule on the lines of Tamil Nadu

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 03:27:13 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent, Mr. Parameshwara said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and a constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara has urged the Union government to initiate a constitutional amendment to include Karnataka’s Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation) Act, 2022 , in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution to protect the enhanced reservation provided to the two communities. Karnataka to explore legal options to challenge High Court verdict striking down reservation enhancement In letters dated November 12 to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment Virendra Kumar, Mr. Parameshwara sought urgent intervention and a time-bound decision on the State’s proposal. The appeal follows the Karnataka High Court’s judgment striking down the enhanced reservation of 17% for SCs and 7% for STs, taking the total reservation in education and public employment to 56%. Karnataka has since filed a Special Leave Petition before the Supreme Court. In a post on X, Dr. Parameshwara said constitutional protection for the enhanced reservation was essential following the High Court judgment. Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent — brought under the Ninth Schedule through the 76th Constitutional Amendment in 1994 — he said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and urged the Centre to initiate the necessary constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities. I have written to Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi, Union Home Minister Shri @AmitShah and Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment @Drvirendrakum13 , urging their immediate intervention to include Karnataka's SC/ST Reservation Act, 2022, in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution. Following the recent High Court judgment, it is essential to secure constitutional protection for the enhanced reservation of 17% for Scheduled Castes and 7% for Scheduled Tribes. Tamil Nadu's 69% reservation framework provides a clear precedent. Karnataka deserves equal consideration. I have urged the Union Government to initiate the necessary constitutional amendment and take a time-bound decision to safeguard the rights and opportunities of our SC/ST communities. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.15ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.3ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಜಾರಿಗೊಳಿಸಲಾದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ (ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸೇವೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೇಮಕಾತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಹುದ್ದೆಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ) ಕಾಯ್ದೆ, 2022 ಅನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುವಂತೆ ಕೋರಿ ಗೌರವಾನ್ವಿತ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿ, ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಅಮಿತ್‌ ಶಾ ಹಾಗೂ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಡಾ.ವೀರೇಂದ್ರ ಕುಮಾರ್‌ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ಸುಮಾರು ಏಳು ದಶಕಗಳಿಂದ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಬದಲಾಗದೆ ಉಳಿದಿತ್ತು. ಈ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದಿರುವಿಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ನ್ಯಾಯಮೂರ್ತಿ ಎಚ್.ಎನ್. ನಾಗಮೋಹನ್ ದಾಸ್ ಆಯೋಗದ ಶಿಫಾರಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಈ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದೂ ಆಯೋಗ ಶಿಫಾರಸು ಮಾಡಿತ್ತು. ಆದರೆ, ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಶೇ.56ಕ್ಕೆ ಏರಿಕೆಯಾಗಿರುವುದು ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಲಾದ ಶೇ.50ರ ಮಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಮೀರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬ ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಹೈಕೋರ್ಟ್ 2026ರ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 12ರಂದು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳದ ನಿಬಂಧನೆಗಳನ್ನು ರದ್ದುಗೊಳಿಸಿದೆ. ಈ ತೀರ್ಪಿನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸುಪ್ರೀಂ ಕೋರ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲ್ಮನವಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದೆ. 1994ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 76ನೇ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಅದೇ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಶೇ.17 ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.7ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬೇಕು. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರವು 2023ರ ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 23ರಂದೇ ಈ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿತ್ತು. 2025ರ ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್ 18ರಂದು ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ನಿರ್ಣಯ ಅಂಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ನಿಕಟಪೂರ್ವ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಸಿದ್ದರಾಮಯ್ಯ ಅವರು 2026ರ ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 16ರಂದು ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದು ಇದೇ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪುನರುಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದ್ದರು. ಈ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮಧ್ಯಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ಕೋರಿ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೇನೆ. 1. ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕು. 2. ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಾದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಮಸೂದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಸತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂಡಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ತುರ್ತಾಗಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಬೇಕು. 3. ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಆಯೋಗ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಆಯೋಗಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಿ, ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಗುರುತಿಸಿರುವ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಹರಿಸಲು ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. 4. ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕಾನೂನು ಮತ್ತು ನ್ಯಾಯ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ ಹಾಗೂ ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯಗಳು ಸಮನ್ವಯದಿಂದ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿ, ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. 5. ದೇಶದ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವಾಸ್ತವಗಳು, ವಿವಿಧ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಅನುಭವಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಸಮಾನತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಶೇ.50ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಮಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅನ್ವಯದ ಕುರಿತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಕ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಬೇಕು. ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಿರುವಂತೆ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.24ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ದೊರೆಯಬೇಕೆಂಬುದು ನಮ್ಮ ಆಗ್ರಹವಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ವಿಚಾರವು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಪಕ್ಷಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಡಾ. ಬಿ.ಆರ್. ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಅವರ ಆಶಯದಂತೆ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕವಾಗಿ ಅವಕಾಶವಂಚಿತರಾದ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವುದು ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರ ಭವಿಷ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಈ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಚಾರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗಿನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಕೈಗೊಂಡು ಅಗತ್ಯ ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಜರುಗಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಮನವಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ. The enhanced reservation was recommended by a commission headed by retired Karnataka High Court judge H.N. Nagamohan Das. The State subsequently enacted the Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions and of Appointments or Posts in the Services under the State) Act, 2022. The legislation received the Governor’s assent on January 11, 2023, and came into effect retrospectively from November 1, 2022, the letter stated. The State had submitted its proposal to the Union Government on March 23, 2023 , seeking inclusion of the legislation in the Ninth Schedule. The Legislative Assembly also passed a resolution on December 18, 2025, urging the Centre to provide constitutional protection to the enhanced reservation. The Union Government had acknowledged the receipt of Karnataka’s proposal in a written reply in the Lok Sabha on July 25, 2026, but said inclusion in the Ninth Schedule was not considered appropriate at that stage as the matter was pending before the High Court.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Parameshwara has also called for consultations with the National Commissions for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes to address the constitutional and procedural issues concerning the legislation. He has sought coordinated action by the Ministries of Law and Justice, Social Justice and Empowerment, Tribal Affairs, and Home Affairs to expedite the matter.

• 1. Core Context & Background: Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent, Mr. Parameshwara said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and a constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara has urged the Union government to initiate a constitutional amendment to include Karnataka’s Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation) Act, 2022 , in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution to protect the enhanced reservation provided to the two communities. Karnataka to explore legal options to challenge High Court verdict striking down reservation enhancement In letters dated November 12 to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment Virendra Kumar, Mr. Parameshwara sought urgent intervention and a time-bound decision on the State’s proposal. The appeal follows the Karnataka High Court’s judgment striking down the enhanced reservation of 17% for SCs and 7% for STs, taking the total reservation in education and public employment to 56%. Karnataka has since filed a Special Leave Petition before the Supreme Court. In a post on X, Dr. Parameshwara said constitutional protection for the enhanced reservation was essential following the High Court judgment. Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent — brought under the Ninth Schedule through the 76th Constitutional Amendment in 1994 — he said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and urged the Centre to initiate the necessary constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities. I have written to Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi, Union Home Minister Shri @AmitShah and Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment @Drvirendrakum13 , urging their immediate intervention to include Karnataka's SC/ST Reservation Act, 2022, in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution. Following the recent High Court judgment, it is essential to secure constitutional protection for the enhanced reservation of 17% for Scheduled Castes and 7% for Scheduled Tribes. Tamil Nadu's 69% reservation framework provides a clear precedent. Karnataka deserves equal consideration. I have urged the Union Government to initiate the necessary constitutional amendment and take a time-bound decision to safeguard the rights and opportunities of our SC/ST communities. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.15ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.3ರಿಂದ ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಜಾರಿಗೊಳಿಸಲಾದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ (ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸೇವೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೇಮಕಾತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಹುದ್ದೆಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ) ಕಾಯ್ದೆ, 2022 ಅನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುವಂತೆ ಕೋರಿ ಗೌರವಾನ್ವಿತ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿ, ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಅಮಿತ್‌ ಶಾ ಹಾಗೂ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಡಾ.ವೀರೇಂದ್ರ ಕುಮಾರ್‌ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ಸುಮಾರು ಏಳು ದಶಕಗಳಿಂದ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಬದಲಾಗದೆ ಉಳಿದಿತ್ತು. ಈ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದಿರುವಿಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ನ್ಯಾಯಮೂರ್ತಿ ಎಚ್.ಎನ್. ನಾಗಮೋಹನ್ ದಾಸ್ ಆಯೋಗದ ಶಿಫಾರಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಈ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಅದೇ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಶೇ.17 ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.7ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬೇಕು. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರವು 2023ರ ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 23ರಂದೇ ಈ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿತ್ತು. 2025ರ ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್ 18ರಂದು ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ನಿರ್ಣಯ ಅಂಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ನಿಕಟಪೂರ್ವ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಸಿದ್ದರಾಮಯ್ಯ ಅವರು 2026ರ ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 16ರಂದು ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದು ಇದೇ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪುನರುಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದ್ದರು. ಈ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮಧ್ಯಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ಕೋರಿ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೇನೆ. 1. ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.17ಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಶೇ.7ಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 9ನೇ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕು. 2. ಕಾಯ್ದೆಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಾದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಮಸೂದೆಯನ್ನು ಸಂಸತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂಡಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ತುರ್ತಾಗಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಬೇಕು. 3. ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಆಯೋಗ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಆಯೋಗಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಿ, ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಗುರುತಿಸಿರುವ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಹರಿಸಲು ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. 4. ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕಾನೂನು ಮತ್ತು ನ್ಯಾಯ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ ಹಾಗೂ ಗೃಹ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯಗಳು ಸಮನ್ವಯದಿಂದ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿ, ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. 5. ದೇಶದ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವಾಸ್ತವಗಳು, ವಿವಿಧ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಅನುಭವಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಸಮಾನತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಶೇ.50ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಮಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅನ್ವಯದ ಕುರಿತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಕ ಸಮಾಲೋಚನೆ ನಡೆಸಬೇಕು. ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಶೇ.69ರ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಒದಗಿಸಿರುವಂತೆ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಶೇ.56ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಯ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಶೇ.24ರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೀಸಲಾತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ದೊರೆಯಬೇಕೆಂಬುದು ನಮ್ಮ ಆಗ್ರಹವಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯದ ವಿಚಾರವು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಪಕ್ಷಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಡಾ. ಬಿ.ಆರ್. ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಅವರ ಆಶಯದಂತೆ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕವಾಗಿ ಅವಕಾಶವಂಚಿತರಾದ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವುದು ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡಗಳ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರ ಭವಿಷ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಈ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವಿಚಾರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆ ಕುರಿತು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಾಲಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗಿನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಕೈಗೊಂಡು ಅಗತ್ಯ ಶಾಸನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಜರುಗಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಮನವಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ. The enhanced reservation was recommended by a commission headed by retired Karnataka High Court judge H.N. Nagamohan Das. The State subsequently enacted the Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions and of Appointments or Posts in the Services under the State) Act, 2022. The legislation received the Governor’s assent on January 11, 2023, and came into effect retrospectively from November 1, 2022, the letter stated. The State had submitted its proposal to the Union Government on March 23, 2023 , seeking inclusion of the legislation in the Ninth Schedule. The Legislative Assembly also passed a resolution on December 18, 2025, urging the Centre to provide constitutional protection to the enhanced reservation. The Union Government had acknowledged the receipt of Karnataka’s proposal in a written reply in the Lok Sabha on July 25, 2026, but said inclusion in the Ninth Schedule was not considered appropriate at that stage as the matter was pending before the High Court.

articles.title: Keralam Government to buy new vehicles for Ministers and Chief Secretary
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The General Administration Department has issued orders for the purchase of 24 Toyota Innova Hycross ZX(O) Strong Hybrid vehicles which include 22 for the use of the Ministers and Chief Secretary Bishwananth Sinha and two for the use of State guests

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The State Government has decided to purchase 24 new cars for the official use of the Ministers and the Chief Secretary on the grounds that the existing vehicles have “considerably deteriorated in their mechanical condition due to prolonged use.” The General Administration Department has issued orders for the purchase of 24 Toyota Innova Hycross (ZX(O) Strong Hybrid) vehicles which include 22 for the use of the Ministers and Chief Secretary Bishwananth Sinha and two for the use of State guests. The procurement is estimated to cost ₹9.60 crore, but the actual expenditure would be determined based on the prevailing rates and applicable charges at the time of procurement, the GAD order noted. The decision has sparked a debate as Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan, on taking charge in May this year, had decided to use a car that was already in use, saying that the Government would forego unnecessary expenditure amid financial stress. He had also decided to do away with the Chief Minister’s motorcade. In September, the Minister for Local Bodies K. M. Shaji’s decision to use a luxury sports utility vehicle, purportedly borrowed from a businessperson friend of his, as his official vehicle had courted controversy. According to the November 12 order, the Tourism Department has been entrusted with the task of procuring the vehicles. The vehicles presently being used by most of the Ministers for official purposes have become old and have considerably deteriorated in their mechanical condition due to prolonged use, the GAD order noted. “They require frequent repairs and maintenance, resulting in increased expenditure and affecting their reliability and availability for official duties. The need for suitable and well-maintained vehicles for the Ministers to attend official engagements, meetings, field visits and various government functions also necessitates the periodic replacement of the existing vehicles,” it said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Vehicles presently available with the government for protocol purposes are also inadequate to meet the growing requirements arising from the visits of VIPs, foreign dignitaries and other distinguished guests to the State, the Department noted.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Keralam Government to buy new vehicles for Ministers and Chief Secretary

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 03:17:04 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The General Administration Department has issued orders for the purchase of 24 Toyota Innova Hycross ZX(O) Strong Hybrid vehicles which include 22 for the use of the Ministers and Chief Secretary Bishwananth Sinha and two for the use of State guests

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The State Government has decided to purchase 24 new cars for the official use of the Ministers and the Chief Secretary on the grounds that the existing vehicles have “considerably deteriorated in their mechanical condition due to prolonged use.” The General Administration Department has issued orders for the purchase of 24 Toyota Innova Hycross (ZX(O) Strong Hybrid) vehicles which include 22 for the use of the Ministers and Chief Secretary Bishwananth Sinha and two for the use of State guests. The procurement is estimated to cost ₹9.60 crore, but the actual expenditure would be determined based on the prevailing rates and applicable charges at the time of procurement, the GAD order noted. The decision has sparked a debate as Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan, on taking charge in May this year, had decided to use a car that was already in use, saying that the Government would forego unnecessary expenditure amid financial stress. He had also decided to do away with the Chief Minister’s motorcade. In September, the Minister for Local Bodies K. M. Shaji’s decision to use a luxury sports utility vehicle, purportedly borrowed from a businessperson friend of his, as his official vehicle had courted controversy. According to the November 12 order, the Tourism Department has been entrusted with the task of procuring the vehicles. The vehicles presently being used by most of the Ministers for official purposes have become old and have considerably deteriorated in their mechanical condition due to prolonged use, the GAD order noted. “They require frequent repairs and maintenance, resulting in increased expenditure and affecting their reliability and availability for official duties. The need for suitable and well-maintained vehicles for the Ministers to attend official engagements, meetings, field visits and various government functions also necessitates the periodic replacement of the existing vehicles,” it said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Vehicles presently available with the government for protocol purposes are also inadequate to meet the growing requirements arising from the visits of VIPs, foreign dignitaries and other distinguished guests to the State, the Department noted.

articles.title: From glory to gloom: Manchester United's fall leaves Keralam fans heartbroken
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Once a refuge from life’s hardships, Manchester United has become a test of endurance for its Keralam fans

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Glory Glory Manchester United, goes the iconic terrace anthem of English Premier League (EPL) giants Manchester United. These days, though, there is anything but glory about the once-mighty European powerhouse, which sits in the relegation zone this season, much to the dismay of its formidable fan base. For fans who have been put through the wringer, with the team managing only one win in 10 games and languishing 18th in the 20-team table, the sacking of manager Michael Carrick has come as the harbinger of yet another painful rebuilding process. Argentine Mauricio Pochettino, who previously coached the U.S. national team, has been appointed his successor. “There is nothing more painful in the world at present than being a Manchester United fan. It is frustrating to watch the club in action, with the players unable to string together even four decent passes,” laments former Indian international N.P. Pradeep, who nonetheless hopes the club will turn the corner at some point. Manchester United, one of the most popular football clubs in the world, has had 13 managers, including interim managers and caretakers, since the legendary Alex Ferguson retired in 2013 after guiding the club to its record 13th EPL title. The years since have been nightmarish for fans, barring a few bright moments, including a Europa League title and a couple of FA Cups. “This season has been really bad, with just one win. It is infuriating to watch the team play despite having a good squad, not to mention the trolls from rival fans. Hopefully, things will improve, as sometimes happens under a new manager,” observes another former Indian player, Mohammed Rafi. Naveen James, a legal professional and an ardent United fan, once went sleepless when Cristiano Ronaldo, the club legend, walked away during his second stint after criticising the way it was being run. Today, he claims to be ‘totally numb’ to the team’s state. “I was fortunate to watch seven blissful seasons under Sir Alex and will relish those memories for the rest of my life. Gone are the days when I lost sleep when United lost. I have become used to mediocrity and try to extract maximum positivity from the rare wins,” he says.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Narendar Bhat is as fanatical a United fan as they come, with Manchester United themes dominating his personal accessories. “Earlier, watching United was the biggest relief, helping me escape the hardships of life. But now it has become a torture. I still continue to watch the team’s games, but have resigned myself to the fact that another defeat is always just around the corner,” he bemoans.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 From glory to gloom: Manchester United's fall leaves Keralam fans heartbroken

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 03:06:42 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Once a refuge from life’s hardships, Manchester United has become a test of endurance for its Keralam fans

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Glory Glory Manchester United, goes the iconic terrace anthem of English Premier League (EPL) giants Manchester United. These days, though, there is anything but glory about the once-mighty European powerhouse, which sits in the relegation zone this season, much to the dismay of its formidable fan base. For fans who have been put through the wringer, with the team managing only one win in 10 games and languishing 18th in the 20-team table, the sacking of manager Michael Carrick has come as the harbinger of yet another painful rebuilding process. Argentine Mauricio Pochettino, who previously coached the U.S. national team, has been appointed his successor. “There is nothing more painful in the world at present than being a Manchester United fan. It is frustrating to watch the club in action, with the players unable to string together even four decent passes,” laments former Indian international N.P. Pradeep, who nonetheless hopes the club will turn the corner at some point. Manchester United, one of the most popular football clubs in the world, has had 13 managers, including interim managers and caretakers, since the legendary Alex Ferguson retired in 2013 after guiding the club to its record 13th EPL title. The years since have been nightmarish for fans, barring a few bright moments, including a Europa League title and a couple of FA Cups. “This season has been really bad, with just one win. It is infuriating to watch the team play despite having a good squad, not to mention the trolls from rival fans. Hopefully, things will improve, as sometimes happens under a new manager,” observes another former Indian player, Mohammed Rafi. Naveen James, a legal professional and an ardent United fan, once went sleepless when Cristiano Ronaldo, the club legend, walked away during his second stint after criticising the way it was being run. Today, he claims to be ‘totally numb’ to the team’s state. “I was fortunate to watch seven blissful seasons under Sir Alex and will relish those memories for the rest of my life. Gone are the days when I lost sleep when United lost. I have become used to mediocrity and try to extract maximum positivity from the rare wins,” he says.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Narendar Bhat is as fanatical a United fan as they come, with Manchester United themes dominating his personal accessories. “Earlier, watching United was the biggest relief, helping me escape the hardships of life. But now it has become a torture. I still continue to watch the team’s games, but have resigned myself to the fact that another defeat is always just around the corner,” he bemoans.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Professional' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Relegation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Mediocrity (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Mediocrity' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "From glory to gloom: Manchester United's fall leaves Keralam fans heartbroken", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Once a refuge from life’s hardships, Manchester United has become a test of endurance for its Keralam fans.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'From glory to gloom: Manchester United's fall le' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'From glory to gloom: Manchester United's fall' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'From glory to gloom: Manchester United's fall' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Once a refuge from life’s hardships, Manchester United has become a test of endurance for its Keralam fans."
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "From glory to gloom: Manchester United's fall leaves Keralam fans heartbroken"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. I still continue to watch the team’s games, but have resigned myself to the fact that another defeat is always just around the corner,” he bemoans.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "I still continue to watch the team’s games, but have resigned myself to the fact that another defeat is always just around the corner,” he bemoans."

articles.title: SC/ST quota enhancement: Karnataka recommends inclusion of law in 9th Schedule
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Chief Secretary Vandita Sharma has written to the Home Secretary, Government of India

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Karnataka government has recommended to the Centre to bring the new legislation enhancing reservation to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes under the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution. The inclusion of the law in the Ninth Schedule will fortify it against any legal challenge. The Cabinet in February decided to send the proposal to the Centre . Chief Secretary Vandita Sharma has written to the Home Secretary, Government of India, on the inclusion of The Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions and of Appointments or Posts in the Services Under the State) Act, 2022, that enhances reservation for SCs from 15% to 17% and for STs from 3% to 7%, in the Ninth Schedule. The legislation was passed in the winter session of the legislature in Belagavi in December last. The Congress had been attacking the government for not bringing the law under the Ninth Schedule to protect it from legal scrutiny and termed the government move an “eyewash” to attract SC/ST votes ahead of the Assembly elections. The State government’s move comes days ahead of the schedule of the Assembly elections being declared.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Karnataka / Reservation / Indian National Congress

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 SC/ST quota enhancement: Karnataka recommends inclusion of law in 9th Schedule

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 03:03:48 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Chief Secretary Vandita Sharma has written to the Home Secretary, Government of India

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Karnataka government has recommended to the Centre to bring the new legislation enhancing reservation to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes under the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution. The inclusion of the law in the Ninth Schedule will fortify it against any legal challenge. The Cabinet in February decided to send the proposal to the Centre . Chief Secretary Vandita Sharma has written to the Home Secretary, Government of India, on the inclusion of The Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions and of Appointments or Posts in the Services Under the State) Act, 2022, that enhances reservation for SCs from 15% to 17% and for STs from 3% to 7%, in the Ninth Schedule. The legislation was passed in the winter session of the legislature in Belagavi in December last. The Congress had been attacking the government for not bringing the law under the Ninth Schedule to protect it from legal scrutiny and termed the government move an “eyewash” to attract SC/ST votes ahead of the Assembly elections. The State government’s move comes days ahead of the schedule of the Assembly elections being declared.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Karnataka / Reservation / Indian National Congress

Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।

✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Inclusive (Adjective)
समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing  |  ✖ Ant: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow
Legislation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Legislation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

A. Chief Secretary Vandita Sharma has written to the Home Secretary, Government of India.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'SC/ST quota enhancement: Karnataka recommends in' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'SC/ST quota enhancement: Karnataka recommends' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'SC/ST quota enhancement: Karnataka recommends' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Chief Secretary Vandita Sharma has written to the Home Secretary, Government of India."
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "SC/ST quota enhancement: Karnataka recommends inclusion of law in 9th Schedule"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Karnataka / Reservation / Indian National Congress.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Karnataka / Reservation / Indian National Congress."

articles.title: South Sudan postpones first national elections until February
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The legislative and presidential elections had been scheduled for December 22, after already being delayed several times. The United Nations had warned that a vote could set off widespread conflict

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: South Sudan, the world’s newest country, on Saturday (November 14, 2026) postponed its first national elections from December to February amid growing ethnic and political battles. The legislative and presidential elections had been scheduled for December 22, after already being delayed several times. The United Nations had warned that a vote could set off widespread conflict. The electoral commission issued a new calendar on social media, giving a new voting date of February 11, with results to be announced four days later. Commission secretary general Ahon Malou Lueth confirmed the change to AFP but would not give a reason or other details. President Salva Kiir’s government forces and followers of detained former Vice President Riek Machar have been involved in escalating, deadly confrontations in recent months. Other ethnic tensions and cattle-rustling battles have also complicated the picture in one of the world’s poorest countries. South Sudan became independent from Sudan in 2011, but Mr. Kiir’s and Mr. Machar’s forces fought a civil war from 2013 to 2018 that killed at least 400,000 people. Mr. Machar has been under house arrest since March 2025, accused of “crimes against humanity”. The new election date was announced on the day that voter registration was due to start, with more than 3,100 centres set up across the country. Not all the necessary equipment had arrived at the centres, officials said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The UN Commission on Human Rights in South Sudan has issued several warnings about conditions in the country, including the displacement of tens of thousands of people, the deadly battles and the disruption of international humanitarian operations.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 South Sudan postpones first national elections until February

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 02:40:07 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The legislative and presidential elections had been scheduled for December 22, after already being delayed several times. The United Nations had warned that a vote could set off widespread conflict

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: South Sudan, the world’s newest country, on Saturday (November 14, 2026) postponed its first national elections from December to February amid growing ethnic and political battles. The legislative and presidential elections had been scheduled for December 22, after already being delayed several times. The United Nations had warned that a vote could set off widespread conflict. The electoral commission issued a new calendar on social media, giving a new voting date of February 11, with results to be announced four days later. Commission secretary general Ahon Malou Lueth confirmed the change to AFP but would not give a reason or other details. President Salva Kiir’s government forces and followers of detained former Vice President Riek Machar have been involved in escalating, deadly confrontations in recent months. Other ethnic tensions and cattle-rustling battles have also complicated the picture in one of the world’s poorest countries. South Sudan became independent from Sudan in 2011, but Mr. Kiir’s and Mr. Machar’s forces fought a civil war from 2013 to 2018 that killed at least 400,000 people. Mr. Machar has been under house arrest since March 2025, accused of “crimes against humanity”. The new election date was announced on the day that voter registration was due to start, with more than 3,100 centres set up across the country. Not all the necessary equipment had arrived at the centres, officials said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The UN Commission on Human Rights in South Sudan has issued several warnings about conditions in the country, including the displacement of tens of thousands of people, the deadly battles and the disruption of international humanitarian operations.

articles.title: Riots in France: How anti-Government protests spiralled out of control
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The French authorities’ heavy-handed response, including thousands of arrests, police beatings and curbs on marches, has added to the volatile mix of grievances fuelling an anti-Government groundswell that shows no sign of abating before next year’s presidential election

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Smashed windows and ransacked shops. Bloodied teenage protesters. A city hall on fire. Such scenes shocked France as rioting erupted last month during nationwide protests over high living costs and strained public services. Government officials have repeatedly blamed far-left radicals and “opportunistic delinquents,” who they say took advantage of mostly peaceful demonstrations ​to attack symbols of State authority and capitalism across France. But the authorities’ heavy-handed response, including thousands of arrests, police beatings and curbs on marches, has added to the volatile mix of grievances fuelling an anti-Government groundswell that shows no sign of abating before next year’s presidential election, Reuters found. Reuters journalists reviewed dozens of videos of the violence, attended ‌the court hearings of 26 people accused of taking part and interviewed over 50 Government officials, police officers, attorneys, protesters and witnesses to understand how a movement that began in September with small protests over conditions in State schools spiralled ​into some of the worst civil unrest in years. Police tactics have faced scrutiny since the start due to the life-changing injuries suffered by some young people, including blown-off hands and lost eyes. United Nations and other human rights experts have also raised concerns about ⁠the arrest of nearly 7,000 minors during sometimes-violent school blockades, which they said was disproportionate. Images of riot police baton-charging teenagers fanned support for the students from a diverse array of protesters, including parents, teachers, left-wing politicians and trade unionists, who joined their marches. “We have rights,” said Emilie Berthier de Grandry, 42, who has attended four demonstrations in Paris with her 15-year-old son, Aaron, dressed in an inflatable shark costume. “We’re not going to let ourselves be pushed around.” Nationwide demonstrations on October 17 also brought a resurgence of so-called yellow-vest protesters, an anti-establishment movement that faced off against President Emmanuel Macron’s Government in 2018-2019 over high fuel prices.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The violent outbursts were so intense that day that police lost control of ‌entire neighbourhoods to rioters and looters in France’s three largest cities: Paris, Marseille and Lyon. Every week since then, people have taken to the streets across France to voice their anger at police and the Government.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #20 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Riots in France: How anti-Government protests spiralled out of control

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 02:30:34 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The French authorities’ heavy-handed response, including thousands of arrests, police beatings and curbs on marches, has added to the volatile mix of grievances fuelling an anti-Government groundswell that shows no sign of abating before next year’s presidential election

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Smashed windows and ransacked shops. Bloodied teenage protesters. A city hall on fire. Such scenes shocked France as rioting erupted last month during nationwide protests over high living costs and strained public services. Government officials have repeatedly blamed far-left radicals and “opportunistic delinquents,” who they say took advantage of mostly peaceful demonstrations ​to attack symbols of State authority and capitalism across France. But the authorities’ heavy-handed response, including thousands of arrests, police beatings and curbs on marches, has added to the volatile mix of grievances fuelling an anti-Government groundswell that shows no sign of abating before next year’s presidential election, Reuters found. Reuters journalists reviewed dozens of videos of the violence, attended ‌the court hearings of 26 people accused of taking part and interviewed over 50 Government officials, police officers, attorneys, protesters and witnesses to understand how a movement that began in September with small protests over conditions in State schools spiralled ​into some of the worst civil unrest in years. Police tactics have faced scrutiny since the start due to the life-changing injuries suffered by some young people, including blown-off hands and lost eyes. United Nations and other human rights experts have also raised concerns about ⁠the arrest of nearly 7,000 minors during sometimes-violent school blockades, which they said was disproportionate. Images of riot police baton-charging teenagers fanned support for the students from a diverse array of protesters, including parents, teachers, left-wing politicians and trade unionists, who joined their marches. “We have rights,” said Emilie Berthier de Grandry, 42, who has attended four demonstrations in Paris with her 15-year-old son, Aaron, dressed in an inflatable shark costume. “We’re not going to let ourselves be pushed around.” Nationwide demonstrations on October 17 also brought a resurgence of so-called yellow-vest protesters, an anti-establishment movement that faced off against President Emmanuel Macron’s Government in 2018-2019 over high fuel prices.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The violent outbursts were so intense that day that police lost control of ‌entire neighbourhoods to rioters and looters in France’s three largest cities: Paris, Marseille and Lyon. Every week since then, people have taken to the streets across France to voice their anger at police and the Government.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Opportunistic' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Establishment (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Establishment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Presidential (Adjective)

articles.title: Microsoft Outage updates: Global outage ends after tech giant restores services across all affected systems
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: After nearly 24 hours of global outage, lasting from November 12 to November 14, Microsoft restores services across all platforms

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Microsoft reports consumer services fully recovered, ongoing recovery for Microsoft 365 enterprise services, and monitoring for potential further issues. Microsoft said efforts to address the underlying issue of the incident have been completed. It added that services to remaining impacted customers and regions have also been restored. Microsoft’s service health page showed all products became operational on Saturday. The page read “All products are operational” on Saturday morning, including Microsoft 365 (business or enterprise) and consumer products. Microsoft said it was “monitoring the backlog of email messages ‌accrued during this event” before considering the issue with ⁠the enterprise services resolved. “Due to ‌the severity of impact this incident caused, we’re monitoring for an extended period to ‌ensure no additional mitigative actions are required,” Microsoft said in ⁠an update on its ⁠service status page. Microsoft ⁠said ⁠on Friday its consumer products ‌services had fully recovered at 4:10 p.m. UTC ‌on Friday (1610 GMT), ‌while it was seeing some ⁠sustained recovery ‌for its Microsoft 365 enterprise services. The global disruption of multiple Microsoft services, which continued late into Friday, affected several Indian businesses’ internal communications and customer-facing operations. Microsoft outage disrupts global services, hitting Indian businesses, airlines, public sectors, with recovery underway and security advisories issued.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Microsoft said on Saturday that services across Teams, Outlook, Copilot and other applications had fully recovered, bringing an end to a massive global outage that disrupted online communication for businesses and government agencies for more than 24 hours.

📰 Microsoft Outage updates: Global outage ends after tech giant restores services across all affected systems

1. Core Context & Background: After nearly 24 hours of global outage, lasting from November 12 to November 14, Microsoft restores services across all platforms

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Microsoft reports consumer services fully recovered, ongoing recovery for Microsoft 365 enterprise services, and monitoring for potential further issues. Microsoft said efforts to address the underlying issue of the incident have been completed. It added that services to remaining impacted customers and regions have also been restored. Microsoft’s service health page showed all products became operational on Saturday. The page read “All products are operational” on Saturday morning, including Microsoft 365 (business or enterprise) and consumer products. Microsoft said it was “monitoring the backlog of email messages ‌accrued during this event” before considering the issue with ⁠the enterprise services resolved. “Due to ‌the severity of impact this incident caused, we’re monitoring for an extended period to ‌ensure no additional mitigative actions are required,” Microsoft said in ⁠an update on its ⁠service status page. Microsoft ⁠said ⁠on Friday its consumer products ‌services had fully recovered at 4:10 p.m. UTC ‌on Friday (1610 GMT), ‌while it was seeing some ⁠sustained recovery ‌for its Microsoft 365 enterprise services. The global disruption of multiple Microsoft services, which continued late into Friday, affected several Indian businesses’ internal communications and customer-facing operations. Microsoft outage disrupts global services, hitting Indian businesses, airlines, public sectors, with recovery underway and security advisories issued.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Microsoft said on Saturday that services across Teams, Outlook, Copilot and other applications had fully recovered, bringing an end to a massive global outage that disrupted online communication for businesses and government agencies for more than 24 hours.

articles.title: Samsung announces Google co-developed smart glasses pricing and sale details
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Equipped with a high-definition camera, open-ear speakers, and directional microphones, the eyewear helps users interact naturally with the world around them

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Samsung has officially unveiled its new lineup of intelligent eyewear , bringing hands-free artificial intelligence into everyday fashion. Developed in partnership with Google, Gentle Monster and Warby Parker, the smart glasses integrate Google’s Gemini AI directly into stylish frames built for daily wear. Set to launch on December 10, 2026, in the U.S. and South Korea, with pre-orders starting today, the collection features 30 distinct frame styles. Weighing around 41 grams, the frames combine Warby Parker’s classic look with Gentle Monster’s bold design aesthetics. The smart glasses run on Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 platform. Equipped with a 12 MP HD camera, open-ear speakers, and directional microphones, the eyewear helps users interact naturally with the world around them. Wearers can ask Gemini to identify objects and landmarks, translate menus instantly or follow step-by-step navigation via Google Maps. For workplace efficiency, the glasses can capture meeting whiteboards, generate key summaries and automatically sync them into Samsung Notes. The system also organises, summarises, and reads aloud incoming notifications. To address privacy concerns, the eyewear design includes visible recording lights and audio chimes whenever the camera captures images or video. Additionally, the software claims to automatically blur bystanders’ faces during visual queries, while open-ear speakers are tuned to limit sound leakage. The eyewear claims up to nine hours of battery life on a single charge, extending up to 72 hours with its charging case. The U.S. pricing starts at $395 for Warby Parker models, while Gentle Monster frames range from $449 to $489.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: technology (general) / gadgets (general) / accessories

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (14 NOV)

📰 Samsung announces Google co-developed smart glasses pricing and sale details

📌 Published: 14 Nov 2026, 01:49:28 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Equipped with a high-definition camera, open-ear speakers, and directional microphones, the eyewear helps users interact naturally with the world around them

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Samsung has officially unveiled its new lineup of intelligent eyewear , bringing hands-free artificial intelligence into everyday fashion. Developed in partnership with Google, Gentle Monster and Warby Parker, the smart glasses integrate Google’s Gemini AI directly into stylish frames built for daily wear. Set to launch on December 10, 2026, in the U.S. and South Korea, with pre-orders starting today, the collection features 30 distinct frame styles. Weighing around 41 grams, the frames combine Warby Parker’s classic look with Gentle Monster’s bold design aesthetics. The smart glasses run on Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 platform. Equipped with a 12 MP HD camera, open-ear speakers, and directional microphones, the eyewear helps users interact naturally with the world around them. Wearers can ask Gemini to identify objects and landmarks, translate menus instantly or follow step-by-step navigation via Google Maps. For workplace efficiency, the glasses can capture meeting whiteboards, generate key summaries and automatically sync them into Samsung Notes. The system also organises, summarises, and reads aloud incoming notifications. To address privacy concerns, the eyewear design includes visible recording lights and audio chimes whenever the camera captures images or video. Additionally, the software claims to automatically blur bystanders’ faces during visual queries, while open-ear speakers are tuned to limit sound leakage. The eyewear claims up to nine hours of battery life on a single charge, extending up to 72 hours with its charging case. The U.S. pricing starts at $395 for Warby Parker models, while Gentle Monster frames range from $449 to $489.

articles.title: In a dilemma: On Sheikh Hasina and India-Bangladesh ties
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India must improve ties with Bangladesh, and protect Hasina

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bangladesh’s former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina now in exile in India, has set off speculation about her imminent return to Dhaka by submitting an application for a new Bangladeshi passport and national identity card this week. The application, made through the Bangladesh High Commission in Delhi, was dismissed by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s Foreign Affairs Adviser Humayun Kabir, who said that the government in Dhaka would not grant a passport to a “terrorist”, and would seek her return via the extradition agreement as a “prisoner transfer process” with India. Ms. Hasina has already announced that she plans to return to Bangladesh in December this year, as she did after her previous stay in India in exile from 1975-1981, after the brutal assassination of her father Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and nearly every other member of her family. However, the situation is considerably different now. This time, Ms. Hasina came to India in 2024 fleeing mobs of protestors that overthrew her government, and has since been convicted by a tribunal for ordering a crackdown on thousands of students, and sentenced to death. In interviews, including to The Hindu , Ms. Hasina says she hopes to return to Bangladesh to argue her case and rebuild her party, the Awami League, but that is hardly likely, given the anger against her amongst the polity, and bipartisan consensus to ban the Awami League from politics. Despite the harsh rhetoric it employs against her, the BNP government is unlikely to wish for her return, as it would have to begin execution proceedings against the 79-year-old former Prime Minister, with international opposition to such a move expected to be voluble. Not doing so would only strengthen its opposition party, the Jamaat-e-Islami, that has accused the Rahman government of soft-pedalling the issue. The government must also worry about possible protests and violence within the country in the event Ms. Hasina returns.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The situation puts the Modi government in a spot. Ever since Ms. Hasina announced plans to return, during a virtual press conference held in Delhi on August 5 this year, Delhi-Dhaka ties have been on a downslide. The government’s decision not to prevent Ms. Hasina from addressing the press, where she used the opportunity to soundly criticise PM Rahman, meant the abrupt cancellation of the Bangladesh PM’s visit. Next month, the Indo-Bangladesh Ganga Water treaty is set to expire, and talks on its extension have also become a casualty. Ms. Hasina has been an honoured guest in India, and the government cannot physically restrain her from taking the flight to Dhaka or travelling to the land border at Petrapole to cross over. Nor can it wash its hands of her situation once she crosses over. New Delhi must redouble its diplomatic efforts on improving bilateral ties while also ensuring Ms. Hasina’s welfare.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #2 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 In a dilemma: On Sheikh Hasina and India-Bangladesh ties

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 12:09:56 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India must improve ties with Bangladesh, and protect Hasina

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bangladesh’s former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina now in exile in India, has set off speculation about her imminent return to Dhaka by submitting an application for a new Bangladeshi passport and national identity card this week. The application, made through the Bangladesh High Commission in Delhi, was dismissed by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s Foreign Affairs Adviser Humayun Kabir, who said that the government in Dhaka would not grant a passport to a “terrorist”, and would seek her return via the extradition agreement as a “prisoner transfer process” with India. Ms. Hasina has already announced that she plans to return to Bangladesh in December this year, as she did after her previous stay in India in exile from 1975-1981, after the brutal assassination of her father Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and nearly every other member of her family. However, the situation is considerably different now. This time, Ms. Hasina came to India in 2024 fleeing mobs of protestors that overthrew her government, and has since been convicted by a tribunal for ordering a crackdown on thousands of students, and sentenced to death. In interviews, including to The Hindu , Ms. Hasina says she hopes to return to Bangladesh to argue her case and rebuild her party, the Awami League, but that is hardly likely, given the anger against her amongst the polity, and bipartisan consensus to ban the Awami League from politics. Despite the harsh rhetoric it employs against her, the BNP government is unlikely to wish for her return, as it would have to begin execution proceedings against the 79-year-old former Prime Minister, with international opposition to such a move expected to be voluble. Not doing so would only strengthen its opposition party, the Jamaat-e-Islami, that has accused the Rahman government of soft-pedalling the issue. The government must also worry about possible protests and violence within the country in the event Ms. Hasina returns.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The situation puts the Modi government in a spot. Ever since Ms. Hasina announced plans to return, during a virtual press conference held in Delhi on August 5 this year, Delhi-Dhaka ties have been on a downslide. The government’s decision not to prevent Ms. Hasina from addressing the press, where she used the opportunity to soundly criticise PM Rahman, meant the abrupt cancellation of the Bangladesh PM’s visit. Next month, the Indo-Bangladesh Ganga Water treaty is set to expire, and talks on its extension have also become a casualty. Ms. Hasina has been an honoured guest in India, and the government cannot physically restrain her from taking the flight to Dhaka or travelling to the land border at Petrapole to cross over. Nor can it wash its hands of her situation once she crosses over. New Delhi must redouble its diplomatic efforts on improving bilateral ties while also ensuring Ms. Hasina’s welfare.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Assassination (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Assassination' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
International (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Cancellation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Cancellation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

A. India must improve ties with Bangladesh, and protect Hasina.

D. The author contends that 'In a dilemma: On Sheikh Hasina and India-Bang' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "India must improve ties with Bangladesh, and protect Hasina."

articles.title: New deal: On COP31 and lofty climate goals
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Nations must deliver on past promises before committing to lofty climate goals

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The 31st Conference of Parties (COP) began this week in Antalya, Türkiye. Hosted by Türkiye and negotiations presided over by Australia, the run-up to the gathering saw ministerial delegations visit Fiji and Tuvalu. This was to serve as a stark reminder of the purpose of COPs, namely that it was small island nations that are most vulnerable to warming from rising greenhouse gas emissions. However, the opening days have belied this sense of urgency. Prominent world leaders, even from the European countries who as a group champion the cause most vociferously, have chosen to skip the meet. The agenda and pre-summit expectations suggest that the main concerns this year are likely to be about delivering on existing commitments such as delivering $300 billion a year by 2035, which was decided at COP29 in Baku, as well as the COP30 call to triple the adaptation finance during that interval. However, deciding how these climate funds will practically flow has been deferred to COP32. The second global stocktake, a periodic check on progress under the Paris Agreement, begins at COP31, but the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) has dithered on a timeline for the next reports that will serve as the scientific push to policy makers to accelerate efforts towards keeping a rise in temperatures below 2°C, and more ambitiously 1.5°C. The previous edition of COP30 concluded without a formal roadmap away from fossil fuels — a step back from the COP28 consensus in Dubai. There is a voluntary roadmap ahead of COP31 but it is out of the formal negotiating text. In the background of the West Asia war, the withdrawal of the United States from the Paris Agreement and financial strain writ large over Europe, funds are a challenge as evidenced in the recent Loss and Damage fund approval to Nepal of $21 million when the ask is in billions. COP31 president, Murat Kurum has laid an electrification target, which is to raise electricity’s share from 23% of total energy consumption to 35% by 2035. India has already refused to sign such a pledge and insisted on predictable climate finance, technology transfer, and nationally determined approaches to climate mitigation. These negotiations have a character of their own and deliberating nations must strive to get nations to deliver on past promises rather than commit to new lofty targets.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: greenhouse gases / environmental politics / environmental issues

However, the opening days have belied this sense of urgency. Prominent world leaders, even from the European countries who as a group champion the cause most vociferously, have chosen to skip the meet. The agenda and pre-summit expectations suggest that the main concerns this year are likely to be about delivering on existing commitments such as delivering $300 billion a year by 2035, which was decided at COP29 in Baku, as well as the COP30 call to triple the adaptation finance during that interval. However, deciding how these climate funds will practically flow has been deferred to COP32. The second global stocktake, a periodic check on progress under the Paris Agreement, begins at COP31, but the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) has dithered on a timeline for the next reports that will serve as the scientific push to policy makers to accelerate efforts towards keeping a rise in temperatures below 2°C, and more ambitiously 1.5°C. The previous edition of COP30 concluded without a formal roadmap away from fossil fuels — a step back from the COP28 consensus in Dubai. There is a voluntary roadmap ahead of COP31 but it is out of the formal negotiating text. In the background of the West Asia war, the withdrawal of the United States from the Paris Agreement and financial strain writ large over Europe, funds are a challenge as evidenced in the recent Loss and Damage fund approval to Nepal of $21 million when the ask is in billions. COP31 president, Murat Kurum has laid an electrification target, which is to raise electricity’s share from 23% of total energy consumption to 35% by 2035. India has already refused to sign such a pledge and insisted on predictable climate finance, technology transfer, and nationally determined approaches to climate mitigation. These negotiations have a character of their own and deliberating nations must strive to get nations to deliver on past promises rather than commit to new lofty targets.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: greenhouse gases / environmental politics / environmental issues
