fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Health department issues flu advisory

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: With the India Meteorological Department (IMD) forecasting dry weather across Telangana over the next two days and minimum temperatures likely to remain 2°C to 3°C below normal, the State Health Department has issued an advisory urging people to take precautions against seasonal flu, warning of a possible increase in acute respiratory infections. In an advisory, Director of Public Health and Family Welfare B. Ravinder Nayak cautioned that the dip in minimum temperatures could favour the spread of seasonal flu across the State. Seasonal flu is an acute and contagious respiratory infection characterised by fever, cough, sore throat, body ache and fatigue. The infection spreads easily through respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs or sneezes. The department has advised people experiencing flu symptoms to stay at home, get adequate rest and drink plenty of fluids. Most patients are expected to recover without complications within a week. The advisory identifies pregnant women, children below five years, senior citizens above 65 years and people with chronic medical conditions as vulnerable groups at greater risk of developing severe illness. They have been advised to consult a doctor at the nearest health facility if they develop flu-like symptoms. People experiencing warning signs such as high fever, difficulty in breathing, bluish discoloration of the skin or lips, blood in sputum or altered behaviour should seek immediate medical attention at the nearest government health facility. The public has also been asked to dial 108 for ambulance services during medical emergencies. As part of preventive measures, the advisory asks people to cover their mouth and nose with a handkerchief or tissue while coughing or sneezing, wash their hands frequently with soap and water, consume nutritious food and adequate water, and ensure proper ventilation in indoor spaces. People with fever, cough or sneezing have been advised to avoid public places. The advisory also recommends avoiding handshakes, crowded places, reuse of tissues or handkerchiefs, frequent touching of the eyes, nose and mouth, and spitting in public places. The department has cautioned against self-medication without consulting a physician.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “As a part of precautionary measures, the government has made elaborate arrangements by providing Special beds and essential medicines at all the public health facilities,” the advisory stated.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 IMD forecasts 2°C to 3°C dip in temperatures across Telangana for next two days

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 10:34:29 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Health department issues flu advisory

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: With the India Meteorological Department (IMD) forecasting dry weather across Telangana over the next two days and minimum temperatures likely to remain 2°C to 3°C below normal, the State Health Department has issued an advisory urging people to take precautions against seasonal flu, warning of a possible increase in acute respiratory infections. In an advisory, Director of Public Health and Family Welfare B. Ravinder Nayak cautioned that the dip in minimum temperatures could favour the spread of seasonal flu across the State. Seasonal flu is an acute and contagious respiratory infection characterised by fever, cough, sore throat, body ache and fatigue. The infection spreads easily through respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs or sneezes. The department has advised people experiencing flu symptoms to stay at home, get adequate rest and drink plenty of fluids. Most patients are expected to recover without complications within a week. The advisory identifies pregnant women, children below five years, senior citizens above 65 years and people with chronic medical conditions as vulnerable groups at greater risk of developing severe illness. They have been advised to consult a doctor at the nearest health facility if they develop flu-like symptoms. People experiencing warning signs such as high fever, difficulty in breathing, bluish discoloration of the skin or lips, blood in sputum or altered behaviour should seek immediate medical attention at the nearest government health facility. The public has also been asked to dial 108 for ambulance services during medical emergencies. As part of preventive measures, the advisory asks people to cover their mouth and nose with a handkerchief or tissue while coughing or sneezing, wash their hands frequently with soap and water, consume nutritious food and adequate water, and ensure proper ventilation in indoor spaces. People with fever, cough or sneezing have been advised to avoid public places. The advisory also recommends avoiding handshakes, crowded places, reuse of tissues or handkerchiefs, frequent touching of the eyes, nose and mouth, and spitting in public places. The department has cautioned against self-medication without consulting a physician.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “As a part of precautionary measures, the government has made elaborate arrangements by providing Special beds and essential medicines at all the public health facilities,” the advisory stated.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Meteorological (Adjective)
मौसम विज्ञान और वायुमंडलीय परिवर्तनों से संबंधित (Connected with weather forecasting and atmospheric shifts).
✓ Syn: Atmospheric, Climatic, Weather-related  |  ✖ Ant: Geological, Subterranean, Terrestrial
Discoloration (Adjective / Verb)
मलिनकिरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Discoloration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Ventilation (Noun)
वेंटिलेशन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Ventilation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Department (Adjective)
विभाग — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Department' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "IMD forecasts 2°C to 3°C dip in temperatures across Telangana for next two days", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Health department issues flu advisory.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'IMD forecasts 2°C to 3°C dip in temperatures acr' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'IMD forecasts 2°C to 3°C dip in temperatures ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'IMD forecasts 2°C to 3°C dip in temperatures ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Health department issues flu advisory." (Hinglish Arth: स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने जारी की फ्लू एडवाइजरी)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "IMD forecasts 2°C to 3°C dip in temperatures across Telangana for next two days"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. “As a part of precautionary measures, the government has made elaborate arrangements by providing Special beds and essential medicines at all the...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“As a part of precautionary measures, the government has made elaborate arrangements by providing Special beds and essential medicines at all the..." (Hinglish Arth: एडवाइजरी में कहा गया है, "एहतियाती उपायों के एक हिस्से के रूप में, सरकार ने सभी सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य सुविधाओं पर विशेष बिस्तर और आवश्यक दवाएं उपलब्ध कराकर विस्तृत व्यवस्था की है।")

articles.title: Trees misidentified, misjudged, wrongly marked and felled to facilitate civil projects in Hyderabad
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Over 1800 trees are being felled for an access road to the Cherlapally Railway Station, most of them not the species identified in permission copy; field inspection reveals serious irregularities

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Grave irregularities mark the tree felling/translocation permissions accorded by the Hyderabad Tree Protection Committee, as discovered in two sample cases of field inspection, respectively at Falaknuma and Cherlapally railway stations, casting a deep shadow on the whole process. Healthy trees with woody stems and high survival rate marked for felling, dead trees or trees with no canopy permitted for translocation, wrong marking of trees on the ground, and multiple trees marked with the same number: these are only a few examples of how careless and compromised the Forest department is in granting permissions for tree felling/translocation in the age of aggravating climate crisis. In the first instance, a rain tree which had anchored itself on the Falaknuma railway over bridge years ago, and grown with full canopy, was marked for translocation by the Tree Protection Committee to make way for the Metro Rail expansion project. Uprooting the tree means demolition of the flyover, yet this detail escaped the notice of the members who reportedly conducted field inspections before according permissions. A rain tree anchored on Falaknuma railway bridge is recommended for translocation to facilitate Metro Rail expansion. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement On the same stretch, the letter ‘T’ is painted in red on a row of median palm trees, indicating translocation. Several of them are bare trunks devoid of crown, and practically dead, which makes them unlikely candidates for translocation. The rationale for translocation was not explained, and attempts to reach the forest officials have failed. In the second, more flagrant instance, the proposed access road to Charlapally Railway Station by Telangana Industrial Infrastructure Corporation (TGIIC) is replete with glaring errors in identification of species and their demarcation, besides absolute callousness in execution. For this project, a total 2,519 trees are going, of which a whopping 1,883 are permitted to be felled, and 636 are to be translocated. Several copper pod trees with thickly wooded trunks were hacked and piled in an open forested plot, where trees with negligible girth, and even dead trees were tied with a red ribbon isolating them for translocation. Their number and species do not match with the permission accorded by the TPC even in a single instance. Several such anomalies could be observed with regard to the avenue trees too. A thick and healthy copper pod tree is axed down, but several trees much smaller in the background are tied with ribbons for translocation at Cherlapally | Photo Credit: Swathi Vadlamudi For instance, the avenue tree with the number 158 is marked for translocation on the permission copy, with the species was mentioned as ‘China Are’. On the ground, it is a dead tree with no canopy at all.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The trees with the numbers 160 and 161 painted on them are ‘Moduga’ (Flame of the Forest) and ‘Vepa’ (Neem) respectively on the ground, while it is reverse on the paper. There were two trees painted with the number 39-- one Peepal and another Mango-- while on paper, the number is associated with a mango tree marked for felling. The reason mentioned was termite infestation, but the tree is found in a healthy condition.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Trees misidentified, misjudged, wrongly marked and felled to facilitate civil projects in Hyderabad

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 10:30:01 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Over 1800 trees are being felled for an access road to the Cherlapally Railway Station, most of them not the species identified in permission copy; field inspection reveals serious irregularities

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Grave irregularities mark the tree felling/translocation permissions accorded by the Hyderabad Tree Protection Committee, as discovered in two sample cases of field inspection, respectively at Falaknuma and Cherlapally railway stations, casting a deep shadow on the whole process. Healthy trees with woody stems and high survival rate marked for felling, dead trees or trees with no canopy permitted for translocation, wrong marking of trees on the ground, and multiple trees marked with the same number: these are only a few examples of how careless and compromised the Forest department is in granting permissions for tree felling/translocation in the age of aggravating climate crisis. In the first instance, a rain tree which had anchored itself on the Falaknuma railway over bridge years ago, and grown with full canopy, was marked for translocation by the Tree Protection Committee to make way for the Metro Rail expansion project. Uprooting the tree means demolition of the flyover, yet this detail escaped the notice of the members who reportedly conducted field inspections before according permissions. A rain tree anchored on Falaknuma railway bridge is recommended for translocation to facilitate Metro Rail expansion. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement On the same stretch, the letter ‘T’ is painted in red on a row of median palm trees, indicating translocation. Several of them are bare trunks devoid of crown, and practically dead, which makes them unlikely candidates for translocation. The rationale for translocation was not explained, and attempts to reach the forest officials have failed. In the second, more flagrant instance, the proposed access road to Charlapally Railway Station by Telangana Industrial Infrastructure Corporation (TGIIC) is replete with glaring errors in identification of species and their demarcation, besides absolute callousness in execution. For this project, a total 2,519 trees are going, of which a whopping 1,883 are permitted to be felled, and 636 are to be translocated. Several copper pod trees with thickly wooded trunks were hacked and piled in an open forested plot, where trees with negligible girth, and even dead trees were tied with a red ribbon isolating them for translocation. Their number and species do not match with the permission accorded by the TPC even in a single instance. Several such anomalies could be observed with regard to the avenue trees too. A thick and healthy copper pod tree is axed down, but several trees much smaller in the background are tied with ribbons for translocation at Cherlapally | Photo Credit: Swathi Vadlamudi For instance, the avenue tree with the number 158 is marked for translocation on the permission copy, with the species was mentioned as ‘China Are’. On the ground, it is a dead tree with no canopy at all.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The trees with the numbers 160 and 161 painted on them are ‘Moduga’ (Flame of the Forest) and ‘Vepa’ (Neem) respectively on the ground, while it is reverse on the paper. There were two trees painted with the number 39-- one Peepal and another Mango-- while on paper, the number is associated with a mango tree marked for felling. The reason mentioned was termite infestation, but the tree is found in a healthy condition.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Permissibility (Noun)
कानूनी अनुमति या स्वीकार्यता — किसी कार्य को करने की वैध छूट।
✓ Syn: Admissibility, Legality, Allowance  |  ✖ Ant: Prohibition, Ban, Illegality
Identification (Noun)
पहचान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Identification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Translocation (Noun)
अनुवादन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Translocation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Arrangement (Adjective)
व्यवस्था — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Arrangement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Trees misidentified, misjudged, wrongly marked and felled to facilitate civil projects in Hyderabad", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Over 1800 trees are being felled for an access road to the Cherlapally Railway Station, most of them not the species identified in permission copy;...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Trees misidentified, misjudged, wrongly marked a' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Trees misidentified, misjudged, wrongly marke' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Trees misidentified, misjudged, wrongly marke' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Over 1800 trees are being felled for an access road to the Cherlapally Railway Station, most of them not the species identified in permission copy;..." (Hinglish Arth: चेरलापल्ली रेलवे स्टेशन तक पहुंच मार्ग के लिए 1800 से अधिक पेड़ काटे जा रहे हैं, उनमें से अधिकांश अनुमति प्रति में पहचानी गई प्रजाति के नहीं हैं; क्षेत्र निरीक्षण में गंभीर अनियमितताएं उजागर हुईं)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Trees misidentified, misjudged, wrongly marked and felled to facilitate civil projects in Hyderabad"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The reason mentioned was termite infestation, but the tree is found in a healthy condition.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The reason mentioned was termite infestation, but the tree is found in a healthy condition." (Hinglish Arth: कारण बताया गया है दीमक का प्रकोप, लेकिन पेड़ स्वस्थ अवस्था में पाया गया है।)

articles.title: Sanskrit varsity suspension row: Maintenance of discipline paramount, can’t be compromised, university tells Kerala HC
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The maintenance of discipline was paramount and could not be compromised for a few students, the Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit, Kalady, has stated before the Kerala High Court.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Sixteen students and Student Federation of India (SFI) activists had been suspended pending an inquiry for allegedly staging a mock cremation of the Vice-Chancellor, manhandling her and attempting to damage her property on September 1. They had approached the court challenging the suspension order and seeking permission to appear for the semester examinations. Opposing the students’ plea in an affidavit, the university stated that judicial interference in the matter would prejudice its efforts to preserve academic discipline and ensure smooth functioning. The University informed the court that the Syndicate had reviewed the Enquiry Committee’s report, which found the students guilty. It resolved that the suspension of 12 students could be revoked if they tendered an unconditional apology. The suspension of four other students was extended by another two months, the university stated. The university said the Syndicate had taken a lenient view. It opposed the students’ contention that the suspension was prolonged and said the inquiry had been concluded within two months. The students’ plea was futile at this stage as the examinations were over and the inquiry had concluded, the university stated. In any case, the students did not have the required attendance to appear for the examinations, and a shortage of attendance due to suspension was not a ground for condonation under university rules. Further, they had neither applied for condonation of the attendance shortage nor secured the required internal marks, it stated. The alleged grievances regarding vacancies, certificates, infrastructure and fellowships could not justify the students’ conduct, the university claimed. It also pointed to criminal cases registered against several students with the Kalady police. It alleged that active workers of the Left Democratic Front (LDF) were involved in the student protest and that prominent LDF leaders had visited the Satyagraha Pandal. The protest was not for academic reasons but was aimed at using the University as a platform to mobilise the student community for a larger political campaign following the last Assembly election, it stated.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The university further stated that if the students were aggrieved over the lack of academic facilities, they should have tendered an unconditional apology to secure reinstatement, as had been done in earlier instances. Instead, the students chose to approach the High Court with their grievances without first seeking alternative remedies, such as the University’s grievance redressal platforms, to sensationalise the matter for political motives, it stated.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Sixteen students and Student Federation of India (SFI) activists had been suspended pending an inquiry for allegedly staging a mock cremation of the Vice-Chancellor, manhandling her and attempting to damage her property on September 1. They had approached the court challenging the suspension order and seeking permission to appear for the semester examinations. Opposing the students’ plea in an affidavit, the university stated that judicial interference in the matter would prejudice its efforts to preserve academic discipline and ensure smooth functioning. The University informed the court that the Syndicate had reviewed the Enquiry Committee’s report, which found the students guilty. It resolved that the suspension of 12 students could be revoked if they tendered an unconditional apology. The suspension of four other students was extended by another two months, the university stated. The university said the Syndicate had taken a lenient view. It opposed the students’ contention that the suspension was prolonged and said the inquiry had been concluded within two months. The students’ plea was futile at this stage as the examinations were over and the inquiry had concluded, the university stated. In any case, the students did not have the required attendance to appear for the examinations, and a shortage of attendance due to suspension was not a ground for condonation under university rules. Further, they had neither applied for condonation of the attendance shortage nor secured the required internal marks, it stated. The alleged grievances regarding vacancies, certificates, infrastructure and fellowships could not justify the students’ conduct, the university claimed. It also pointed to criminal cases registered against several students with the Kalady police. It alleged that active workers of the Left Democratic Front (LDF) were involved in the student protest and that prominent LDF leaders had visited the Satyagraha Pandal. The protest was not for academic reasons but was aimed at using the University as a platform to mobilise the student community for a larger political campaign following the last Assembly election, it stated.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The university further stated that if the students were aggrieved over the lack of academic facilities, they should have tendered an unconditional apology to secure reinstatement, as had been done in earlier instances. Instead, the students chose to approach the High Court with their grievances without first seeking alternative remedies, such as the University’s grievance redressal platforms, to sensationalise the matter for political motives, it stated.

articles.title: Delhi reels under ‘severe’ level air pollution
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The 24-hour average overall Air Quality Index (AQI) of Delhi was 403 (severe) at 9 a.m. on November 13, as per Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) data

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The overall air quality of Delhi worsened to “severe” category on Friday (November 13, 2026) morning, according to official data. Ballabgarh in Haryana also witnessed “severe” air pollution, while many other cities and towns in north India, including Noida, Gurugram, Faridabad witnessed “very poor” air quality, on Friday morning. The 24-hour average overall Air Quality Index (AQI) of Delhi was 403 (severe) at 9 a.m. on Friday, as per Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) data. The overall air quality of Delhi is expected to be in the “severe’” category till Friday night, as per the Central government’s ‘Air Quality Early Warning System for Delhi’. The 24-hour average overall Air Quality Index (AQI) of Delhi stood at 350 (very poor) at 4 p.m. on Thursday, up from 313 (very poor) a day earlier, the Central Pollution Control Board’s daily bulletin, which is treated as the day’s AQI. A higher AQI means worsening of air quality. Every winter, air pollution spikes in Delhi-NCR and many parts of the larger Indo-Gangetic Plains, mainly due to meteorological factors such as lower wind speeds and a drop in temperature. Also, pollution from stubble burning during October and November and bursting of firecrackers during the festive season add to existing pollution from vehicles and dust, worsening the air quality. “Severe” level air pollution affects healthy people and seriously impacts those with existing diseases, as per the CPCB.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: air pollution / environmental issues / environmental pollution / New Delhi

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Delhi reels under ‘severe’ level air pollution

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 10:23:52 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The 24-hour average overall Air Quality Index (AQI) of Delhi was 403 (severe) at 9 a.m. on November 13, as per Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) data

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The overall air quality of Delhi worsened to “severe” category on Friday (November 13, 2026) morning, according to official data. Ballabgarh in Haryana also witnessed “severe” air pollution, while many other cities and towns in north India, including Noida, Gurugram, Faridabad witnessed “very poor” air quality, on Friday morning. The 24-hour average overall Air Quality Index (AQI) of Delhi was 403 (severe) at 9 a.m. on Friday, as per Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) data. The overall air quality of Delhi is expected to be in the “severe’” category till Friday night, as per the Central government’s ‘Air Quality Early Warning System for Delhi’. The 24-hour average overall Air Quality Index (AQI) of Delhi stood at 350 (very poor) at 4 p.m. on Thursday, up from 313 (very poor) a day earlier, the Central Pollution Control Board’s daily bulletin, which is treated as the day’s AQI. A higher AQI means worsening of air quality. Every winter, air pollution spikes in Delhi-NCR and many parts of the larger Indo-Gangetic Plains, mainly due to meteorological factors such as lower wind speeds and a drop in temperature. Also, pollution from stubble burning during October and November and bursting of firecrackers during the festive season add to existing pollution from vehicles and dust, worsening the air quality. “Severe” level air pollution affects healthy people and seriously impacts those with existing diseases, as per the CPCB.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: air pollution / environmental issues / environmental pollution / New Delhi

D. The author contends that 'Delhi reels under ‘severe’ level air pollutio' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

articles.title: Messi visit case: Keralam Governor gives approval to prosecute former Sports Minister Abdurahiman over alleged irregularities
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Lok Bhavan’s decision is based on a request of Chief Minister. The SIT led by Additional Director General of Police P. Vijayan had earlier submitted a preliminary report to the government

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Keralam Governor Om Prakash Mathur on Thursday granted sanction to prosecute former Sports Minister V. Abdurahiman under the Prevention of Corruption Act in connection with alleged irregularities surrounding the proposed visit of football great Lionel Messi and the Argentina national football team to Keralam. Lok Bhavan’s decision is based on a request submitted by the Chief Minister on October 16. The Special Investigation Team (SIT) led by Additional Director General of Police P. Vijayan had earlier submitted a preliminary report to the government. According to the SIT’s findings, Mr. Abdurahiman allegedly misused his official position and intervened improperly to provide undue financial benefits to the event’s sponsor, Reporter Broadcasting Company (RBC). The investigation reportedly found serious violations of procedures, including in the tendering process and the award of the sponsorship contract. Besides purportedly causing financial loss to the State government, the alleged crime also involved the alleged misuse of official documents and financial irregularities involving crores of rupees and suspected violations of GST norms. The SIT recommended registering cases under the Prevention of Corruption Act against five individuals and entities, including the former minister, his former private secretary C. Sathyapalan, former Kerala State Sports Council president U. Sharafali, and RBC and its owner, Anto Augustine. Since the allegations concern decisions and actions allegedly taken by Mr. Abdurahiman while serving as a Minister, the government had received legal advice to obtain the Governor’s sanction before proceeding with a corruption case against him.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The former Minister, who had been questioned by the SIT, had denied any wrongdoing and maintained that his involvement was merely aimed at facilitating the proposed visit of the Argentina team to Keralam.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Messi visit case: Keralam Governor gives approval to prosecute former Sports Minister Abdurahiman over alleged irregularities

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 10:12:15 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Lok Bhavan’s decision is based on a request of Chief Minister. The SIT led by Additional Director General of Police P. Vijayan had earlier submitted a preliminary report to the government

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Keralam Governor Om Prakash Mathur on Thursday granted sanction to prosecute former Sports Minister V. Abdurahiman under the Prevention of Corruption Act in connection with alleged irregularities surrounding the proposed visit of football great Lionel Messi and the Argentina national football team to Keralam. Lok Bhavan’s decision is based on a request submitted by the Chief Minister on October 16. The Special Investigation Team (SIT) led by Additional Director General of Police P. Vijayan had earlier submitted a preliminary report to the government. According to the SIT’s findings, Mr. Abdurahiman allegedly misused his official position and intervened improperly to provide undue financial benefits to the event’s sponsor, Reporter Broadcasting Company (RBC). The investigation reportedly found serious violations of procedures, including in the tendering process and the award of the sponsorship contract. Besides purportedly causing financial loss to the State government, the alleged crime also involved the alleged misuse of official documents and financial irregularities involving crores of rupees and suspected violations of GST norms. The SIT recommended registering cases under the Prevention of Corruption Act against five individuals and entities, including the former minister, his former private secretary C. Sathyapalan, former Kerala State Sports Council president U. Sharafali, and RBC and its owner, Anto Augustine. Since the allegations concern decisions and actions allegedly taken by Mr. Abdurahiman while serving as a Minister, the government had received legal advice to obtain the Governor’s sanction before proceeding with a corruption case against him.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The former Minister, who had been questioned by the SIT, had denied any wrongdoing and maintained that his involvement was merely aimed at facilitating the proposed visit of the Argentina team to Keralam.

Investigation (Adjective / Verb)
जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

अतिरिक्त — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Additional' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Prevention (Noun)
रोकथाम — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Prevention' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. A. Lok Bhavan’s decision is based on a request of Chief Minister.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Messi visit case: Keralam Governor gives approva' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Messi visit case: Keralam Governor gives appr' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Messi visit case: Keralam Governor gives appr' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Lok Bhavan’s decision is based on a request of Chief Minister." (Hinglish Arth: लोकभवन का निर्णय मुख्यमंत्री के अनुरोध पर आधारित है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Messi visit case: Keralam Governor gives approval to prosecute former Sports Minister Abdurahiman over alleged irregularities"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The former Minister, who had been questioned by the SIT, had denied any wrongdoing and maintained that his involvement was merely aimed at...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The former Minister, who had been questioned by the SIT, had denied any wrongdoing and maintained that his involvement was merely aimed at..." fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Netherlands currently has a minority government by a coalition of three parties holding 66 seats in the 150-member Tweede Kamer, the lower house

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Story so far: The Dutch government came close to a collapse this week over its Tax Plan for 2027 as members of the three-party ruling coalition disagreed over an amendment to the plan. Though the plan was passed in the lowest-possible majority in the House of Representatives on Thursday (November 12, 2026) night and the government subsequently defeated a no-confidence motion, the developments have brought a rift in the coalition out in the open and threaten the future of the government led by Rob Jetten just nine-months into its 4-year term. The Netherlands currently has a minority government by a coalition of three parties holding 66 seats in the 150-member Tweede Kamer, the lower house. The centrist D66 led by Prime Minister Jetten, the youngest premier in the country’s history, is the single largest party with 26 seats and is joined by centre-right parties People’s Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD) and Christian Democratic Appeal (CDA), with 22 and 18 seats respectively. The government came to power in February, 117 days after a snap election in October last year necessitated by the collapse of Dick Schoof’s right-wing government as far-right leader of Freedom Party Geert Wilders withdrew his support. The months following the election that failed to produce a clear winner saw parties across political spectrum and ideologies negotiate to form a government to no effect, paving the way for the centrist parties to make do with a minority administration.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Netherlands / economy, business and finance / The Hindu Explains

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हालाँकि यह योजना गुरुवार (नवंबर 12, 2026) की रात को प्रतिनिधि सभा में सबसे कम-संभव बहुमत में पारित की गई थी और सरकार ने बाद में अविश्वास प्रस्ताव को हरा दिया था, लेकिन घटनाक्रम ने गठबंधन में दरार को खुले में ला दिया है और रॉब जेट्टेन के नेतृत्व वाली सरकार के 4 साल के कार्यकाल में केवल नौ महीने के भविष्य को खतरे में डाल दिया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Confidence' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: आत्मविश्वास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Confidence' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The centrist D66 led by Prime Minister Jetten, the youngest premier in the country’s history, is the single largest party with 26 seats and is joined by centre-right parties People’s Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD) and Christian Democratic Appeal (CDA), with 22 and 18 seats respectively.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — देश के इतिहास में सबसे कम उम्र के प्रधान मंत्री जेट्टेन के नेतृत्व वाली मध्यमार्गी डी66, 26 सीटों के साथ सबसे बड़ी पार्टी है और इसके साथ केंद्र-दक्षिणपंथी पार्टियां पीपुल्स पार्टी फॉर फ्रीडम एंड डेमोक्रेसी (वीवीडी) और क्रिश्चियन डेमोक्रेटिक अपील (सीडीए) भी शामिल हैं, जिनके पास क्रमशः 22 और 18 सीटें हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Democratic' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: लोकतांत्रिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Democratic' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The government came to power in February, 117 days after a snap election in October last year necessitated by the collapse of Dick Schoof’s right-wing government as far-right leader of Freedom Party Geert Wilders withdrew his support.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — डिक शूफ की दक्षिणपंथी सरकार के पतन के कारण पिछले साल अक्टूबर में हुए आकस्मिक चुनाव के 117 दिन बाद फरवरी में सरकार सत्ता में आई, क्योंकि फ्रीडम पार्टी के धुर दक्षिणपंथी नेता गीर्ट वाइल्डर्स ने अपना समर्थन वापस ले लिया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The months following the election that failed to produce a clear winner saw parties across political spectrum and ideologies negotiate to form a government to no effect, paving the way for the centrist parties to make do with a minority administration.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — चुनाव के बाद के महीनों में, जो एक स्पष्ट विजेता देने में विफल रहे, विभिन्न राजनीतिक स्पेक्ट्रम और विचारधाराओं वाली पार्टियों ने बिना किसी प्रभाव के सरकार बनाने के लिए बातचीत की, जिससे मध्यमार्गी पार्टियों के लिए अल्पसंख्यक प्रशासन बनाने का मार्ग प्रशस्त हुआ।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Administration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रशासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Netherlands currently has a minority government by a coalition of three parties holding 66 seats in the 150-member Tweede Kamer, the lower house

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Story so far: The Dutch government came close to a collapse this week over its Tax Plan for 2027 as members of the three-party ruling coalition disagreed over an amendment to the plan. Though the plan was passed in the lowest-possible majority in the House of Representatives on Thursday (November 12, 2026) night and the government subsequently defeated a no-confidence motion, the developments have brought a rift in the coalition out in the open and threaten the future of the government led by Rob Jetten just nine-months into its 4-year term. The Netherlands currently has a minority government by a coalition of three parties holding 66 seats in the 150-member Tweede Kamer, the lower house. The centrist D66 led by Prime Minister Jetten, the youngest premier in the country’s history, is the single largest party with 26 seats and is joined by centre-right parties People’s Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD) and Christian Democratic Appeal (CDA), with 22 and 18 seats respectively. The government came to power in February, 117 days after a snap election in October last year necessitated by the collapse of Dick Schoof’s right-wing government as far-right leader of Freedom Party Geert Wilders withdrew his support. The months following the election that failed to produce a clear winner saw parties across political spectrum and ideologies negotiate to form a government to no effect, paving the way for the centrist parties to make do with a minority administration.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Netherlands / economy, business and finance / The Hindu Explains

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The RBI has reportedly proposed a ₹50 lakh sub-limit within the $250,000 annual Liberalised Remittance Scheme cap to curb dollar outflows and protect the rupee

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has reportedly proposed to the Ministry of Finance tightening the limits of the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS), in an attempt likely aimed at preventing a massive outflow of dollars from India. Under the current structure, Indian residents can remit up to $250,000 (over ₹2 crore) in a financial year for purposes such as travel, education, medical treatment, and overseas investments. The LRS is a scheme under the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA), introduced by the RBI in 2004. It covers both capital account and current account transactions. Under the capital account, transactions are permitted for opening overseas foreign currency bank accounts, purchasing property, extending interest-free loans of up to one year, and investing in foreign equity, mutual funds, and listed debt securities.

articles.title: China stages unannounced Pacific drills in ‘silent intimidation’ of Taiwan, officials say
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A senior Taiwan security official said China’s military and coast guard had, at one point, amassed more than 100 vessels in the region early this month

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China carried out a large, unannounced military exercise across ‌the western Pacific and around Taiwan in early November, in what officials in Taipei have ​described as a campaign of “silent intimidation” aimed at pressuring Taiwan and other governments before major international ⁠meetings. A senior Taiwan security official, speaking on condition of anonymity due to the sensitivity of the matter, said China’s military and coast guard had at one point massed more than 100 vessels in the region early this month, conducting drills that included simulated ‌attacks on other militaries and cities including Taiwan’s. The naval deployment was larger than “Justice Mission 2025”, China’s last formally named drills targeting Taiwan nearly a year ago and one of the largest Chinese ‌naval deployments to date, the official said. The drills come as China, which views democratically governed Taiwan as ‌its ⁠own territory, has stepped up its military pressure over the past five years, drawing condemnation from ⁠Taipei and heightening concern in Western capitals about the potential for conflict. Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday (November 12, 2026) gave a major policy speech about Taiwan, urging peaceful “reunification” though making no mention of using force. During the latest drills, a Chinese submarine also launched an intercontinental ballistic missile from ​the Yellow Sea into the Chinese mainland, the official ‌said. “It is a silent exercise — and in effect, silent intimidation,” they said. “This is like a robber hiding a gun in the pocket of a coat — with the muzzle pointed at the bank teller. It scares the teller into handing over the money, while avoiding setting off the alarm and bringing in ‌a large police response.” China’s defence ministry did not respond to a request for comment.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: China, which ⁠has never renounced the use of force to bring Taiwan under its control, has said the carrier is on “routine” exercises that are not directed at any country.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #20 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 China stages unannounced Pacific drills in ‘silent intimidation’ of Taiwan, officials say

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 03:16:55 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A senior Taiwan security official said China’s military and coast guard had, at one point, amassed more than 100 vessels in the region early this month

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China carried out a large, unannounced military exercise across ‌the western Pacific and around Taiwan in early November, in what officials in Taipei have ​described as a campaign of “silent intimidation” aimed at pressuring Taiwan and other governments before major international ⁠meetings. A senior Taiwan security official, speaking on condition of anonymity due to the sensitivity of the matter, said China’s military and coast guard had at one point massed more than 100 vessels in the region early this month, conducting drills that included simulated ‌attacks on other militaries and cities including Taiwan’s. The naval deployment was larger than “Justice Mission 2025”, China’s last formally named drills targeting Taiwan nearly a year ago and one of the largest Chinese ‌naval deployments to date, the official said. The drills come as China, which views democratically governed Taiwan as ‌its ⁠own territory, has stepped up its military pressure over the past five years, drawing condemnation from ⁠Taipei and heightening concern in Western capitals about the potential for conflict. Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday (November 12, 2026) gave a major policy speech about Taiwan, urging peaceful “reunification” though making no mention of using force. During the latest drills, a Chinese submarine also launched an intercontinental ballistic missile from ​the Yellow Sea into the Chinese mainland, the official ‌said. “It is a silent exercise — and in effect, silent intimidation,” they said. “This is like a robber hiding a gun in the pocket of a coat — with the muzzle pointed at the bank teller. It scares the teller into handing over the money, while avoiding setting off the alarm and bringing in ‌a large police response.” China’s defence ministry did not respond to a request for comment.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: China, which ⁠has never renounced the use of force to bring Taiwan under its control, has said the carrier is on “routine” exercises that are not directed at any country.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Reunification (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Reunification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Intimidation (Adjective / Verb)
डराना — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intimidation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "China stages unannounced Pacific drills in ‘silent intimidation’ of Taiwan, officials say", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. A senior Taiwan security official said China’s military and coast guard had, at one point, amassed more than 100 vessels in the region early this...

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'China stages unannounced Pacific drills in ‘s' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'China stages unannounced Pacific drills in ‘s' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A senior Taiwan security official said China’s military and coast guard had, at one point, amassed more than 100 vessels in the region early this..." articles.title: Iran says it struck U.S. military radar in Bahrain
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The IRGC says the strait is closed, while the U.S. Navy claims that it has opened a southern route for commercial vessels to exit and enter the critical waterway, while maintaining its “ironclad blockade” of Iranian ports

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) on Friday (November 13, 2026) said it had “destroyed” a U.S. military early-warning radar in Bahrain, in retaliation for a U.S. strike on a telecommunications tower in Sirik, southern Iran. “An hour ago, in response to the enemy’s air attack on a telecommunications tower in Sirik, the IRGC’s aerospace fighters targeted and destroyed the early-warning radar of the American aggressors on the islam of Bahrain,” the IRGC said in its statement. It added that the attack was “a serious warning to the aggressor enemy to end air mischief and oil smuggling in the Strait of Hormuz”. The U.S. military in recent days had carried out limited air strikes on Qeshm island and other parts of southern Iran near the strait, which it said were “defensive in nature”. October saw a record spike in maritime attacks in the Strait of Hormuz with nearly three dozen tankers being hit. The IRGC says the strait is closed, while the U.S. Navy claims that it has opened a southern route for commercial vessels to exit and enter the critical waterway, while maintaining its “ironclad blockade” of Iranian ports. In the first week of November, at least six vessels came under attack in the strait, according to the U.K. Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO). The U.S. says its strikes in southern Iran were aimed at neutralising the threats the IRGC posed to maritime traffic. “In case of repeated violations and aggressions, the IRGC’s air force is on full alert for borderless confrontation,” the Guards said in the statement. The latest confrontation comes hours after U.S. President Donald Trump pulled Vice President J.D. Vance off talks with Iran, saying the U.S. did not want a deal with Iran. “Those days have long since passed. We have got their money, hundreds of billions of dollars, and we have got their strait,” he wrote in a social media post, after diplomatic efforts mediated by Qatar failed to reach any breakthrough. Iran wants the U.S. to meet its conditions, including removal of the blockade, unfreezing of its assets and war reparation, to reopen the strait and bring the nuclear issue back to the table. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio had said earlier this week that Iran’s demands were “outrageous and ridiculous and really not realistic”. Before the November 3 U.S. midterm elections, Mr. Trump had said that he would decide whether he should “destroy” Iran based on the outcome of the diplomatic outcomes. But after the midterm, in which his Republican party suffered a massive defeat, Mr. Trump signalled that he was stepping back from renewed conflict.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Immediately after the results, Vice President J.D. Vance had blamed the war on Iran as the main reason for the Republican rout. On November 10, Mr. Trump said he would maintain the status quo on Iran — no immediate military escalation — but added that the naval blockade would stay in place. Tehran, on the other side, vowed to break the status quo.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Iran says it struck U.S. military radar in Bahrain

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 03:12:57 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The IRGC says the strait is closed, while the U.S. Navy claims that it has opened a southern route for commercial vessels to exit and enter the critical waterway, while maintaining its “ironclad blockade” of Iranian ports

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) on Friday (November 13, 2026) said it had “destroyed” a U.S. military early-warning radar in Bahrain, in retaliation for a U.S. strike on a telecommunications tower in Sirik, southern Iran. “An hour ago, in response to the enemy’s air attack on a telecommunications tower in Sirik, the IRGC’s aerospace fighters targeted and destroyed the early-warning radar of the American aggressors on the islam of Bahrain,” the IRGC said in its statement. It added that the attack was “a serious warning to the aggressor enemy to end air mischief and oil smuggling in the Strait of Hormuz”. The U.S. military in recent days had carried out limited air strikes on Qeshm island and other parts of southern Iran near the strait, which it said were “defensive in nature”. October saw a record spike in maritime attacks in the Strait of Hormuz with nearly three dozen tankers being hit. The IRGC says the strait is closed, while the U.S. Navy claims that it has opened a southern route for commercial vessels to exit and enter the critical waterway, while maintaining its “ironclad blockade” of Iranian ports. In the first week of November, at least six vessels came under attack in the strait, according to the U.K. Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO). The U.S. says its strikes in southern Iran were aimed at neutralising the threats the IRGC posed to maritime traffic. “In case of repeated violations and aggressions, the IRGC’s air force is on full alert for borderless confrontation,” the Guards said in the statement. The latest confrontation comes hours after U.S. President Donald Trump pulled Vice President J.D. Vance off talks with Iran, saying the U.S. did not want a deal with Iran. “Those days have long since passed. We have got their money, hundreds of billions of dollars, and we have got their strait,” he wrote in a social media post, after diplomatic efforts mediated by Qatar failed to reach any breakthrough. Iran wants the U.S. to meet its conditions, including removal of the blockade, unfreezing of its assets and war reparation, to reopen the strait and bring the nuclear issue back to the table. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio had said earlier this week that Iran’s demands were “outrageous and ridiculous and really not realistic”. Before the November 3 U.S. midterm elections, Mr. Trump had said that he would decide whether he should “destroy” Iran based on the outcome of the diplomatic outcomes. But after the midterm, in which his Republican party suffered a massive defeat, Mr. Trump signalled that he was stepping back from renewed conflict.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Immediately after the results, Vice President J.D. Vance had blamed the war on Iran as the main reason for the Republican rout. On November 10, Mr. Trump said he would maintain the status quo on Iran — no immediate military escalation — but added that the naval blockade would stay in place. Tehran, on the other side, vowed to break the status quo.

articles.title: U.S. Commerce Secretary Lutnick to testify before Congress on Nvidia: US media
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S. lawmakers have called for clarity on what the administration of President Donald Trump knew about Nvidia chief Jensen Huang's extramarital affair with a woman suspected of spying for China

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick will testify before Congress on the Nvidia scandal, U.S. media reported on Thursday (November 12 2026). U.S. lawmakers have called for clarity on what the administration of President Donald Trump knew about Nvidia chief Jensen Huang's extramarital affair with a woman suspected of spying for China. "Secretary Lutnick has proactively agreed to appear voluntarily before the Banking Committee to address their questions," Kristen Eichamer, a spokeswoman for Lutnick, told NBC News . Mr. Huang, a pivotal figure in the Artificial Intelligence (AI) boom, quit as Nvidia's chief executive after revelations of two extramarital affairs, including one with suspected spy Alice Huang, who is no relation. Mr. Lutnick has come under scrutiny as the Commerce Department was mandated to review companies for national security risks before the Trump administration green-lit Nvidia to sell advanced chips to China. Beijing is in a race for tech dominance against the United States, which restricts the export to China of the most cutting-edge silicon chips. Nvidia, a global leader in producing chips used to train and run AI models, is one of the world's most valuable companies. Senate Banking Committee chairman Tim Scott requested that Mr. Lutnick testify "for a public hearing regarding recent public reports about Nvidia and the Department of Commerce's role that raises national security concerns", NBC reported.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Scott has also requested Jensen Huang testify before the committee, NBC said.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 U.S. Commerce Secretary Lutnick to testify before Congress on Nvidia: US media

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 03:09:12 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S. lawmakers have called for clarity on what the administration of President Donald Trump knew about Nvidia chief Jensen Huang's extramarital affair with a woman suspected of spying for China

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick will testify before Congress on the Nvidia scandal, U.S. media reported on Thursday (November 12 2026). U.S. lawmakers have called for clarity on what the administration of President Donald Trump knew about Nvidia chief Jensen Huang's extramarital affair with a woman suspected of spying for China. "Secretary Lutnick has proactively agreed to appear voluntarily before the Banking Committee to address their questions," Kristen Eichamer, a spokeswoman for Lutnick, told NBC News . Mr. Huang, a pivotal figure in the Artificial Intelligence (AI) boom, quit as Nvidia's chief executive after revelations of two extramarital affairs, including one with suspected spy Alice Huang, who is no relation. Mr. Lutnick has come under scrutiny as the Commerce Department was mandated to review companies for national security risks before the Trump administration green-lit Nvidia to sell advanced chips to China. Beijing is in a race for tech dominance against the United States, which restricts the export to China of the most cutting-edge silicon chips. Nvidia, a global leader in producing chips used to train and run AI models, is one of the world's most valuable companies. Senate Banking Committee chairman Tim Scott requested that Mr. Lutnick testify "for a public hearing regarding recent public reports about Nvidia and the Department of Commerce's role that raises national security concerns", NBC reported.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Scott has also requested Jensen Huang testify before the committee, NBC said.

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "U.S. Commerce Secretary Lutnick to testify before Congress on Nvidia: US media", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. lawmakers have called for clarity on what the administration of President Donald Trump knew about Nvidia chief Jensen Huang's extramarital affair...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'U.S. Commerce Secretary Lutnick to testify befor' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

D. The author contends that 'U.S. Commerce Secretary Lutnick to testify be' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "U.S. Commerce Secretary Lutnick to testify before Congress on Nvidia: US media"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.

articles.title: What polluted air adds to India’s rising blood sugar
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India’s blood-sugar readings are climbing, and studies from Tamil Nadu and Delhi link type 2 diabetes to dirty air, outdoors and in smoky kitchens, inside. In a year when cooking gas ran short, however, the national health survey left clean cooking fuel out of its fact sheets. The link is there, the data is missing

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Chennai breathes far cleaner air than Delhi. A study that followed 12,064 adults in the two cities put the typical yearly level of fine particles around Chennai homes between 2010 and 2016 at 40.2 micrograms per cubic metre, just above the national standard of 40, against 101.5 in Delhi. In both cities, the dirtier a person’s air, the likelier they were to develop type 2 diabetes .

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The World Health Organization’s theme for World Diabetes Day, on November 14 this year, is early action. The sixth National Family Health Survey (NFHS-6), carried out in 2023-24, found 17.8% of women and 20.9% of men aged 15 and above had high blood sugar or were on medicine for it, up from 13.5% and 15.6% per cent in NFHS-5, conducted in 2019-21. In Chennai district, nearly 3 in 10 women fall in the group.

hinglishTracks.en: The sixth National Family Health Survey (NFHS-6), carried out in 2023-24, found 17.8% of women and 20.9% of men aged 15 and above had high blood sugar or were on medicine for it, up from 13.5% and 15.6% per cent in NFHS-5, conducted in 2019-21.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 2023-24 में किए गए छठे राष्ट्रीय परिवार स्वास्थ्य सर्वेक्षण (एनएफएचएस-6) में पाया गया कि 15 वर्ष और उससे अधिक उम्र की 17.8% महिलाओं और 20.9% पुरुषों में उच्च रक्त शर्करा थी या वे इसके लिए दवा ले रहे थे, जो 2019-21 में आयोजित एनएफएचएस-5 में 13.5% और 15.6% प्रतिशत से अधिक है।।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 What polluted air adds to India’s rising blood sugar

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 10:50:00 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India’s blood-sugar readings are climbing, and studies from Tamil Nadu and Delhi link type 2 diabetes to dirty air, outdoors and in smoky kitchens, inside. In a year when cooking gas ran short, however, the national health survey left clean cooking fuel out of its fact sheets. The link is there, the data is missing

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Chennai breathes far cleaner air than Delhi. A study that followed 12,064 adults in the two cities put the typical yearly level of fine particles around Chennai homes between 2010 and 2016 at 40.2 micrograms per cubic metre, just above the national standard of 40, against 101.5 in Delhi. In both cities, the dirtier a person’s air, the likelier they were to develop type 2 diabetes .

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The World Health Organization’s theme for World Diabetes Day, on November 14 this year, is early action. The sixth National Family Health Survey (NFHS-6), carried out in 2023-24, found 17.8% of women and 20.9% of men aged 15 and above had high blood sugar or were on medicine for it, up from 13.5% and 15.6% per cent in NFHS-5, conducted in 2019-21. In Chennai district, nearly 3 in 10 women fall in the group.

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "What polluted air adds to India’s rising blood sugar", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. India’s blood-sugar readings are climbing, and studies from Tamil Nadu and Delhi link type 2 diabetes to dirty air, outdoors and in smoky kitchens,...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'What polluted air adds to India’s rising blood s' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'What polluted air adds to India’s rising bloo' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'What polluted air adds to India’s rising bloo' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "India’s blood-sugar readings are climbing, and studies from Tamil Nadu and Delhi link type 2 diabetes to dirty air, outdoors and in smoky kitchens,..." (Hinglish Arth: भारत की रक्त-शर्करा रीडिंग बढ़ रही है, और तमिलनाडु और दिल्ली के अध्ययन टाइप 2 मधुमेह को गंदी हवा, बाहर और धुएँ वाली रसोई, अंदर से जोड़ते हैं।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "What polluted air adds to India’s rising blood sugar"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. In Chennai district, nearly 3 in 10 women fall in the group.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "In Chennai district, nearly 3 in 10 women fall in the group." (Hinglish Arth: चेन्नई जिले में, लगभग 10 में से 3 महिलाएँ समूह में आती हैं।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: NFHS-6 data puts the rate of Caesarean sections in West Bengal at 44.5%, nearly double the 2015-16 level and significantly higher than the national average of 27.2%. Private facilities handle about 3 in 10 births but perform almost 6 in 10 of the operations

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: On September 29, 2015, a memo went out from Swasthya Bhawan, the West Bengal Health Department’s headquarters in Salt Lake, to every medical college principal and every district’s chief medical officer of health. Its subject was a concern the Union Health Ministry had raised about rising Caesarean sections rates, especially where the operation was not medically needed.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The memo enclosed a statement the World Health Organization (WHO) had issued that April. It suggested that chief medical officers, who license private clinics, carry out periodic “prescription audits” of Caesareans in private and government facilities.

📰 Why West Bengal’s C-Sections, at nearly 1 in 2 births, demand a hard look

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 10:44:28 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: NFHS-6 data puts the rate of Caesarean sections in West Bengal at 44.5%, nearly double the 2015-16 level and significantly higher than the national average of 27.2%. Private facilities handle about 3 in 10 births but perform almost 6 in 10 of the operations

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: On September 29, 2015, a memo went out from Swasthya Bhawan, the West Bengal Health Department’s headquarters in Salt Lake, to every medical college principal and every district’s chief medical officer of health. Its subject was a concern the Union Health Ministry had raised about rising Caesarean sections rates, especially where the operation was not medically needed.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The memo enclosed a statement the World Health Organization (WHO) had issued that April. It suggested that chief medical officers, who license private clinics, carry out periodic “prescription audits” of Caesareans in private and government facilities.

articles.title: Narendra Modi will not remain PM after one-on-one debate with me, says Rahul Gandhi
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Rahul Gandhi has repeatedly challenged Narendra Modi to an open debate and earlier claimed that it would take him just five minutes to establish that the Prime Minister was a “traitor”.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Friday (November 13, 2026) repeated his debate dare to Prime Minister Narendra Modi and claimed that Mr. Modi will not remain in office after a one-on-one exchange with him. Responding to a question during an 'Ask Me' session on Instagram about why he was insisting on a public debate when the BJP has said that the exchange can take place in Parliament, Mr. Gandhi said he was not allowed to speak in the House, and his microphone was even switched off. "You did not let me talk on the farm bills, vote chori, SIR, China, on (Gen) Naravane's book, Epstein. I want a one-on-one debate. I don't want a debate entailing long speeches," the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha said. "I want that Narendra Modi makes allegations against me and I do the same to him. He can come; there will be a table, on one side there will be Narendra Modi ji and on the other side, it would be me," Mr. Gandhi said. He added that he had no objection if Adani Group chairperson Gautam Adani or RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat was appointed as the Judge for the debate. "But I guarantee that the Prime Minister will not remain the PM after a one-on-one debate with me," Mr. Gandhi said. Mr. Gandhi has repeatedly challenged Mr. Modi to an open debate and earlier claimed that it would take him just five minutes to establish that the Prime Minister was a "traitor". The BJP leaders have scoffed at Mr. Gandhi's challenge, alleging that he has been running away from debates in Parliament.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has said that while Mr. Gandhi is asking the Prime Minister to choose the venue for a debate, there already exists one in Parliament and called on him to show "some seriousness and responsibility" as the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Narendra Modi will not remain PM after one-on-one debate with me, says Rahul Gandhi

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 11:27:21 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Rahul Gandhi has repeatedly challenged Narendra Modi to an open debate and earlier claimed that it would take him just five minutes to establish that the Prime Minister was a “traitor”.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Friday (November 13, 2026) repeated his debate dare to Prime Minister Narendra Modi and claimed that Mr. Modi will not remain in office after a one-on-one exchange with him. Responding to a question during an 'Ask Me' session on Instagram about why he was insisting on a public debate when the BJP has said that the exchange can take place in Parliament, Mr. Gandhi said he was not allowed to speak in the House, and his microphone was even switched off. "You did not let me talk on the farm bills, vote chori, SIR, China, on (Gen) Naravane's book, Epstein. I want a one-on-one debate. I don't want a debate entailing long speeches," the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha said. "I want that Narendra Modi makes allegations against me and I do the same to him. He can come; there will be a table, on one side there will be Narendra Modi ji and on the other side, it would be me," Mr. Gandhi said. He added that he had no objection if Adani Group chairperson Gautam Adani or RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat was appointed as the Judge for the debate. "But I guarantee that the Prime Minister will not remain the PM after a one-on-one debate with me," Mr. Gandhi said. Mr. Gandhi has repeatedly challenged Mr. Modi to an open debate and earlier claimed that it would take him just five minutes to establish that the Prime Minister was a "traitor". The BJP leaders have scoffed at Mr. Gandhi's challenge, alleging that he has been running away from debates in Parliament.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has said that while Mr. Gandhi is asking the Prime Minister to choose the venue for a debate, there already exists one in Parliament and called on him to show "some seriousness and responsibility" as the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Opposition (Noun)
विरोध — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Opposition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Objection (Noun)
आपत्ति — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Objection' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Narendra Modi will not remain PM after one-on-one debate with me, says Rahul Gandhi", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?

D. The author contends that 'Narendra Modi will not remain PM after one-on' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

articles.title: Modi in Bengaluru: PM participates in Prashanti Kutiram celebrations, to inaugurate Namma Metro Pink Line | LIVE
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: PM Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the Pink Line at around 12.45 p.m. today. He will flag off the metro service and take a ride on the newly inaugurated stretch

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Bengaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express will be the longest-duration Vande Bharat of all 82 services in the country. Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Goa Vande Bharat: Route, timings, ticket prices and more Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat: Check Route, timings, and ticket prices Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat: Check Route, timings, and ticket prices PM Narendra Modi said he was getting the opportunity to experience the wonderful energy of yoga in Bengaluru. He said Karnataka had been a centre of yoga for centuries, and several yoga teachers and scholars had been born here and enriched the tradition. He also cited Kannada cinema legend Dr. Rajkumar as an example of personalities who had contributed to yoga alongside their work in the world of art. Prime Minister Narendra Modi digitally laid the foundation stone for the Golden Jubilee Administrative Block of S-VYASA University and digitally inaugurated the university’s Thiruvananthapuram off-campus. He also released six books authored by H.V. Sheshadri, whose works in Kannada have been translated into Hindi and English, as part of his birth centenary celebrations. The event has brought together two occasions, says RSS General Secretary Dattatreya Hosabale - the golden jubilee celebrations of S-VYASA University’s Prashanti Kutiram and the birth centenary of former RSS General Secretary H.V. Sheshadri, who had been a source of guidance to swayamsevaks like him. He said that countless people, including himself, had been associated with H.V. Sheshadri over the years. Prime Minister Narendra Modi, too, had been closely acquainted with Mr. Sheshadri. Mr. Hosabale said Mr. Sheshadri, after completing his M.Sc., worked as a teacher for a short period before dedicating himself to nation-building through the RSS, where he became a swayamsevak (volunteer).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: As an RSS swayamsevak and later a pracharak (full-time worker), Mr. Sheshadri held various responsibilities. He also served as the RSS Sarkaryavah (General Secretary) for 13 years, Mr. Hosabale said.
