🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Microsoft Outage LIVE: Microsoft outage enters second day; company says not aware of malicious activity

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 01:22:21 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Microsoft explained that a portion of its infrastructure was 'experiencing elevated load' which it said was 'likely contributing to the connectivity errors'

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: Software giant Microsoft is facing a widespread outage affecting users of its Outlook email service, as well as its other workplace products. Thousands of Microsoft users in India awakened on Friday (November 13, 2026) to find their inboxes inaccessible, losing hours of productivity. According to DownDetector, over 100,000 users had initially registered complaints about Microsoft Outlook.​ Microsoft Outage: Why did Microsoft Outlook and other products go offline globally? Microsoft shared on X on November 13 that a portion of infrastructure was experiencing elevated load across multiple regions, and this could likely be contributing to the connectivity errors. ​ Microsoft shared on X on November 13 that a portion of infrastructure was experiencing elevated load across multiple regions, and this could likely be contributing to the connectivity errors. Microsoft’s workplace services, including Outlook and Teams, remained disrupted for users in India and elsewhere on Friday (November 13, 2026), a day after a global outage began, with the company saying it was still working to pinpoint the cause and is not aware of any malicious activity behind it. Microsoft’s service health page showed “service degradation” for Microsoft 365 business and enterprise customers as well as its consumer products, as of an update at 11.16 am India time on Friday (November 13, 2026). The company said it was pursuing multiple workstreams to pinpoint the underlying cause of a traffic influx and to recover its backend servers. “As of now, we are not aware of any malicious activity that is causing this incident,” it said, adding that full details of the root cause would be shared in a post-incident report once the issue is mitigated. Microsoft said Thursday (November 13, 2026) that it was not aware of any “malicious activity” behind the hours-long disruption of its Outlook services. “As of now, we are not aware of any malicious activity that is causing this incident. We will continue to treat this incident with urgency and priority until full resolution,” Microsoft said. “For a city whose economy runs on serving global clients, [the outage] is no minor inconvenience,” Sambratha Shetty, Chief Operating Officer (COO), Synergia Foundation, said. “Bengaluru’s IT firms, startups and global capability centres coordinate across time zones through email, Teams calls and shared files. When those stop, client deliveries slip, support queues pile up, and teams sit idle. For outsourcing contracts bound by strict service-level agreements, even a few hours of downtime can mean penalties and strained client trust.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Bengaluru’s tech leaders should treat cloud failure as certain, not hypothetical. That means backup communication channels, multi-vendor setups and regularly tested continuity plans. The city that builds resilient systems for the world must build them for itself,” the COO said.

articles.title: COP31: Himalayan flash floods should push all to act ‘faster and fairer’ on climate change: UN climate chief
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: “The glacial collapse and flash floods in the Himalayas this year are a devastating reminder of how fragile these mountain environments can be, particularly the Hindu Kush Himalayas,” UNFCCC Executive Secretary Simon Stiell said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The glacial collapse and flash floods in the Himalayas this year should push everyone to act "faster and fairer" on climate change, a top United Nations official said. Responding to a question on the issue of the Himalayas on the sidelines of the UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya,Turkiye, United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) Executive Secretary Simon Stiell told PTI that transitioning away from fossil fuels in a just, orderly and equitable manner, along with tripling adaptation finance, are key to resolving the crisis. “The glacial collapse and flash floods in the Himalayas this year are a devastating reminder of how fragile these mountain environments can be, particularly the Hindu Kush Himalayas. For years, scientists and local communities have been warning that the Himalayas are at huge risk from climate change. What is happening in the Himalayas should push us to act faster and fairer on climate change,” he said. Proposals by Nepal and Bhutan, and separately by Kyrgyzstan, to secure formal agenda items on mountain-related issues at the 31st UN failed to secure the backing of major negotiating blocs. COP31 leaders urge focus on climate action despite global conflicts World leaders take stage at COP31 but big names missing Highlighting that global heating is caused by humanity still burning huge amounts of coal, oil and gas and destroying forests, the UNFCCC Executive Secretary recalled COP28 in the UAE, where all countries agreed to transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems in a just, orderly and equitable manner. He stated that the agreement must be delivered in full, and that it is equally essential to make faster progress on helping nations adapt to climate impacts and build their resilience, especially vulnerable nations that did practically nothing to contribute to the climate crisis. “That means delivering in full on the tripling of adaptation finance agreed at COP30 in Brazil last year. Full delivery on all existing financial commitments by developed economies is also essential, as is boosting access to finance for those who need it most, especially those vulnerable developing nations who did the least to cause the global crisis,” Mr. Stiell told PTI .

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: When asked how climate-vulnerable nations can trust a platform like COP given that the agenda on tripling adaptation finance failed to be formally adopted, he said that the Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage (FRLD) has been set up to provide support to vulnerable developing countries, adding that the crisis in the Himalayas shows why the COP process is critical.

📰 COP31: Himalayan flash floods should push all to act ‘faster and fairer’ on climate change: UN climate chief

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 01:15:49 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: “The glacial collapse and flash floods in the Himalayas this year are a devastating reminder of how fragile these mountain environments can be, particularly the Hindu Kush Himalayas,” UNFCCC Executive Secretary Simon Stiell said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The glacial collapse and flash floods in the Himalayas this year should push everyone to act "faster and fairer" on climate change, a top United Nations official said. Responding to a question on the issue of the Himalayas on the sidelines of the UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya,Turkiye, United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) Executive Secretary Simon Stiell told PTI that transitioning away from fossil fuels in a just, orderly and equitable manner, along with tripling adaptation finance, are key to resolving the crisis. “The glacial collapse and flash floods in the Himalayas this year are a devastating reminder of how fragile these mountain environments can be, particularly the Hindu Kush Himalayas. For years, scientists and local communities have been warning that the Himalayas are at huge risk from climate change. What is happening in the Himalayas should push us to act faster and fairer on climate change,” he said. Proposals by Nepal and Bhutan, and separately by Kyrgyzstan, to secure formal agenda items on mountain-related issues at the 31st UN failed to secure the backing of major negotiating blocs. COP31 leaders urge focus on climate action despite global conflicts World leaders take stage at COP31 but big names missing Highlighting that global heating is caused by humanity still burning huge amounts of coal, oil and gas and destroying forests, the UNFCCC Executive Secretary recalled COP28 in the UAE, where all countries agreed to transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems in a just, orderly and equitable manner. He stated that the agreement must be delivered in full, and that it is equally essential to make faster progress on helping nations adapt to climate impacts and build their resilience, especially vulnerable nations that did practically nothing to contribute to the climate crisis. “That means delivering in full on the tripling of adaptation finance agreed at COP30 in Brazil last year. Full delivery on all existing financial commitments by developed economies is also essential, as is boosting access to finance for those who need it most, especially those vulnerable developing nations who did the least to cause the global crisis,” Mr. Stiell told PTI .

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: When asked how climate-vulnerable nations can trust a platform like COP given that the agenda on tripling adaptation finance failed to be formally adopted, he said that the Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage (FRLD) has been set up to provide support to vulnerable developing countries, adding that the crisis in the Himalayas shows why the COP process is critical.

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The glacial collapse and flash floods in the Himalayas this year should push everyone to act "faster and fairer" on climate change, a top United Nations official said. Responding to a question on the issue of the Himalayas on the sidelines of the UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya,Turkiye, United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) Executive Secretary Simon Stiell told PTI that transitioning away from fossil fuels in a just, orderly and equitable manner, along with tripling adaptation finance, are key to resolving the crisis. “The glacial collapse and flash floods in the Himalayas this year are a devastating reminder of how fragile these mountain environments can be, particularly the Hindu Kush Himalayas. For years, scientists and local communities have been warning that the Himalayas are at huge risk from climate change. What is happening in the Himalayas should push us to act faster and fairer on climate change,” he said. Proposals by Nepal and Bhutan, and separately by Kyrgyzstan, to secure formal agenda items on mountain-related issues at the 31st UN failed to secure the backing of major negotiating blocs. COP31 leaders urge focus on climate action despite global conflicts World leaders take stage at COP31 but big names missing Highlighting that global heating is caused by humanity still burning huge amounts of coal, oil and gas and destroying forests, the UNFCCC Executive Secretary recalled COP28 in the UAE, where all countries agreed to transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems in a just, orderly and equitable manner. He stated that the agreement must be delivered in full, and that it is equally essential to make faster progress on helping nations adapt to climate impacts and build their resilience, especially vulnerable nations that did practically nothing to contribute to the climate crisis. “That means delivering in full on the tripling of adaptation finance agreed at COP30 in Brazil last year. Full delivery on all existing financial commitments by developed economies is also essential, as is boosting access to finance for those who need it most, especially those vulnerable developing nations who did the least to cause the global crisis,” Mr. Stiell told PTI .
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: When asked how climate-vulnerable nations can trust a platform like COP given that the agenda on tripling adaptation finance failed to be formally adopted, he said that the Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage (FRLD) has been set up to provide support to vulnerable developing countries, adding that the crisis in the Himalayas shows why the COP process is critical.

articles.title: U.S. lawmakers summon Nvidia former CEO after affair with suspected spy

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: U.S. lawmakers have called Jensen Huang, an architect of the artificial intelligence boom, to face their questions in December after the Nvidia ex-CEO quit over extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy. Nvidia's new interim CEO following Jensen Huang’s exit Former Nvidia CEO Huang had a relationship with a second employee, sources say Untangling Nvidia chief Jensen Huang’s Chinese spy connection It joins a call for a closed-door interview with the leather-jacketed, 63-year-old Huang on December 1 by three House of Representatives committees, on threat of subpoena. Huang, who has been married to his wife Lori for over 40 years, admitted Sunday to an affair, reportedly with Alice Huang, a former senior executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed. The two are not related.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: U.S. intelligence reportedly circulated a memo this spring alleging she was an asset of China’s Ministry of State Security. Beijing has rejected the allegations.

articles.title: Europe pushes for seat at Ukraine peace talks but lacks unified voice
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Ukraine is eager for backup from its European allies, as it's reluctant to leave the talks solely in the hands of a U.S. administration that has often seemed to lean toward Moscow's views

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: European nations are seeking an envoy to represent them in talks on ending the Russia-Ukraine war, concerned that a U.S.-backed process will leave them sidelined as Moscow and Washington decide the fate of a conflict that has roiled the continent. Whether that should be one individual or more, and who it might be, is being debated as leaders from the 27-nation European Union meet Friday (November 13, 2026) at a summit in Dublin. Senior EU officials and politicians have been suggested, but there is not yet a consensus. What the job might entail is also unclear and contested. But there is broad agreement among governments from the U.K. to Ukraine on the need for Europe to join the ongoing negotiations involving Moscow, Kyiv and Washington. Ukraine is eager for backup from its European allies, as it's reluctant to leave the talks solely in the hands of a U.S. administration that has often seemed to lean toward Moscow's views. Russia does not want European countries involved in direct negotiations, complaining they are financing and supplying Ukraine's military effort. And the Europeans do not trust U.S. President Donald Trump to negotiate on their behalf after a series of tense standoffs over trade, Greenland and conflicts in Iran and Ukraine. “Without Europeans, there is no support for Ukraine,” French President Emmanuel Macron said at the European Political Community meeting in Dublin. “There is no more U.S. support." “At the end of the day, we will be the ones to define and decide for our future security as Europeans,” he said. European leaders fear Russian President Vladimir Putin will press Mr. Trump to back a peace settlement that weakens not just Ukraine but broader European security. Putin has demanded that NATO troops be pulled back from Russia's borders and that no European forces be deployed in Ukraine. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham rejected the idea that Europe was being sidelined during peace negotiations, saying “there are European voices in the room.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “All the leaders I've spoken to today are determined to put a bit of a ring of steel around Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as part of all of this to back him up to the hilt, and that's what we will do,” he said.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Europe pushes for seat at Ukraine peace talks but lacks unified voice

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 01:11:12 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Ukraine is eager for backup from its European allies, as it's reluctant to leave the talks solely in the hands of a U.S. administration that has often seemed to lean toward Moscow's views

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: European nations are seeking an envoy to represent them in talks on ending the Russia-Ukraine war, concerned that a U.S.-backed process will leave them sidelined as Moscow and Washington decide the fate of a conflict that has roiled the continent. Whether that should be one individual or more, and who it might be, is being debated as leaders from the 27-nation European Union meet Friday (November 13, 2026) at a summit in Dublin. Senior EU officials and politicians have been suggested, but there is not yet a consensus. What the job might entail is also unclear and contested. But there is broad agreement among governments from the U.K. to Ukraine on the need for Europe to join the ongoing negotiations involving Moscow, Kyiv and Washington. Ukraine is eager for backup from its European allies, as it's reluctant to leave the talks solely in the hands of a U.S. administration that has often seemed to lean toward Moscow's views. Russia does not want European countries involved in direct negotiations, complaining they are financing and supplying Ukraine's military effort. And the Europeans do not trust U.S. President Donald Trump to negotiate on their behalf after a series of tense standoffs over trade, Greenland and conflicts in Iran and Ukraine. “Without Europeans, there is no support for Ukraine,” French President Emmanuel Macron said at the European Political Community meeting in Dublin. “There is no more U.S. support." “At the end of the day, we will be the ones to define and decide for our future security as Europeans,” he said. European leaders fear Russian President Vladimir Putin will press Mr. Trump to back a peace settlement that weakens not just Ukraine but broader European security. Putin has demanded that NATO troops be pulled back from Russia's borders and that no European forces be deployed in Ukraine. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham rejected the idea that Europe was being sidelined during peace negotiations, saying “there are European voices in the room.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “All the leaders I've spoken to today are determined to put a bit of a ring of steel around Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as part of all of this to back him up to the hilt, and that's what we will do,” he said.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A pooled analysis of the studies found that about two-thirds of participants receiving the drug retatrutide experienced at least a 50% reduction in knee pain, compared with 38% of those receiving a placebo

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In a study published in the New England Journal of Medicine , researchers in the U.S., Canada, Australia and the United Kingdom, showed that treatment with the drug retatrutide, may be useful for the treatment of painful knee arthritis in people with obesity.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In two phase 3 trials, adults without diabetes who had painful knee osteoarthritis and a body mass index (BMI) of at least 27 were randomly assigned to receive once-weekly subcutaneous retatrutide.

articles.title: EU leaders seek to tackle challenges at first ever AI summit
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The meeting comes amid mounting ⁠worries about a technology that promises to transform industries and societies but in recent months has caused alarm after a series of incidents involving rogue ‌AI agents

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: European Union leaders gather in Dublin on Friday (November 13, 2026) for their first ​ever summit on Artificial Intelligence (AI), to debate how the bloc can catch ‌up with the United States and China and tackle ​funding issues and other problems. The meeting comes amid mounting ⁠worries about a technology that promises to transform industries and societies but in recent months has caused alarm after a series of incidents involving rogue ‌AI agents. There was further turmoil this week with the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang , leaving the industry ‌without its biggest champion. Leaders in Dublin will also ‌assess ⁠how to overcome other problems such as red tape and ⁠set guardrails. “Given the rapid pace of AI development, I believe that a first dedicated discussion, at leaders’ level, is now needed on the opportunities presented by ​AI, as well as ‌on its transformative effect on our economies and societies,” European Council President Antonio Costa wrote in an invitation letter to EU leaders last week. Mistral AI chief executive Arthur Mensch and Nobel Prize-winning ‌AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton will brief EU leaders. Europe will ​have to ramp up its efforts if it is to be an AI player. An initiative known ⁠as the Chips Act, implemented three years ago looks likely to fall short of its goal to attract advanced manufacturing and double the ‌bloc’s share of the global chip market to 20% by 2030. A plan to build seven AI gigafactories to house advanced AI processors, software, cloud technology, high-speed connectivity and data centres under one roof has yet to fully take off due to the fight among EU countries over spending on competitiveness in the ‌bloc’s 2028-2034 budget. In addition to AI, leaders are also set to discuss ​Ukraine, which has since been added as a second major topic to the agenda, a day after U.S. ⁠envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner flew into Dublin to meet Ukrainian ⁠President Volodymyr Zelenskiy following talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. EU leaders are likely to discuss European ‌involvement in peace negotiations and potential security guarantees the EU could offer in the event of a ceasefire, a senior EU ​official said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / science (general) / technology (general) / Europe

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 EU leaders seek to tackle challenges at first ever AI summit

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 12:17:16 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The meeting comes amid mounting ⁠worries about a technology that promises to transform industries and societies but in recent months has caused alarm after a series of incidents involving rogue ‌AI agents

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: European Union leaders gather in Dublin on Friday (November 13, 2026) for their first ​ever summit on Artificial Intelligence (AI), to debate how the bloc can catch ‌up with the United States and China and tackle ​funding issues and other problems. The meeting comes amid mounting ⁠worries about a technology that promises to transform industries and societies but in recent months has caused alarm after a series of incidents involving rogue ‌AI agents. There was further turmoil this week with the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang , leaving the industry ‌without its biggest champion. Leaders in Dublin will also ‌assess ⁠how to overcome other problems such as red tape and ⁠set guardrails. “Given the rapid pace of AI development, I believe that a first dedicated discussion, at leaders’ level, is now needed on the opportunities presented by ​AI, as well as ‌on its transformative effect on our economies and societies,” European Council President Antonio Costa wrote in an invitation letter to EU leaders last week. Mistral AI chief executive Arthur Mensch and Nobel Prize-winning ‌AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton will brief EU leaders. Europe will ​have to ramp up its efforts if it is to be an AI player. An initiative known ⁠as the Chips Act, implemented three years ago looks likely to fall short of its goal to attract advanced manufacturing and double the ‌bloc’s share of the global chip market to 20% by 2030. A plan to build seven AI gigafactories to house advanced AI processors, software, cloud technology, high-speed connectivity and data centres under one roof has yet to fully take off due to the fight among EU countries over spending on competitiveness in the ‌bloc’s 2028-2034 budget. In addition to AI, leaders are also set to discuss ​Ukraine, which has since been added as a second major topic to the agenda, a day after U.S. ⁠envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner flew into Dublin to meet Ukrainian ⁠President Volodymyr Zelenskiy following talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. EU leaders are likely to discuss European ‌involvement in peace negotiations and potential security guarantees the EU could offer in the event of a ceasefire, a senior EU ​official said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / science (general) / technology (general) / Europe

D. The author contends that 'EU leaders seek to tackle challenges at first' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: Who is Colette Kress? Nvidia's new interim CEO following Jensen Huang’s exit
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A 13-year Nvidia veteran, Colette Kress will lead the chipmaker whose processors power cutting-edge AI data centers and supercomputers, as the board weighs a longer-term successor.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nvidia co-founder and longtime chief executive Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday (November 13, 2026), following reports of two extramarital affairs, one involving an Nvidia executive who reported to him and another involving a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. While Mr. Huang apologised for being unfaithful and Nvidia investigates whether he was targeted by foreign intelligence, the chipmaker’s shares have tumbled more than 30% from their October peak. In a bid to reclaim control, Nvidia's finance chief, Colette Kress, will assume the role of interim CEO, taking over from Mr. Huang, the company announced on Thursday (November 12, 2026). This will put her in charge of the chipmaker whose processors ​power the world’s most advanced supercomputers and AI data centers. Ms. Kress is far from an outsider to the $4 trillion AI mammoth in the artificial intelligence industry. She joined Nvidia in September 2013 ​as executive vice president and chief financial officer and has held the post since. ​She has appeared alongside Mr. Huang on the company’s quarterly earnings calls. Prior to joining Nvidia, Ms. Kress worked at Cisco, Microsoft and Texas Instruments. Nvidia’s ⁠revenue was $4.13 billion in the fiscal year she joined and $215.9 billion in fiscal 2026. Before Nvidia, Ms. Kress spent nearly 25 years building her career at some of the tech sector’s biggest giants. She started out with an eight-year stint in finance roles at Texas Instruments before moving to Microsoft, where she worked from 1997 to 2010 and became CFO of the server amd Tools division. She moved to Cisco (CSCO.O) in 2010 as senior vice president ​and chief financial officer of its Business Technology and Operations Finance organisation, where she was ​responsible for financial strategy and business development. She left for Nvidia in 2013, eventhough Nvidia was the smallest company she had ever worked for. She holds a bachelor’s degree finance from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University. Nvidia’s stock rise over the past decade made Ms. Kress one fo the wealthiest executives in the world. Forbes ranked her No. 32 on its 2026 list of America’s richest self-made women. At the stock’s October peak, her Nvidia holdings pushed her personal net worth past $1 billion, though the recent market slide reduced her company shares to roughly $750 million. She was awarded a pay package worth $14 million for Nvidia’s fiscal 2026, according to Nvidia’s proxy statement. This also includes restricted stock units. Executive officers at Nvidia are employed at will and have no ​individual employment, severance or change-in-control agreements, according to the company’s proxy ​statement. Nvidia ⁠has said in earlier filings that many of its peer companies offer such agreements.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In a statement on Thursday, Ms. Kress said that Nvidia’s “strength has always come from its people” and that she would build on the “extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years.”

hinglishTracks.en: A 13-year Nvidia veteran, Colette Kress will lead the chipmaker whose processors power cutting-edge AI data centers and supercomputers, as the board weighs a longer-term successor.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — 13-वर्षीय एनवीडिया अनुभवी, कोलेट क्रेस उस चिप निर्माता का नेतृत्व करेंगे, जिसके प्रोसेसर अत्याधुनिक एआई डेटा केंद्रों और सुपर कंप्यूटरों को शक्ति प्रदान करते हैं, क्योंकि बोर्ड एक दीर्घकालिक उत्तराधिकारी का वजन रखता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Nvidia co-founder and longtime chief executive Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday (November 13, 2026), following reports of two extramarital affairs, one involving an Nvidia executive who reported to him and another involving a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एनवीडिया के सह-संस्थापक और लंबे समय तक मुख्य कार्यकारी जेन्सेन हुआंग ने दो विवाहेतर संबंधों की रिपोर्टों के बाद गुरुवार (13 नवंबर, 2026) को पद छोड़ दिया, जिनमें से एक एनवीडिया कार्यकारी से जुड़ा था जिसने उन्हें रिपोर्ट किया था और दूसरे में चीनी जासूस होने का आरोप लगाने वाली एक महिला शामिल थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Extramarital' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Extramarital' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Huang apologised for being unfaithful and Nvidia investigates whether he was targeted by foreign intelligence, the chipmaker’s shares have tumbled more than 30% from their October peak.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हुआंग ने बेवफा होने के लिए माफी मांगी और एनवीडिया ने जांच की कि क्या उसे विदेशी खुफिया विभाग ने निशाना बनाया था, चिपमेकर के शेयर अक्टूबर के शिखर से 30% से अधिक गिर गए हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Intelligence' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Intelligence' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: In a bid to reclaim control, Nvidia's finance chief, Colette Kress, will assume the role of interim CEO, taking over from Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — नियंत्रण पुनः प्राप्त करने के प्रयास में, एनवीडिया के वित्त प्रमुख, कोलेट क्रेस, श्रीमान से पदभार ग्रहण करते हुए, अंतरिम सीईओ की भूमिका निभाएंगे।।

hinglishTracks.en: Huang, the company announced on Thursday (November 12, 2026).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हुआंग, कंपनी ने गुरुवार (12 नवंबर, 2026) को घोषणा की।।

hinglishTracks.en: This will put her in charge of the chipmaker whose processors ​power the world’s most advanced supercomputers and AI data centers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह उन्हें उस चिप निर्माता का प्रभारी बना देगा जिसके प्रोसेसर दुनिया के सबसे उन्नत सुपर कंप्यूटर और एआई डेटा केंद्रों को शक्ति प्रदान करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Kress is far from an outsider to the $4 trillion AI mammoth in the artificial intelligence industry.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता उद्योग में क्रेस एक बाहरी व्यक्ति से $4 ट्रिलियन एआई विशाल तक नहीं है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Intelligence' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Intelligence' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: She joined Nvidia in September 2013 ​as executive vice president and chief financial officer and has held the post since.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — वह सितंबर 2013 में कार्यकारी उपाध्यक्ष और मुख्य वित्तीय अधिकारी के रूप में एनवीडिया में शामिल हुईं और तब से इस पद पर हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: ​She has appeared alongside Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ​वह मिस्टर के साथ नजर आ चुकी हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Huang on the company’s quarterly earnings calls.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — कंपनी की तिमाही आय कॉल पर हुआंग।।

hinglishTracks.en: Prior to joining Nvidia, Ms.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एनवीडिया में शामिल होने से पहले, सुश्री.।

hinglishTracks.en: Kress worked at Cisco, Microsoft and Texas Instruments.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — क्रेस ने सिस्को, माइक्रोसॉफ्ट और टेक्सास इंस्ट्रूमेंट्स में काम किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Nvidia’s ⁠revenue was $4.13 billion in the fiscal year she joined and $215.9 billion in fiscal 2026.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जिस वित्तीय वर्ष में वह शामिल हुई उसमें एनवीडिया का राजस्व $4.13 बिलियन था और वित्तीय वर्ष 2026 में $215.9 बिलियन था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Fiscal' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: राजकोषीय — सरकार की कुल कमाई (टैक्स) और कुल सरकारी खर्च (बजट) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Budgetary, Financial, Revenue-related और Antonyms हैं: Non-financial, Private।

hinglishTracks.en: Before Nvidia, Ms.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एनवीडिया से पहले, सुश्री।

hinglishTracks.en: Kress spent nearly 25 years building her career at some of the tech sector’s biggest giants.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — क्रेस ने तकनीकी क्षेत्र की कुछ सबसे बड़ी दिग्गज कंपनियों में अपना करियर बनाने में लगभग 25 साल बिताए।।

hinglishTracks.en: She started out with an eight-year stint in finance roles at Texas Instruments before moving to Microsoft, where she worked from 1997 to 2010 and became CFO of the server amd Tools division.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — माइक्रोसॉफ्ट में जाने से पहले उन्होंने टेक्सास इंस्ट्रूमेंट्स में वित्त भूमिकाओं में आठ साल का कार्यकाल शुरू किया, जहां उन्होंने 1997 से 2010 तक काम किया और सर्वर एएमडी टूल्स डिवीजन की सीएफओ बन गईं।।

hinglishTracks.en: She moved to Cisco (CSCO.O) in 2010 as senior vice president ​and chief financial officer of its Business Technology and Operations Finance organisation, where she was ​responsible for financial strategy and business development.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — वह 2010 में सिस्को (CSCO.O) में इसके बिजनेस टेक्नोलॉजी और ऑपरेशंस फाइनेंस संगठन के वरिष्ठ उपाध्यक्ष और मुख्य वित्तीय अधिकारी के रूप में चली गईं, जहां वह वित्तीय रणनीति और व्यवसाय विकास के लिए जिम्मेदार थीं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Organisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Organisation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: She left for Nvidia in 2013, eventhough Nvidia was the smallest company she had ever worked for.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — वह 2013 में एनवीडिया के लिए रवाना हो गईं, हालांकि एनवीडिया सबसे छोटी कंपनी थी जिसके लिए उन्होंने कभी काम किया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: She holds a bachelor’s degree finance from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उनके पास एरिज़ोना विश्वविद्यालय से वित्त में स्नातक की डिग्री और दक्षिणी मेथोडिस्ट विश्वविद्यालय से एमबीए है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Nvidia’s stock rise over the past decade made Ms.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — पिछले एक दशक में एनवीडिया के स्टॉक में वृद्धि ने सुश्री को...।

hinglishTracks.en: Kress one fo the wealthiest executives in the world.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — क्रेस दुनिया के सबसे धनी अधिकारियों में से एक है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Forbes ranked her No.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — फोर्ब्स ने उन्हें नंबर दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: 32 on its 2026 list of America’s richest self-made women.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — अमेरिका की सबसे अमीर स्व-निर्मित महिलाओं की 2026 की सूची में 32वें स्थान पर।।

hinglishTracks.en: At the stock’s October peak, her Nvidia holdings pushed her personal net worth past $1 billion, though the recent market slide reduced her company shares to roughly $750 million.

📰 Who is Colette Kress? Nvidia's new interim CEO following Jensen Huang’s exit

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 12:04:22 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A 13-year Nvidia veteran, Colette Kress will lead the chipmaker whose processors power cutting-edge AI data centers and supercomputers, as the board weighs a longer-term successor.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nvidia co-founder and longtime chief executive Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday (November 13, 2026), following reports of two extramarital affairs, one involving an Nvidia executive who reported to him and another involving a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. While Mr. Huang apologised for being unfaithful and Nvidia investigates whether he was targeted by foreign intelligence, the chipmaker’s shares have tumbled more than 30% from their October peak. In a bid to reclaim control, Nvidia's finance chief, Colette Kress, will assume the role of interim CEO, taking over from Mr. Huang, the company announced on Thursday (November 12, 2026). This will put her in charge of the chipmaker whose processors ​power the world’s most advanced supercomputers and AI data centers. Ms. Kress is far from an outsider to the $4 trillion AI mammoth in the artificial intelligence industry. She joined Nvidia in September 2013 ​as executive vice president and chief financial officer and has held the post since. ​She has appeared alongside Mr. Huang on the company’s quarterly earnings calls. Prior to joining Nvidia, Ms. Kress worked at Cisco, Microsoft and Texas Instruments. Nvidia’s ⁠revenue was $4.13 billion in the fiscal year she joined and $215.9 billion in fiscal 2026. Before Nvidia, Ms. Kress spent nearly 25 years building her career at some of the tech sector’s biggest giants. She started out with an eight-year stint in finance roles at Texas Instruments before moving to Microsoft, where she worked from 1997 to 2010 and became CFO of the server amd Tools division. She moved to Cisco (CSCO.O) in 2010 as senior vice president ​and chief financial officer of its Business Technology and Operations Finance organisation, where she was ​responsible for financial strategy and business development. She left for Nvidia in 2013, eventhough Nvidia was the smallest company she had ever worked for. She holds a bachelor’s degree finance from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University. Nvidia’s stock rise over the past decade made Ms. Kress one fo the wealthiest executives in the world. Forbes ranked her No. 32 on its 2026 list of America’s richest self-made women. At the stock’s October peak, her Nvidia holdings pushed her personal net worth past $1 billion, though the recent market slide reduced her company shares to roughly $750 million. She was awarded a pay package worth $14 million for Nvidia’s fiscal 2026, according to Nvidia’s proxy statement. This also includes restricted stock units. Executive officers at Nvidia are employed at will and have no ​individual employment, severance or change-in-control agreements, according to the company’s proxy ​statement. Nvidia ⁠has said in earlier filings that many of its peer companies offer such agreements.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In a statement on Thursday, Ms. Kress said that Nvidia’s “strength has always come from its people” and that she would build on the “extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years.”

articles.title: What are the findings of the 2024 Hindu Kush Himalayas snow update? | Explained
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: What does the report by the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development highlight? How important is snow persistence? How much of a role does climate change play in river basins receiving low levels of snowmelt this year?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: T he Ganga river basin — India’s largest — reached a record low snow persistence in 2024, the Hindu Kush Himalaya snow update of the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD) has reported. The Brahmaputra and the Indus basins have suffered similarly, threatening water supply to millions of people. “Tragically this is yet another postcard from the frontlines of a climate crisis that is accelerating even beyond scientists’ projections and causing huge challenges in one of the most populated regions of the world,” Miriam Jackson, Cryosphere Lead at ICIMOD and a contributor to reports of the UN Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, told The Hindu . Snow persistence is the fraction of time snow is on the ground. When this snow melts, it provides water to people and ecosystems. In the river basins of the Hindu Kush Himalaya (HKH), snowmelt is the biggest source of water in the streams. Overall, it contributes 23% of the runoff to the region’s 12 major river basins every year. The HKH mountains extend around 3,500 km over eight countries — Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, China, India, Nepal, Myanmar, and Pakistan. These mountains are also called the “water towers of Asia” because they are the origins of 10 crucial river systems on the continent — Amu Darya, Indus, Ganga, Brahmaputra, Irrawaddy, Salween, Mekong, Yangtse, Yellow river, and Tarim. These river basins provide water to almost one-fourth of the world’s population and are a significant freshwater source for 240 million people in the HKH region. The authors of the 2024 HKH snow update analysed data from 2003 to 2024 and found significant fluctuations in snow persistence between November and April every year, when snow accumulates above ground. Based on this, they made grim predictions of lasting impact on the people in the region as well as those downstream of the river basins. In India, snow persistence in the Ganga, the Brahmaputra, and the Indus river basins dropped significantly in 2024. The Ganga river basin noted its lowest snow persistence in 22 years, 17% below the long-term historical average (also known as ‘normal’). The previous holder of this dubious distinction was 2018, when it was 15.2% below normal. In 2015, on the other hand, snow persistence was 25.6% above normal. Similarly, snow persistence in the Brahmaputra basin was 14.6% below normal in 2024. It was worse in 2021, when the average persistence was 15.5% below normal. In the Indus river basin, snow persistence fell 23.3% below normal this year although this was offset by excesses in parts of the lower altitudes. Outside India, the basin of the Amu Darya river — which flows through Central Asia — recorded its lowest snow persistence in 2024: 28.2% below normal. The figure for the Helmand river, an important source of drinking water for Iran and Afghanistan, was almost 32% below normal in 2024, beating a record set in 2018. Persistence in the part where the Mekong river originates in the Himalaya was only slightly below normal this time. (This river’s delta is Vietnam’s “rice bowl”.) The primary reason for the lower persistence in 2024 was weak western disturbances, ICIMOD remote sensing specialist and author of the report Sher Muhammad told The Hindu . “Due to changing climate and global warming, this pattern is becoming increasingly unstable. Although the exact mechanisms are not fully understood, global warming is thought to exacerbate prolonged and intense La Niña–El Niño conditions. These phases of a recurring climate pattern across the tropical Pacific Ocean significantly influence global weather patterns, including western disturbances,” he added. Western disturbances are low-pressure systems that originate over the Mediterranean Sea, the Caspian, and the Black Seas and bring rain and snow to the HKH region in winter. “The region where these storms originate experienced persistently high sea-surface temperatures,” Mr. Muhammad explained. “This disruption weakened and delayed the arrival of the western disturbance, resulting in reduced winter precipitation and snowfall in the HKH region. The pattern of high temperatures and altered weather systems explains both the record low snow persistence in 2024 and similar historical records.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “We have warned for years that the 1.5 degrees Celsius limit that governments signed up to in the Paris Agreement is not ambitious enough to protect the snow and ice, people and nature of the Hindu Kush Himalayas because the target is a global average, and the real temperature increase will be far higher here,” Ms. Jackson added.

(Hinglish Arth: इंटरनेशनल सेंटर फॉर इंटीग्रेटेड माउंटेन डेवलपमेंट की रिपोर्ट क्या उजागर करती है?)

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "What are the findings of the 2024 Hindu Kush Himalayas snow update? | Explained"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
“We have warned for years that the 1.5 degrees Celsius limit that governments signed up to in the Paris Agreement is not ambitious enough to protect...
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: “We have warned for years that the 1.5 degrees Celsius limit that governments signed up to in the Paris Agreement is not ambitious enough to protect...
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“We have warned for years that the 1.5 degrees Celsius limit that governments signed up to in the Paris Agreement is not ambitious enough to protect..." (Hinglish Arth: "हमने वर्षों से चेतावनी दी है कि सरकारों ने पेरिस समझौते में जिस 1.5 डिग्री सेल्सियस की सीमा पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं, वह हिंदू कुश हिमालय की बर्फ और बर्फ, लोगों और प्रकृति की रक्षा के लिए पर्याप्त महत्वाकांक्षी नहीं है क्योंकि)

hinglishTracks.en: What does the report by the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development highlight?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इंटरनेशनल सेंटर फॉर इंटीग्रेटेड माउंटेन डेवलपमेंट की रिपोर्ट क्या उजागर करती है?। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: How important is snow persistence?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — बर्फ का बने रहना कितना महत्वपूर्ण है?।

hinglishTracks.en: How much of a role does climate change play in river basins receiving low levels of snowmelt this year?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इस वर्ष बर्फ पिघलने का निम्न स्तर प्राप्त करने वाली नदी घाटियों में जलवायु परिवर्तन की कितनी भूमिका है?।

hinglishTracks.en: T he Ganga river basin — India’s largest — reached a record low snow persistence in 2024, the Hindu Kush Himalaya snow update of the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD) has reported.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इंटरनेशनल सेंटर फॉर इंटीग्रेटेड माउंटेन डेवलपमेंट (ICIMOD) के हिंदू कुश हिमालय स्नो अपडेट के अनुसार, गंगा नदी बेसिन - भारत का सबसे बड़ा - 2024 में रिकॉर्ड कम बर्फबारी स्तर पर पहुंच गया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The Brahmaputra and the Indus basins have suffered similarly, threatening water supply to millions of people.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ब्रह्मपुत्र और सिंधु घाटियों को भी इसी तरह नुकसान हुआ है, जिससे लाखों लोगों के लिए पानी की आपूर्ति खतरे में पड़ गई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Tragically this is yet another postcard from the frontlines of a climate crisis that is accelerating even beyond scientists’ projections and causing huge challenges in one of the most populated regions of the world,” Miriam Jackson, Cryosphere Lead at ICIMOD and a contributor to reports of the UN Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, told The Hindu .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — आईसीआईएमओडी में क्रायोस्फीयर लीड और जलवायु परिवर्तन पर संयुक्त राष्ट्र अंतर सरकारी पैनल की रिपोर्ट में योगदानकर्ता मिरियम जैक्सन ने द हिंदू को बताया, "दुख की बात है कि यह जलवायु संकट की अग्रिम पंक्ति का एक और पोस्टकार्ड है जो वैज्ञानिकों के अनुमानों से भी आगे बढ़ रहा है और दुनिया के सबसे अधिक आबादी वाले क्षेत्रों में बड़ी चुनौतियों का कारण बन रहा है।"। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Intergovernmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Intergovernmental' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Snow persistence is the fraction of time snow is on the ground.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — बर्फ की दृढ़ता उस समय का अंश है जब बर्फ जमीन पर होती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: When this snow melts, it provides water to people and ecosystems.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जब यह बर्फ पिघलती है, तो यह लोगों और पारिस्थितिक तंत्र को पानी प्रदान करती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: In the river basins of the Hindu Kush Himalaya (HKH), snowmelt is the biggest source of water in the streams.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हिंदू कुश हिमालय (एचकेएच) के नदी घाटियों में, जलधाराओं में पानी का सबसे बड़ा स्रोत बर्फ का पिघलना है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Overall, it contributes 23% of the runoff to the region’s 12 major river basins every year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — कुल मिलाकर, यह हर साल क्षेत्र की 12 प्रमुख नदी घाटियों में 23% अपवाह का योगदान देता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The HKH mountains extend around 3,500 km over eight countries — Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, China, India, Nepal, Myanmar, and Pakistan.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एचकेएच पर्वत आठ देशों - अफगानिस्तान, बांग्लादेश, भूटान, चीन, भारत, नेपाल, म्यांमार और पाकिस्तान - में लगभग 3,500 किमी तक फैला हुआ है।।

hinglishTracks.en: These mountains are also called the “water towers of Asia” because they are the origins of 10 crucial river systems on the continent — Amu Darya, Indus, Ganga, Brahmaputra, Irrawaddy, Salween, Mekong, Yangtse, Yellow river, and Tarim.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इन पहाड़ों को "एशिया के जल टावर" भी कहा जाता है क्योंकि ये महाद्वीप पर 10 महत्वपूर्ण नदी प्रणालियों - अमु दरिया, सिंधु, गंगा, ब्रह्मपुत्र, इरावदी, साल्विन, मेकांग, यांग्त्से, पीली नदी और तारिम का उद्गम स्थल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: These river basins provide water to almost one-fourth of the world’s population and are a significant freshwater source for 240 million people in the HKH region.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ये नदी घाटियाँ दुनिया की लगभग एक-चौथाई आबादी को पानी उपलब्ध कराती हैं और एचकेएच क्षेत्र के 240 मिलियन लोगों के लिए मीठे पानी का एक महत्वपूर्ण स्रोत हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The authors of the 2024 HKH snow update analysed data from 2003 to 2024 and found significant fluctuations in snow persistence between November and April every year, when snow accumulates above ground.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — 2024 एचकेएच स्नो अपडेट के लेखकों ने 2003 से 2024 तक के आंकड़ों का विश्लेषण किया और हर साल नवंबर और अप्रैल के बीच बर्फ की स्थिरता में महत्वपूर्ण उतार-चढ़ाव पाया, जब बर्फ जमीन के ऊपर जमा होती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Based on this, they made grim predictions of lasting impact on the people in the region as well as those downstream of the river basins.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसके आधार पर, उन्होंने क्षेत्र के लोगों के साथ-साथ नदी घाटियों के निचले हिस्से पर स्थायी प्रभाव की गंभीर भविष्यवाणी की।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: In India, snow persistence in the Ganga, the Brahmaputra, and the Indus river basins dropped significantly in 2024.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — भारत में, 2024 में गंगा, ब्रह्मपुत्र और सिंधु नदी घाटियों में बर्फ की स्थिरता में काफी गिरावट आई।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Ganga river basin noted its lowest snow persistence in 22 years, 17% below the long-term historical average (also known as ‘normal’).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — गंगा नदी बेसिन में 22 वर्षों में सबसे कम बर्फबारी देखी गई, जो दीर्घकालिक ऐतिहासिक औसत (जिसे 'सामान्य' भी कहा जाता है) से 17% कम है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The previous holder of this dubious distinction was 2018, when it was 15.2% below normal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इस संदिग्ध अंतर का पिछला धारक 2018 था, जब यह सामान्य से 15.2% कम था।।

hinglishTracks.en: In 2015, on the other hand, snow persistence was 25.6% above normal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — दूसरी ओर, 2015 में, बर्फ की स्थिरता सामान्य से 25.6% अधिक थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Similarly, snow persistence in the Brahmaputra basin was 14.6% below normal in 2024.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसी तरह, 2024 में ब्रह्मपुत्र बेसिन में बर्फ की स्थिरता सामान्य से 14.6% कम थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: It was worse in 2021, when the average persistence was 15.5% below normal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — 2021 में यह और भी बदतर था, जब औसत दृढ़ता सामान्य से 15.5% कम थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: In the Indus river basin, snow persistence fell 23.3% below normal this year although this was offset by excesses in parts of the lower altitudes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सिंधु नदी बेसिन में, इस वर्ष बर्फ की स्थिरता सामान्य से 23.3% कम हो गई, हालांकि कम ऊंचाई वाले हिस्सों में अधिकता से इसकी भरपाई हो गई।।

hinglishTracks.en: Outside India, the basin of the Amu Darya river — which flows through Central Asia — recorded its lowest snow persistence in 2024: 28.2% below normal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — भारत के बाहर, अमु दरिया नदी का बेसिन - जो मध्य एशिया से होकर बहती है - 2024 में सबसे कम बर्फबारी दर्ज की गई: सामान्य से 28.2% कम।।

hinglishTracks.en: The figure for the Helmand river, an important source of drinking water for Iran and Afghanistan, was almost 32% below normal in 2024, beating a record set in 2018.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ईरान और अफगानिस्तान के लिए पीने के पानी का एक महत्वपूर्ण स्रोत हेलमंद नदी का आंकड़ा 2024 में सामान्य से लगभग 32% कम था, जो 2018 में बनाए गए रिकॉर्ड को तोड़ रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Persistence in the part where the Mekong river originates in the Himalaya was only slightly below normal this time.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हिमालय में मेकांग नदी जहां से निकलती है, उस हिस्से में पानी का बहाव इस बार सामान्य से थोड़ा ही कम था।।

hinglishTracks.en: (This river’s delta is Vietnam’s “rice bowl”.)
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — (इस नदी का डेल्टा वियतनाम का "धान का कटोरा" है।)।

hinglishTracks.en: The primary reason for the lower persistence in 2024 was weak western disturbances, ICIMOD remote sensing specialist and author of the report Sher Muhammad told The Hindu .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — आईसीआईएमओडी रिमोट सेंसिंग विशेषज्ञ और रिपोर्ट के लेखक शेर मुहम्मद ने द हिंदू को बताया कि 2024 में कम दृढ़ता का मुख्य कारण कमजोर पश्चिमी विक्षोभ था।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Due to changing climate and global warming, this pattern is becoming increasingly unstable.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “बदलती जलवायु और ग्लोबल वार्मिंग के कारण, यह पैटर्न तेजी से अस्थिर होता जा रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Although the exact mechanisms are not fully understood, global warming is thought to exacerbate prolonged and intense La Niña–El Niño conditions.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हालाँकि सटीक तंत्र को पूरी तरह से समझा नहीं गया है, लेकिन माना जाता है कि ग्लोबल वार्मिंग लंबे समय तक और तीव्र ला नीना-अल नीनो स्थितियों को बढ़ा सकती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: These phases of a recurring climate pattern across the tropical Pacific Ocean significantly influence global weather patterns, including western disturbances,” he added.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — उष्णकटिबंधीय प्रशांत महासागर में आवर्ती जलवायु पैटर्न के ये चरण पश्चिमी विक्षोभ सहित वैश्विक मौसम पैटर्न को महत्वपूर्ण रूप से प्रभावित करते हैं, ”उन्होंने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Western disturbances are low-pressure systems that originate over the Mediterranean Sea, the Caspian, and the Black Seas and bring rain and snow to the HKH region in winter.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 What are the findings of the 2024 Hindu Kush Himalayas snow update? | Explained

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 11:46:18 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: What does the report by the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development highlight? How important is snow persistence? How much of a role does climate change play in river basins receiving low levels of snowmelt this year?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: T he Ganga river basin — India’s largest — reached a record low snow persistence in 2024, the Hindu Kush Himalaya snow update of the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD) has reported. The Brahmaputra and the Indus basins have suffered similarly, threatening water supply to millions of people. “Tragically this is yet another postcard from the frontlines of a climate crisis that is accelerating even beyond scientists’ projections and causing huge challenges in one of the most populated regions of the world,” Miriam Jackson, Cryosphere Lead at ICIMOD and a contributor to reports of the UN Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, told The Hindu . Snow persistence is the fraction of time snow is on the ground. When this snow melts, it provides water to people and ecosystems. In the river basins of the Hindu Kush Himalaya (HKH), snowmelt is the biggest source of water in the streams. Overall, it contributes 23% of the runoff to the region’s 12 major river basins every year. The HKH mountains extend around 3,500 km over eight countries — Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, China, India, Nepal, Myanmar, and Pakistan. These mountains are also called the “water towers of Asia” because they are the origins of 10 crucial river systems on the continent — Amu Darya, Indus, Ganga, Brahmaputra, Irrawaddy, Salween, Mekong, Yangtse, Yellow river, and Tarim. These river basins provide water to almost one-fourth of the world’s population and are a significant freshwater source for 240 million people in the HKH region. The authors of the 2024 HKH snow update analysed data from 2003 to 2024 and found significant fluctuations in snow persistence between November and April every year, when snow accumulates above ground. Based on this, they made grim predictions of lasting impact on the people in the region as well as those downstream of the river basins. In India, snow persistence in the Ganga, the Brahmaputra, and the Indus river basins dropped significantly in 2024. The Ganga river basin noted its lowest snow persistence in 22 years, 17% below the long-term historical average (also known as ‘normal’). The previous holder of this dubious distinction was 2018, when it was 15.2% below normal. In 2015, on the other hand, snow persistence was 25.6% above normal. Similarly, snow persistence in the Brahmaputra basin was 14.6% below normal in 2024. It was worse in 2021, when the average persistence was 15.5% below normal. In the Indus river basin, snow persistence fell 23.3% below normal this year although this was offset by excesses in parts of the lower altitudes. Outside India, the basin of the Amu Darya river — which flows through Central Asia — recorded its lowest snow persistence in 2024: 28.2% below normal. The figure for the Helmand river, an important source of drinking water for Iran and Afghanistan, was almost 32% below normal in 2024, beating a record set in 2018. Persistence in the part where the Mekong river originates in the Himalaya was only slightly below normal this time. (This river’s delta is Vietnam’s “rice bowl”.) The primary reason for the lower persistence in 2024 was weak western disturbances, ICIMOD remote sensing specialist and author of the report Sher Muhammad told The Hindu . “Due to changing climate and global warming, this pattern is becoming increasingly unstable. Although the exact mechanisms are not fully understood, global warming is thought to exacerbate prolonged and intense La Niña–El Niño conditions. These phases of a recurring climate pattern across the tropical Pacific Ocean significantly influence global weather patterns, including western disturbances,” he added. Western disturbances are low-pressure systems that originate over the Mediterranean Sea, the Caspian, and the Black Seas and bring rain and snow to the HKH region in winter. “The region where these storms originate experienced persistently high sea-surface temperatures,” Mr. Muhammad explained. “This disruption weakened and delayed the arrival of the western disturbance, resulting in reduced winter precipitation and snowfall in the HKH region. The pattern of high temperatures and altered weather systems explains both the record low snow persistence in 2024 and similar historical records.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “We have warned for years that the 1.5 degrees Celsius limit that governments signed up to in the Paris Agreement is not ambitious enough to protect the snow and ice, people and nature of the Hindu Kush Himalayas because the target is a global average, and the real temperature increase will be far higher here,” Ms. Jackson added.

articles.title: Jewellery and souvenir made from plastic discarded in the Himalayas
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Plastic bottle caps left by climbers in the Himalayas are repurposed by Moware into mini Himalayan models, rocks of Himalayas, jewellery, and more

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Have you ever wondered what happens to discarded plastic bottle caps? At best, they transform into wheels in DIY toy projects; or so we think. In Nepal, they are recycled into souvenirs, jewellery and everyday utility items by Nepal-based Moware. This design intervention enterprise Eva Villardon Grande gives a new meaning to waste left behind in the Himalayas. Launched in 2013, Moware which stands for ‘Mountain Waste Repurpose’, employs innovative ways to reduce our footprint by upcycling and creatively transforming waste into useful products. The initiative was kickstarted to promote paper waste management in offices, even as it generated employment for low-income women from Lalitpur, Kathmandu. Over the years, they diversified, experimenting extensively with waste aluminium, wrappers, and glass bottles. The Himalayan stones - Renjo La, Cho La and Kongma La | Photo Credit: Special arrangement Among their collectables, the most talked about is the From the Himalayas collection including a miniature model of the mountains that shows its most iconic peaks — Shartse, Lhotse, Mount Everest, Nuptse, Changtise Peak, Khumbutse Peak, and Mount Lingtren. The collection also includes ornamental rocks, jewellery and candle stand, all made from plastic bottle caps discarded by trekkers in the Himalayas. Plastic bottle caps at Moware’s workshop | Photo Credit: Special arrangement The glass in the collection are made from recycled alcohol bottles that are left behind by tourists. These are collected from hotels by Waste management companies. Moware sources these and turns them into utility items. An average trekker uses approximately 38 water bottles during the climb. Moware decided to see what could be done with the plastic instead of sending it to landfills, or having it incinerated. Towards this end, they set out to collaborate with two like-minded waste product resource management companies, Blue Waste and Sagarmatha Next., based out of Nepal, to find a solution. Carry Me Back was the first initiative of Sagarmatha Next to address the waste management challenge in the Sagarmatha National Park and the Khumbu region (Nepalese side of Mount Everest). When the pilot project of the crowdsourced waste removal system was initiated in 2019, 2,500 tourists transported about 4,000 kilograms of waste. The waste is segregated, packed in specially made bags and left at a pick-up station located by the stupa in Namche Bazaar. Eva and her team members at Moware | Photo Credit: Special arrangement Why bottle caps? Eva explains, “While a plastic bottle without the cap may have a lot of takers, the plastic cap itself — made from High-Density Polyethylene (HDP) — finds no takers, so they eventually end up in landfills.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Moware then collaborated with Pim and Luc of Super Local, a team of Dutch designers based in Nepal. The duo devoted themselves to reducing waste and creating sustainable products hand-in-hand with local communities. “After a few months of brainstorming, they devised the Himalayan model design and Himalayan stones. The Himalayan stone are assortment of three mani stones — Renjo La, Cho La and Kongma La. These stones represent the awe-inspiring three passes of the Khumbu region. We just loved it and saw a beautiful chance to give the caps a new life,” says Eva who has made Nepal her home for now, to work on similar projects.
