🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 As external funding to combat TB falls, domestic spending accounts for 86%: WHO report

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 08:59:30 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: TB cases remain one of the leading causes of death from a single infectious agent, with a quarter of all cases concentrated in India in 2025

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Around 86% of the spending on measures against tuberculosis (TB) in 2025 came from domestic sources, the recently released Global Tuberculosis Report 2026 by the World Health Organisation (WHO) said, even as the reduction in international donor funding to combat the infectious disease remains a cause of concern. TB cases remain one of the leading causes of death from a single infectious agent, with a quarter of all cases concentrated in India in 2025. The report notes that $22 billion is needed annually for TB prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and care to achieve the global targets agreed on at the 2023 United Nations high-level TB meeting by 2027. In absolute terms, Brazil, China, India, the Russian Federation, and South Africa accounted for $3.7 billion (65%) of the total of $5.63 billion provided from domestic sources in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). The report notes that international donor funding fell by 14%, from $1.1 billion in 2024 to $0.94 billion in 2025, having been relatively stable at about $1.1–1.3 billion per year between 2015 and 2024. Financing for TB research and innovation, at $1.2 billion in 2023, also continued to fall far short of the global target of $5 billion per year. Progress to date has been constrained by the overall level of investment, said the report. “TB mostly affects adults in their most productive years. However, all age groups are at risk. Over 80% of cases and deaths are in low- and middle-income countries. In 2025, the largest number of new TB cases occurred in the WHO South-East Asia Region (35%),’’ said the report. The WHO on Friday (November 13, 2026) called on countries in the South-East Asia Region to accelerate action to end TB. The latest TB estimates show the region accounts for 3.6 million people who developed TB in 2025 — 34% of the global total — and 4,00,000 TB-related deaths, or 35% of the global total. "These numbers are a stark reminder that TB remains one of the Region’s most pressing public health and development challenges,” said Nilesh Buddha, officer-in-charge, WHO South-East Asia Region. A release issued by the regional office added that in 2025, $1.03 billion was available for TB prevention and care in the region, with 91% from domestic sources. Yet this represented only around 16% of global TB funding, despite the region accounting for 34% of global cases. "Closing this gap in resources is critical to sustaining progress," the WHO said. “Ending TB is not simply a health sector responsibility. It requires leadership across government, sustained investment, strong health systems and communities at the centre of the response. We have tools to prevent, diagnose and treat TB. What is needed now is the commitment to ensure they reach everyone who needs them, without delay or financial hardship,” said Dr. Buddha, adding that ending TB by 2030 will depend on countries turning political commitments into measurable action, with greater urgency and scale.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Meanwhile, the Global TB Report said that across the world, about 50% of people treated for TB and their households face total costs (direct medical expenditures, non-medical expenditures, and indirect costs such as income losses) that are catastrophic (more than 20% of total household income). This is far from the target of the WHO End TB Strategy of zero.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Responsibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
International (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "As external funding to combat TB falls, domestic spending accounts for 86%: WHO report", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. TB cases remain one of the leading causes of death from a single infectious agent, with a quarter of all cases concentrated in India in 2025.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'As external funding to combat TB falls, domestic' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'As external funding to combat TB falls, domes' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'As external funding to combat TB falls, domes' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "TB cases remain one of the leading causes of death from a single infectious agent, with a quarter of all cases concentrated in India in 2025." (Hinglish Arth: टीबी के मामले एकल संक्रामक एजेंट से मृत्यु के प्रमुख कारणों में से एक बने हुए हैं, 2025 में सभी मामलों में से एक चौथाई भारत में केंद्रित होंगे।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "As external funding to combat TB falls, domestic spending accounts for 86%: WHO report"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. This is far from the target of the WHO End TB Strategy of zero.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "This is far from the target of the WHO End TB Strategy of zero." (Hinglish Arth: यह डब्ल्यूएचओ की टीबी समाप्ति रणनीति के लक्ष्य शून्य से बहुत दूर है।)

articles.title: Major gambling gang busted in Kozhikode
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: According to the police, the gang had deliberately chosen a secluded, peaceful residential locality to organise high-stakes card games without drawing public attention

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In a joint midnight operation, the District Anti-Narcotic Special Action Force (DANSAF) and the Chevayur police busted a major gambling racket allegedly operating out of a rented house in a quiet residential neighbourhood near Malaparamba here, arresting 12 persons and seizing ₹4,96,050 in cash. Acting on a tip-off, a special police team led by Narcotic Cell Assistant Commissioner Jeevan George conducted a surprise raid around 11.30 p.m. on Thursday (November 12) at the house located on Gurudev Road near Malaparamba Junction. According to the police, the gang had deliberately chosen the secluded residential locality to organise high-stakes card games without drawing public attention. The arrested are Muhammed Rafi, 52, of Kakkodi, Sivamani, 40, of Karuvissery, Anil Kumar, 49, of Ulliyeri, Abdul Latheef, 50, of Parambil Bazar, Balakrishnan, 56, of Chemancheri, Saleem, 58, of Karaparamba, Abdul Najeeb, 62, of Vengeri, Muhammed Riyas, 41, of Vazhakkad in Malappuram, Poulose, 51, of Kuthiravattom, Anil Kumar, 41, of Elathur, Shamnas, 40, of Chelannur, and Satheesh Kumar of Palazhi. Playing cards and other gambling gadgets were also seized. The Chevayur police have registered a case against the accused under Sections 7 and 8 of the Kerala Gaming Act.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Senior police officers said that strict surveillance and stringent action against such illegal activities would continue in the coming days. The investigation team comprised Chevayur sub inspectors Rafeeq and Abdul Muneer and DANSAF sub inspector E. Manoj.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Major gambling gang busted in Kozhikode

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 07:23:11 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: According to the police, the gang had deliberately chosen a secluded, peaceful residential locality to organise high-stakes card games without drawing public attention

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In a joint midnight operation, the District Anti-Narcotic Special Action Force (DANSAF) and the Chevayur police busted a major gambling racket allegedly operating out of a rented house in a quiet residential neighbourhood near Malaparamba here, arresting 12 persons and seizing ₹4,96,050 in cash. Acting on a tip-off, a special police team led by Narcotic Cell Assistant Commissioner Jeevan George conducted a surprise raid around 11.30 p.m. on Thursday (November 12) at the house located on Gurudev Road near Malaparamba Junction. According to the police, the gang had deliberately chosen the secluded residential locality to organise high-stakes card games without drawing public attention. The arrested are Muhammed Rafi, 52, of Kakkodi, Sivamani, 40, of Karuvissery, Anil Kumar, 49, of Ulliyeri, Abdul Latheef, 50, of Parambil Bazar, Balakrishnan, 56, of Chemancheri, Saleem, 58, of Karaparamba, Abdul Najeeb, 62, of Vengeri, Muhammed Riyas, 41, of Vazhakkad in Malappuram, Poulose, 51, of Kuthiravattom, Anil Kumar, 41, of Elathur, Shamnas, 40, of Chelannur, and Satheesh Kumar of Palazhi. Playing cards and other gambling gadgets were also seized. The Chevayur police have registered a case against the accused under Sections 7 and 8 of the Kerala Gaming Act.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Senior police officers said that strict surveillance and stringent action against such illegal activities would continue in the coming days. The investigation team comprised Chevayur sub inspectors Rafeeq and Abdul Muneer and DANSAF sub inspector E. Manoj.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Investigation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Surveillance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

Residential (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Residential' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Attention' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Vijay held discussions on the precautionary measures to be implemented during natural calamities

articles.title: Shivamogga District administration makes elaborate arrangements for KPSC exams to be held on Sunday
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The district administration has put in place elaborate security and monitoring arrangements for the Karnataka Public Service Commission’s (KPSC) preliminary examination for Gazetted Probationers, to be held in 24 centres in the city on Sunday.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Briefing presspersons in Shivamogga on Friday, Deputy Commissioner Prakash G.T. Nittali said the district administration had taken stringent measures than ever before as per the instructions from the KPSC. The examination is for 319 Group A and Group B posts for 2026-27. In Shivamogga, 8,466 candidates will appear, including 156 persons with disabilities and two transgender candidates. Fifteen candidates have sought scribes. The examination will be held in two sessions - 10 a.m to 12 noon and 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. Question papers and other confidential material will be kept at the Treasury and moved to the centres by route officers under police escort. Chief examiners and route officers have been trained for the task, Mr. Nittali said. An observer has been deployed at each centre. There will be two invigilators in each room. A dress code officer will also be posted at every centre. CCTV cameras have been installed in all 357 examination rooms. Footage will be monitored from a “war room” at the Deputy Commissioner’s office, and webcasting will also be used. The KPSC will monitor the proceedings as well. Prohibitory orders under Section 163 will be in force around the centres. Each centre will have an inspector-rank police officer, and about 150 constables will be deployed in all. The district police will also monitor social media for rumours and fake news, said Superintendent of Police B. Nikhil.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Zilla Panchayat CEO Rishi Anand and others were present at the press conference.

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Shivamogga District administration makes elaborate arrangements for KPSC exams to be held on Sunday

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 07:20:25 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The district administration has put in place elaborate security and monitoring arrangements for the Karnataka Public Service Commission’s (KPSC) preliminary examination for Gazetted Probationers, to be held in 24 centres in the city on Sunday.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Briefing presspersons in Shivamogga on Friday, Deputy Commissioner Prakash G.T. Nittali said the district administration had taken stringent measures than ever before as per the instructions from the KPSC. The examination is for 319 Group A and Group B posts for 2026-27. In Shivamogga, 8,466 candidates will appear, including 156 persons with disabilities and two transgender candidates. Fifteen candidates have sought scribes. The examination will be held in two sessions - 10 a.m to 12 noon and 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. Question papers and other confidential material will be kept at the Treasury and moved to the centres by route officers under police escort. Chief examiners and route officers have been trained for the task, Mr. Nittali said. An observer has been deployed at each centre. There will be two invigilators in each room. A dress code officer will also be posted at every centre. CCTV cameras have been installed in all 357 examination rooms. Footage will be monitored from a “war room” at the Deputy Commissioner’s office, and webcasting will also be used. The KPSC will monitor the proceedings as well. Prohibitory orders under Section 163 will be in force around the centres. Each centre will have an inspector-rank police officer, and about 150 constables will be deployed in all. The district police will also monitor social media for rumours and fake news, said Superintendent of Police B. Nikhil.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Zilla Panchayat CEO Rishi Anand and others were present at the press conference.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The district administration has put in place elaborate security and monitoring arrangements for the Karnataka Public Service Commission’s (KPSC) preliminary examination for Gazetted Probationers, to be held in 24 centres in the city on Sunday.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Briefing presspersons in Shivamogga on Friday, Deputy Commissioner Prakash G.T. Nittali said the district administration had taken stringent measures than ever before as per the instructions from the KPSC. The examination is for 319 Group A and Group B posts for 2026-27. In Shivamogga, 8,466 candidates will appear, including 156 persons with disabilities and two transgender candidates. Fifteen candidates have sought scribes. The examination will be held in two sessions - 10 a.m to 12 noon and 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. Question papers and other confidential material will be kept at the Treasury and moved to the centres by route officers under police escort. Chief examiners and route officers have been trained for the task, Mr. Nittali said. An observer has been deployed at each centre. There will be two invigilators in each room. A dress code officer will also be posted at every centre. CCTV cameras have been installed in all 357 examination rooms. Footage will be monitored from a “war room” at the Deputy Commissioner’s office, and webcasting will also be used. The KPSC will monitor the proceedings as well. Prohibitory orders under Section 163 will be in force around the centres. Each centre will have an inspector-rank police officer, and about 150 constables will be deployed in all. The district police will also monitor social media for rumours and fake news, said Superintendent of Police B. Nikhil.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Zilla Panchayat CEO Rishi Anand and others were present at the press conference.

articles.title: Europe warned against falling for Russia's 'traps' on Ukraine talks
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The hawkish former Prime Minister of Estonia Kaja Kallas said it was not up to Russia to decide who would represent Europe

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: European Union (EU) foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas warned on Friday (November 13, 2026) that Europe must not walk into Russian “traps” over Ukraine talks, saying reaching a ceasefire needed to be the priority, not broader security negotiations. U.S. envoys said on Thursday (November 12, 2026) after talks with Vladimir Putin that Europe would join future negotiations — but the Kremlin appeared to slam the brakes on that plan saying no decision had been made. After pushing for months to be involved, Europe is now asking itself who should represent it and what it is willing to discuss with the Kremlin. Moscow has pushed to renegotiate Europe’s broader security architecture as part of any talks — and appears to be reviving hardline demands to roll back NATO. “First we need a ceasefire. If we start to talk about what Russia is asking regarding the security architecture, we actually walk into the traps that Russia is setting us, which is that we divert the attention away from that there is no ceasefire,” Ms. Kallas told reporters at an EU summit in Dublin. U.S. envoy and Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner said that getting Europe onboard will “allow us to address the broader postwar European security arrangements”. The new push has set alarm bells ringing among U.S. allies in Europe who have long rejected the Kremlin’s desire to overhaul the continent’s security framework. European Commission chief Ursula von der Leyen insisted it was “self-explanatory that Europe is included in the peace talks to safeguard our interests, but also to support Ukraine”. At the same time, there are calls for Europe to decide soon on who will represent it — with EU leaders set to debate the issue in Dublin.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “This needs to be resolved,” said Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Europe warned against falling for Russia's 'traps' on Ukraine talks

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 05:59:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The hawkish former Prime Minister of Estonia Kaja Kallas said it was not up to Russia to decide who would represent Europe

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: European Union (EU) foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas warned on Friday (November 13, 2026) that Europe must not walk into Russian “traps” over Ukraine talks, saying reaching a ceasefire needed to be the priority, not broader security negotiations. U.S. envoys said on Thursday (November 12, 2026) after talks with Vladimir Putin that Europe would join future negotiations — but the Kremlin appeared to slam the brakes on that plan saying no decision had been made. After pushing for months to be involved, Europe is now asking itself who should represent it and what it is willing to discuss with the Kremlin. Moscow has pushed to renegotiate Europe’s broader security architecture as part of any talks — and appears to be reviving hardline demands to roll back NATO. “First we need a ceasefire. If we start to talk about what Russia is asking regarding the security architecture, we actually walk into the traps that Russia is setting us, which is that we divert the attention away from that there is no ceasefire,” Ms. Kallas told reporters at an EU summit in Dublin. U.S. envoy and Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner said that getting Europe onboard will “allow us to address the broader postwar European security arrangements”. The new push has set alarm bells ringing among U.S. allies in Europe who have long rejected the Kremlin’s desire to overhaul the continent’s security framework. European Commission chief Ursula von der Leyen insisted it was “self-explanatory that Europe is included in the peace talks to safeguard our interests, but also to support Ukraine”. At the same time, there are calls for Europe to decide soon on who will represent it — with EU leaders set to debate the issue in Dublin.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “This needs to be resolved,” said Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin.

articles.title: IIT-Kanpur researchers identify how pancreatic immune cells switch off insulin release
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The findings establish a potential target for developing drugs to preserve insulin production in people with obesity and Type-2 diabetes

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Researchers at the Indian Institute of Technology-Kanpur have identified a molecular pathway through which immune cells in the pancreas can rapidly suppress insulin release, opening up a potential new avenue for developing therapies to protect insulin production in people with obesity and Type-2 diabetes. The findings, published in ‘Journal of Clinical Investigation’ , show that immune cells called macrophages can switch off insulin secretion by neighbouring beta cells within minutes, rather than gradually damaging them through inflammation over months or years, according to a note issued by IIT-Kanpur on Thursday. Simran Singh and Ashish Kumar led the study as co-first authors under the supervision of Sai Prasad Pydi, assistant professor, department of biological sciences and bioengineering, IIT-Kanpur. “We discovered that immune cells that are present next to beta cells can switch off insulin release within minutes,” Pydi said. The researchers found that the process involves sphingolipids, a class of fats released by macrophages, rather than the inflammatory proteins traditionally associated with obesity-related pancreatic damage. The team traced the trigger to GPR18, a receptor on macrophages. Once activated, it prompts the immune cells to release sphingolipids, which are taken up by neighbouring beta cells through a surface transporter, and interfere with their insulin-producing machinery. Using a precision genetic technique, the researchers found that activating this pathway reduced insulin secretion in mouse models, while switching it off improved insulin release. Blocking GPR18 or other steps in the pathway also restored insulin secretion. The team, working with the Indiana Biosciences Research Institute in the US, confirmed that the same pathway was present and active in human pancreatic tissue. Activating it in donated human tissue also suppressed insulin secretion, according to the communique.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the study does not offer an immediate treatment for diabetes, the findings establish a potential target for developing drugs to preserve insulin production in people with obesity and Type-2 diabetes, it said.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 IIT-Kanpur researchers identify how pancreatic immune cells switch off insulin release

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 07:07:48 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The findings establish a potential target for developing drugs to preserve insulin production in people with obesity and Type-2 diabetes

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Researchers at the Indian Institute of Technology-Kanpur have identified a molecular pathway through which immune cells in the pancreas can rapidly suppress insulin release, opening up a potential new avenue for developing therapies to protect insulin production in people with obesity and Type-2 diabetes. The findings, published in ‘Journal of Clinical Investigation’ , show that immune cells called macrophages can switch off insulin secretion by neighbouring beta cells within minutes, rather than gradually damaging them through inflammation over months or years, according to a note issued by IIT-Kanpur on Thursday. Simran Singh and Ashish Kumar led the study as co-first authors under the supervision of Sai Prasad Pydi, assistant professor, department of biological sciences and bioengineering, IIT-Kanpur. “We discovered that immune cells that are present next to beta cells can switch off insulin release within minutes,” Pydi said. The researchers found that the process involves sphingolipids, a class of fats released by macrophages, rather than the inflammatory proteins traditionally associated with obesity-related pancreatic damage. The team traced the trigger to GPR18, a receptor on macrophages. Once activated, it prompts the immune cells to release sphingolipids, which are taken up by neighbouring beta cells through a surface transporter, and interfere with their insulin-producing machinery. Using a precision genetic technique, the researchers found that activating this pathway reduced insulin secretion in mouse models, while switching it off improved insulin release. Blocking GPR18 or other steps in the pathway also restored insulin secretion. The team, working with the Indiana Biosciences Research Institute in the US, confirmed that the same pathway was present and active in human pancreatic tissue. Activating it in donated human tissue also suppressed insulin secretion, according to the communique.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the study does not offer an immediate treatment for diabetes, the findings establish a potential target for developing drugs to preserve insulin production in people with obesity and Type-2 diabetes, it said.

articles.title: Military-linked Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips despite US blacklist, records show
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Both Democrats and Republicans in Congress have urged stronger controls on China’s access to advanced AI chips, such as chip-tracking requirements and greater congressional oversight of exports

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Chinese university with deep ‌ties to the People’s Liberation Army bought Nvidia’s powerful H200 AI chips last month despite being on a US export blacklist , procurement records show, ​highlighting gaps in Washington’s efforts to curb China’s access to advanced technology. The findings come as Nvidia and its CEO Jensen Huang face mounting scrutiny in ⁠Washington over his lobbying for looser restrictions on sales of AI chips to China, following reports alleging he was targeted by a Chinese spying operation. Huang has argued that continued US sales to China would preserve American technological leadership and keep Chinese customers reliant on US technology. But some US lawmakers say access to Nvidia’s most powerful AI chips can speed China’s development of AI systems for weapons design, ‌intelligence analysis and military modernisation. Both Democrats and Republicans in Congress have urged stronger controls on China’s access to advanced AI chips, such as chip-tracking requirements and greater congressional oversight of exports. Three Republican congressional committee chairmen have requested a briefing with Huang on November 18 over his reported contacts with an alleged Chinese ‌intelligence operative. Northwestern Polytechnical University bought two H200 chips last month for 874,700 yuan ($123,000), according to an October 21 procurement record on its website. Northwestern is a member of the “Seven Sons ‌of ⁠National Defense” group of Chinese universities under U.S. sanctions and with a history of conducting defence-related research for Beijing. The chips were purchased for its management ⁠school from Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology rather than directly from Nvidia, the record shows. The H200 is among Nvidia’s most capable chips for training and running advanced AI systems and is subject to US export licence approvals, which are normally denied for blacklisted institutions such as Northwestern Polytechnical. Northwestern Polytechnical also bought access this year to H200 chips and other powerful Nvidia AI processors through five contracts for rented computing capacity from Chinese companies, procurement records show.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Reuters is ​reporting the chip purchases and computing contracts for the first time. Northwestern ‌Polytechnical, Nvidia and the US Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security, which oversees export controls, did not respond to requests for comment. Reuters could not determine contact details for Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology.

options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
Reuters could not determine contact details for Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: Reuters could not determine contact details for Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Reuters could not determine contact details for Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology." (Hinglish Arth: रॉयटर्स शानक्सी बोसुआन नेटवर्क टेक्नोलॉजी के लिए संपर्क विवरण निर्धारित नहीं कर सका।)

hinglishTracks.en: Both Democrats and Republicans in Congress have urged stronger controls on China’s access to advanced AI chips, such as chip-tracking requirements and greater congressional oversight of exports
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — कांग्रेस में डेमोक्रेट और रिपब्लिकन दोनों ने उन्नत एआई चिप्स तक चीन की पहुंच पर मजबूत नियंत्रण का आग्रह किया है, जैसे चिप-ट्रैकिंग आवश्यकताएं और निर्यात की अधिक कांग्रेस निगरानी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Congressional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Congressional' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: A Chinese university with deep ‌ties to the People’s Liberation Army bought Nvidia’s powerful H200 AI chips last month despite being on a US export blacklist , procurement records show, ​highlighting gaps in Washington’s efforts to curb China’s access to advanced technology.

hinglishTracks.en: The findings come as Nvidia and its CEO Jensen Huang face mounting scrutiny in ⁠Washington over his lobbying for looser restrictions on sales of AI chips to China, following reports alleging he was targeted by a Chinese spying operation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह निष्कर्ष तब आया है जब एनवीडिया और उसके सीईओ जेन्सेन हुआंग को चीन में एआई चिप्स की बिक्री पर प्रतिबंधों में ढील देने की पैरवी करने के लिए वाशिंगटन में बढ़ती जांच का सामना करना पड़ रहा है, रिपोर्टों के बाद आरोप लगाया गया है कि उन्हें एक चीनी जासूसी ऑपरेशन द्वारा लक्षित किया गया था।।

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Military-linked Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips despite US blacklist, records show

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 06:58:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Both Democrats and Republicans in Congress have urged stronger controls on China’s access to advanced AI chips, such as chip-tracking requirements and greater congressional oversight of exports

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Chinese university with deep ‌ties to the People’s Liberation Army bought Nvidia’s powerful H200 AI chips last month despite being on a US export blacklist , procurement records show, ​highlighting gaps in Washington’s efforts to curb China’s access to advanced technology. The findings come as Nvidia and its CEO Jensen Huang face mounting scrutiny in ⁠Washington over his lobbying for looser restrictions on sales of AI chips to China, following reports alleging he was targeted by a Chinese spying operation. Huang has argued that continued US sales to China would preserve American technological leadership and keep Chinese customers reliant on US technology. But some US lawmakers say access to Nvidia’s most powerful AI chips can speed China’s development of AI systems for weapons design, ‌intelligence analysis and military modernisation. Both Democrats and Republicans in Congress have urged stronger controls on China’s access to advanced AI chips, such as chip-tracking requirements and greater congressional oversight of exports. Three Republican congressional committee chairmen have requested a briefing with Huang on November 18 over his reported contacts with an alleged Chinese ‌intelligence operative. Northwestern Polytechnical University bought two H200 chips last month for 874,700 yuan ($123,000), according to an October 21 procurement record on its website. Northwestern is a member of the “Seven Sons ‌of ⁠National Defense” group of Chinese universities under U.S. sanctions and with a history of conducting defence-related research for Beijing. The chips were purchased for its management ⁠school from Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology rather than directly from Nvidia, the record shows. The H200 is among Nvidia’s most capable chips for training and running advanced AI systems and is subject to US export licence approvals, which are normally denied for blacklisted institutions such as Northwestern Polytechnical. Northwestern Polytechnical also bought access this year to H200 chips and other powerful Nvidia AI processors through five contracts for rented computing capacity from Chinese companies, procurement records show.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Reuters is ​reporting the chip purchases and computing contracts for the first time. Northwestern ‌Polytechnical, Nvidia and the US Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security, which oversees export controls, did not respond to requests for comment. Reuters could not determine contact details for Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Both Democrats and Republicans in Congress have urged stronger controls on China’s access to advanced AI chips, such as chip-tracking requirements and greater congressional oversight of exports
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Chinese university with deep ‌ties to the People’s Liberation Army bought Nvidia’s powerful H200 AI chips last month despite being on a US export blacklist , procurement records show, ​highlighting gaps in Washington’s efforts to curb China’s access to advanced technology. The findings come as Nvidia and its CEO Jensen Huang face mounting scrutiny in ⁠Washington over his lobbying for looser restrictions on sales of AI chips to China, following reports alleging he was targeted by a Chinese spying operation. Huang has argued that continued US sales to China would preserve American technological leadership and keep Chinese customers reliant on US technology. But some US lawmakers say access to Nvidia’s most powerful AI chips can speed China’s development of AI systems for weapons design, ‌intelligence analysis and military modernisation. Both Democrats and Republicans in Congress have urged stronger controls on China’s access to advanced AI chips, such as chip-tracking requirements and greater congressional oversight of exports. Three Republican congressional committee chairmen have requested a briefing with Huang on November 18 over his reported contacts with an alleged Chinese ‌intelligence operative. Northwestern Polytechnical University bought two H200 chips last month for 874,700 yuan ($123,000), according to an October 21 procurement record on its website. Northwestern is a member of the “Seven Sons ‌of ⁠National Defense” group of Chinese universities under U.S. sanctions and with a history of conducting defence-related research for Beijing. The chips were purchased for its management ⁠school from Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology rather than directly from Nvidia, the record shows. The H200 is among Nvidia’s most capable chips for training and running advanced AI systems and is subject to US export licence approvals, which are normally denied for blacklisted institutions such as Northwestern Polytechnical. Northwestern Polytechnical also bought access this year to H200 chips and other powerful Nvidia AI processors through five contracts for rented computing capacity from Chinese companies, procurement records show.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Reuters is ​reporting the chip purchases and computing contracts for the first time. Northwestern ‌Polytechnical, Nvidia and the US Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security, which oversees export controls, did not respond to requests for comment. Reuters could not determine contact details for Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Telangana State Women’s Commission (TGSCW) has initiated an inquiry into an alleged illegal oocyte donation racket in Hyderabad, issuing notices to eight Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) centres and egg banks over suspected irregularities in their donor records and procurement practices.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Commission examined representatives of the eight institutions on Friday, November 13, after directing their managements to appear before it. However, TGSCW Chairperson Nerella Sharada expressed dissatisfaction after some centres sent staff members and other representatives instead of senior management, despite being specifically instructed to attend in person. The inquiry was subsequently adjourned after the institutions assured the Commission that their management would appear at the next hearing. During Friday’s proceedings, the Commission scrutinised reports, records and details of egg donors submitted by the ART centres and egg banks. “Several irregularities and suspicious elements have emerged from the records examined so far,” said Ms. Sharada. She also questioned claims made by the institutions that nearly 90% of their egg donors came from other States and donated their eggs voluntarily without receiving any remuneration or financial compensation. She said the claims raised several questions and warranted further investigation. Commissioner of Health and Family Welfare, Sangeetha Satyanarayana, also attended the inquiry, during which Ms. Sharada sought details about the progress of the department’s investigation into the alleged illegal egg procurement practices. The discussions also covered shortcomings in the existing Assisted Reproductive Technology Act and its implementation, particularly the challenges in regulating and monitoring ART centres and egg banks. Ms. Sharada said she would soon meet Health Minister C. Damodar Raja Narasimha and Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy to inform them of the findings and discuss corrective measures, including possible legislative amendments to strengthen regulation of the sector. Ms. Sharada further said that the Commission has also received information indicating the possible involvement of several other ART centres and egg banks in the alleged racket. It plans to issue notices to their management and summon them for questioning as part of the ongoing inquiry.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The Commission will not tolerate illegal practices that compromise women’s health, dignity and rights. We will continue the investigation in coordination with the concerned government departments to identify those responsible and ensure appropriate legal action,” she added.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Telangana Women’s Commission issues notices to eight ART centres in illegal oocyte racket case

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 10:20:15 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Telangana State Women’s Commission (TGSCW) has initiated an inquiry into an alleged illegal oocyte donation racket in Hyderabad, issuing notices to eight Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) centres and egg banks over suspected irregularities in their donor records and procurement practices.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Commission examined representatives of the eight institutions on Friday, November 13, after directing their managements to appear before it. However, TGSCW Chairperson Nerella Sharada expressed dissatisfaction after some centres sent staff members and other representatives instead of senior management, despite being specifically instructed to attend in person. The inquiry was subsequently adjourned after the institutions assured the Commission that their management would appear at the next hearing. During Friday’s proceedings, the Commission scrutinised reports, records and details of egg donors submitted by the ART centres and egg banks. “Several irregularities and suspicious elements have emerged from the records examined so far,” said Ms. Sharada. She also questioned claims made by the institutions that nearly 90% of their egg donors came from other States and donated their eggs voluntarily without receiving any remuneration or financial compensation. She said the claims raised several questions and warranted further investigation. Commissioner of Health and Family Welfare, Sangeetha Satyanarayana, also attended the inquiry, during which Ms. Sharada sought details about the progress of the department’s investigation into the alleged illegal egg procurement practices. The discussions also covered shortcomings in the existing Assisted Reproductive Technology Act and its implementation, particularly the challenges in regulating and monitoring ART centres and egg banks. Ms. Sharada said she would soon meet Health Minister C. Damodar Raja Narasimha and Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy to inform them of the findings and discuss corrective measures, including possible legislative amendments to strengthen regulation of the sector. Ms. Sharada further said that the Commission has also received information indicating the possible involvement of several other ART centres and egg banks in the alleged racket. It plans to issue notices to their management and summon them for questioning as part of the ongoing inquiry.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The Commission will not tolerate illegal practices that compromise women’s health, dignity and rights. We will continue the investigation in coordination with the concerned government departments to identify those responsible and ensure appropriate legal action,” she added.

articles.title: Keralam Electricity Minister’s statements on GNA deal disprove CM’s claims, says Pinarayi Vijayan
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Keralam Leader of the Opposition reiterates his demand for a judicial inquiry headed by a High Court judge into the controversy surrounding the cancellation of the power purchase deal; he asks CM Satheesan to apologise to people for ‘manufacturing a non-existent power crisis’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Reiterating his demand for a judicial inquiry headed by a High Court judge into the controversy surrounding the cancellation of the GNA power purchase deal, Keralam Leader of the Opposition Pinarayi Vijayan said on Friday that all the claims made so far by the Chief Minister regarding the power contract have been proved to be factually incorrect going by Electricity Minister Sunny Joseph’s statements. “With the Minister himself openly stating that the KSEB did not exert pressure to procure power and that the GNA contract is unfeasible, the Chief Minister’s credibility has been completely shattered. The Chief Minister, who had previously dismissed with contempt the Opposition’s allegation that GNA was merely an intermediary agency, rather than a power producer or a licensed trader, has now been corrected by his own Minister. The Electricity Minister’s remarks substantiate our position that the Chief Minister only withdrew from the contract after the Opposition caught the irregularities red-handed,” said Mr. Vijayan. He said that the public is well aware that the Chief Minister had repeatedly asserted that the decision in favour of GNA was his own. “It is now, therefore, beyond any doubt that these irregular moves and suspicious interventions were carried out either with the Chief Minister’s direct knowledge or under his leadership in a completely unilateral manner. When the controversy intensified, the Chief Minister attempted to evade responsibility by shifting the blame onto an official. A member of the Cabinet has publicly contradicted the very points that the CM had officially announced following a Cabinet meeting. This exposes deep divisions within the Cabinet and a complete lack of collective responsibility,” he said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Vijayan asked whether the CM was prepared to accept responsibility and apologise for causing hardship to the people by manufacturing a non-existent power crisis.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Keralam Electricity Minister’s statements on GNA deal disprove CM’s claims, says Pinarayi Vijayan

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 09:24:57 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Keralam Leader of the Opposition reiterates his demand for a judicial inquiry headed by a High Court judge into the controversy surrounding the cancellation of the power purchase deal; he asks CM Satheesan to apologise to people for ‘manufacturing a non-existent power crisis’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Reiterating his demand for a judicial inquiry headed by a High Court judge into the controversy surrounding the cancellation of the GNA power purchase deal, Keralam Leader of the Opposition Pinarayi Vijayan said on Friday that all the claims made so far by the Chief Minister regarding the power contract have been proved to be factually incorrect going by Electricity Minister Sunny Joseph’s statements. “With the Minister himself openly stating that the KSEB did not exert pressure to procure power and that the GNA contract is unfeasible, the Chief Minister’s credibility has been completely shattered. The Chief Minister, who had previously dismissed with contempt the Opposition’s allegation that GNA was merely an intermediary agency, rather than a power producer or a licensed trader, has now been corrected by his own Minister. The Electricity Minister’s remarks substantiate our position that the Chief Minister only withdrew from the contract after the Opposition caught the irregularities red-handed,” said Mr. Vijayan. He said that the public is well aware that the Chief Minister had repeatedly asserted that the decision in favour of GNA was his own. “It is now, therefore, beyond any doubt that these irregular moves and suspicious interventions were carried out either with the Chief Minister’s direct knowledge or under his leadership in a completely unilateral manner. When the controversy intensified, the Chief Minister attempted to evade responsibility by shifting the blame onto an official. A member of the Cabinet has publicly contradicted the very points that the CM had officially announced following a Cabinet meeting. This exposes deep divisions within the Cabinet and a complete lack of collective responsibility,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Vijayan asked whether the CM was prepared to accept responsibility and apologise for causing hardship to the people by manufacturing a non-existent power crisis.

articles.title: Vijay Merchant trophy cricket matches to be held in Shivamogga
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Under-16 Vijay Merchant Trophy cricket tournament will be held at the KSCA Stadium and the JNNCE Stadium in Shivamogga from November 14, to December 8.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Addressing a press conference in Shivamogga on Friday, MLC D.S. Arun, who is also a member of the KSCA managing committee, said the BCCI conducts the tournament to encourage young cricket talent. A total of 36 teams from different States will take part. The teams have been divided into six groups of six each, and the Group C matches will be played in Shivamogga. The Group C teams are Chandigarh, Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Hyderabad, Haryana and Odisha. Ayush Y.S., a young cricketer from Shivamogga, is part of the Karnataka team, which is playing in Group B.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The tournament will be inaugurated at 8.30 a.m. on Saturday. Shivamogga Superintendent of Police B. Nikhil, KSCA honorary joint secretary B.K. Ravi and R.P. Nagaraj, in-charge of the Shivamogga zone, will take part.

articles.title: Integrated digital platform for outdoor advertisements in CURE area
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) has invited bids for the development and implementation of an integrated digital platform to manage outdoor advertisements across the three municipal corporations in the Core Urban Region (CURE), with an estimated project value of up to ₹6 crore for five years.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The proposed platform, named CURE-RISE (Revenue, Inspection, Surveillance and Enforcement Platform for Advertisements), is intended to bring advertisement permissions, asset registration, fee collection, field inspections and enforcement under a common digital system covering GHMC, Cyberabad Municipal Corporation (CMC) and Malkajgiri Municipal Corporation (MMC). According to the request for proposal (RFP) issued on November 13, the system will maintain a centralised digital inventory of advertisement assets, including hoardings, unipoles, pole kiosks, bus shelters, traffic umbrellas and advertisements on central medians and foot-over-bridges. Each asset will be assigned a unique identification number and a machine-readable marker to facilitate field verification. The platform will enable online applications for advertisement permissions, automated calculation of fees and penalties, GIS-based location verification and tracking of payments. A mobile application will allow field officers to inspect advertisements, record geo-tagged photographs and monitor compliance with permissions. It will also provide an online booking facility for temporary and hyperlocal advertisements, in accordance with the guidelines issued by the government in October this year. Applicants will be able to select approved locations and available slots, upload advertisement designs and make payments through the digital interface. Approved advertisements will carry QR codes through which field staff can verify their permission status. The RFP envisages an indicative inventory of 500 to 1,000 hoardings and unipoles and around 20,000 other advertisement assets. It estimates about 2,000 chargeable transactions annually involving permanent advertisement categories and another 3,000 bookings for temporary and hyperlocal advertisements. The selected agency will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, operating and maintaining the platform. The contract will include the implementation period followed by 60 months of operation and maintenance.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: GHMC will act as the nodal agency for the three corporations, with the platform providing separate data boundaries for each corporation and a consolidated view for GHMC. The last date for submission of bids is November 23.

hinglishTracks.en: The Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) has invited bids for the development and implementation of an integrated digital platform to manage outdoor advertisements across the three municipal corporations in the Core Urban Region (CURE), with an estimated project value of up to ₹6 crore for five years.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ग्रेटर हैदराबाद नगर निगम (जीएचएमसी) ने कोर शहरी क्षेत्र (सीयूआरई) में तीन नगर निगमों में आउटडोर विज्ञापनों के प्रबंधन के लिए एक एकीकृत डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म के विकास और कार्यान्वयन के लिए बोलियां आमंत्रित की हैं, जिसका अनुमानित परियोजना मूल्य ₹6 करोड़ तक है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: The proposed platform, named CURE-RISE (Revenue, Inspection, Surveillance and Enforcement Platform for Advertisements), is intended to bring advertisement permissions, asset registration, fee collection, field inspections and enforcement under a common digital system covering GHMC, Cyberabad Municipal Corporation (CMC) and Malkajgiri Municipal Corporation (MMC).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — प्रस्तावित मंच, जिसका नाम CURE-RISE (विज्ञापनों के लिए राजस्व, निरीक्षण, निगरानी और प्रवर्तन मंच) है, का उद्देश्य जीएचएमसी, साइबराबाद नगर निगम (सीएमसी) और मल्काजगिरी नगर निगम (एमएमसी) को कवर करने वाली एक सामान्य डिजिटल प्रणाली के तहत विज्ञापन अनुमतियां, संपत्ति पंजीकरण, शुल्क संग्रह, क्षेत्र निरीक्षण और प्रवर्तन लाना है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enforcement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Implementation, Execution, Administration और Antonyms हैं: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver।

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 Integrated digital platform for outdoor advertisements in CURE area

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 09:23:51 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) has invited bids for the development and implementation of an integrated digital platform to manage outdoor advertisements across the three municipal corporations in the Core Urban Region (CURE), with an estimated project value of up to ₹6 crore for five years.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The proposed platform, named CURE-RISE (Revenue, Inspection, Surveillance and Enforcement Platform for Advertisements), is intended to bring advertisement permissions, asset registration, fee collection, field inspections and enforcement under a common digital system covering GHMC, Cyberabad Municipal Corporation (CMC) and Malkajgiri Municipal Corporation (MMC). According to the request for proposal (RFP) issued on November 13, the system will maintain a centralised digital inventory of advertisement assets, including hoardings, unipoles, pole kiosks, bus shelters, traffic umbrellas and advertisements on central medians and foot-over-bridges. Each asset will be assigned a unique identification number and a machine-readable marker to facilitate field verification. The platform will enable online applications for advertisement permissions, automated calculation of fees and penalties, GIS-based location verification and tracking of payments. A mobile application will allow field officers to inspect advertisements, record geo-tagged photographs and monitor compliance with permissions. It will also provide an online booking facility for temporary and hyperlocal advertisements, in accordance with the guidelines issued by the government in October this year. Applicants will be able to select approved locations and available slots, upload advertisement designs and make payments through the digital interface. Approved advertisements will carry QR codes through which field staff can verify their permission status. The RFP envisages an indicative inventory of 500 to 1,000 hoardings and unipoles and around 20,000 other advertisement assets. It estimates about 2,000 chargeable transactions annually involving permanent advertisement categories and another 3,000 bookings for temporary and hyperlocal advertisements. The selected agency will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, operating and maintaining the platform. The contract will include the implementation period followed by 60 months of operation and maintenance.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: GHMC will act as the nodal agency for the three corporations, with the platform providing separate data boundaries for each corporation and a consolidated view for GHMC. The last date for submission of bids is November 23.

articles.summary: 1. Core Context & Background: The Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) has invited bids for the development and implementation of an integrated digital platform to manage outdoor advertisements across the three municipal corporations in the Core Urban Region (CURE), with an estimated project value of up to ₹6 crore for five years.
articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) has invited bids for the development and implementation of an integrated digital platform to manage outdoor advertisements across the three municipal corporations in the Core Urban Region (CURE), with an estimated project value of up to ₹6 crore for five years.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The proposed platform, named CURE-RISE (Revenue, Inspection, Surveillance and Enforcement Platform for Advertisements), is intended to bring advertisement permissions, asset registration, fee collection, field inspections and enforcement under a common digital system covering GHMC, Cyberabad Municipal Corporation (CMC) and Malkajgiri Municipal Corporation (MMC). According to the request for proposal (RFP) issued on November 13, the system will maintain a centralised digital inventory of advertisement assets, including hoardings, unipoles, pole kiosks, bus shelters, traffic umbrellas and advertisements on central medians and foot-over-bridges. Each asset will be assigned a unique identification number and a machine-readable marker to facilitate field verification. The platform will enable online applications for advertisement permissions, automated calculation of fees and penalties, GIS-based location verification and tracking of payments. A mobile application will allow field officers to inspect advertisements, record geo-tagged photographs and monitor compliance with permissions. It will also provide an online booking facility for temporary and hyperlocal advertisements, in accordance with the guidelines issued by the government in October this year. Applicants will be able to select approved locations and available slots, upload advertisement designs and make payments through the digital interface. Approved advertisements will carry QR codes through which field staff can verify their permission status. The RFP envisages an indicative inventory of 500 to 1,000 hoardings and unipoles and around 20,000 other advertisement assets. It estimates about 2,000 chargeable transactions annually involving permanent advertisement categories and another 3,000 bookings for temporary and hyperlocal advertisements. The selected agency will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, operating and maintaining the platform. The contract will include the implementation period followed by 60 months of operation and maintenance.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: GHMC will act as the nodal agency for the three corporations, with the platform providing separate data boundaries for each corporation and a consolidated view for GHMC. The last date for submission of bids is November 23.

articles.title: No impact on INDIA alliance prospects in view of AIMIM-ASP pact, says Congress-SP
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Dalits and Muslims at the ground level remain cautious about the intent and viability of this sudden, unnatural alliance, say leaders

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Samajwadi Party (SP) and the Congress on Friday (November 13, 2026) said the alliance of All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM) president Asaduddin Owaisi and Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) will have no impact on voters from social groups facing injustice under the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) government in Uttar Pradesh. They added voters are aware that only INDIA alliance comprising of the SP-Congress is capable in defeating the BJP decisively. “Even before the announcement of AIMIM-ASP (KR) alliance, people were expecting that the BJP will try to divide the votes of Dalits, Muslims, backwards and progressive sections of society. But we believe people are fully aware that what is real end game of any such front. People across sections of the society are fully behind the INDIA alliance, and are waiting for assembly polls to defeat the anti-people BJP government,” said Shahnawaz Alam, National Secretary, Congress. The SP said Dalits and Muslims at the ground level remain cautious about the sudden, unnatural alliance. “The alliance of AIMIM and ASP (KR) has formed the Samajik Parivartan Morcha (Front for Social Change) to attract anti-incumbency votes from the BJP government, primarily among Scheduled Castes and Muslims. The Samajwadi Party welcomes any effort to expose communal forces that use false promises to attract voters, particularly Dalits. While the front might shift 2% to 3% of the vote away from the BJP—potentially benefiting the INDIA alliance—Dalits and Muslims at the ground level remain cautious about the intent and viability of this sudden, unnatural alliance. Although Dalits and Muslims are part of the Samajwadi Party’s socio-political platform (PDA), there is limited cohesion on the ground. Ultimately, this arrangement is unlikely to alter the election prospects of the INDIA alliance,” said Sudhir Panwar, a senior SP leader.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On November 12, All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM) president Asaduddin Owaisi and Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) chief Chandrashekhar Azad announced a political alliance for the 2027 state Assembly elections, a first declared non-National Democratic Alliance (NDA), non-INDIA bloc political front in Uttar Pradesh, with both parties considered marginal players eyeing to consolidate Scheduled Caste (SC) and minority voters in the politically crucial state. The alliance, Samajik Parivartan Morcha, for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections, named Mr. Azad as the candidate for Chief Minister.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 No impact on INDIA alliance prospects in view of AIMIM-ASP pact, says Congress-SP

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 09:23:45 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Dalits and Muslims at the ground level remain cautious about the intent and viability of this sudden, unnatural alliance, say leaders

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Samajwadi Party (SP) and the Congress on Friday (November 13, 2026) said the alliance of All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM) president Asaduddin Owaisi and Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) will have no impact on voters from social groups facing injustice under the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) government in Uttar Pradesh. They added voters are aware that only INDIA alliance comprising of the SP-Congress is capable in defeating the BJP decisively. “Even before the announcement of AIMIM-ASP (KR) alliance, people were expecting that the BJP will try to divide the votes of Dalits, Muslims, backwards and progressive sections of society. But we believe people are fully aware that what is real end game of any such front. People across sections of the society are fully behind the INDIA alliance, and are waiting for assembly polls to defeat the anti-people BJP government,” said Shahnawaz Alam, National Secretary, Congress. The SP said Dalits and Muslims at the ground level remain cautious about the sudden, unnatural alliance. “The alliance of AIMIM and ASP (KR) has formed the Samajik Parivartan Morcha (Front for Social Change) to attract anti-incumbency votes from the BJP government, primarily among Scheduled Castes and Muslims. The Samajwadi Party welcomes any effort to expose communal forces that use false promises to attract voters, particularly Dalits. While the front might shift 2% to 3% of the vote away from the BJP—potentially benefiting the INDIA alliance—Dalits and Muslims at the ground level remain cautious about the intent and viability of this sudden, unnatural alliance. Although Dalits and Muslims are part of the Samajwadi Party’s socio-political platform (PDA), there is limited cohesion on the ground. Ultimately, this arrangement is unlikely to alter the election prospects of the INDIA alliance,” said Sudhir Panwar, a senior SP leader.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On November 12, All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM) president Asaduddin Owaisi and Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) chief Chandrashekhar Azad announced a political alliance for the 2027 state Assembly elections, a first declared non-National Democratic Alliance (NDA), non-INDIA bloc political front in Uttar Pradesh, with both parties considered marginal players eyeing to consolidate Scheduled Caste (SC) and minority voters in the politically crucial state. The alliance, Samajik Parivartan Morcha, for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections, named Mr. Azad as the candidate for Chief Minister.

A. Dalits and Muslims at the ground level remain cautious about the intent and viability of this sudden, unnatural alliance, say leaders.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'No impact on INDIA alliance prospects in view of' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'No impact on INDIA alliance prospects in view' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'No impact on INDIA alliance prospects in view' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "No impact on INDIA alliance prospects in view of AIMIM-ASP pact, says Congress-SP"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Azad as the candidate for Chief Minister.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Azad as the candidate for Chief Minister." (Hinglish Arth: आज़ाद मुख्यमंत्री पद के उम्मीदवार.)

articles.title: KIIFB accounts should have been audited by CAG, says Kerala High Court
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In a public interest litigation, petitioner argues that the guarantees furnished by the State government to KIIFB against borrowings bypassed the limits set by the Centre and created 'off-Budget borrowings' that threatened the State’s fiscal stability and required mandatory CAG oversight

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The previous State government’s decision not to entrust the audit of the Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board (KIIFB) to the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) is more than concerning, observed the Kerala High Court. The Division Bench of Chief Justice Soumen Sen and Justice V.M. Syam Kumar stated that the previous government should have allowed the audit, especially with regard to the “enormous discrepancies” noticed in the preliminary report. The court held that transparency must be maintained in the accounts and functioning of the KIIFB since it was funded by the State, which furnished guarantees for its borrowings. The court also expressed displeasure at KIIFB’s adverse stance against the CAG audit. The court noted that the present government had resolved to restructure KIIFB and as per the recommendations of an expert committee, have the CAG audit the KIIFB accounts comprehensively. The court was considering a public interest litigation by P. Anilkumar of Kasaragod, seeking a CAG audit of KIIFB accounts. The petitioner argued that the guarantees furnished by the State government to KIIFB against borrowings bypassed the limits set by the Union government, effectively creating 'off-Budget borrowings' that threatened the State’s fiscal stability and required mandatory CAG oversight. An affidavit filed by the CAG in this regard showed that the outstanding balance of loans taken by KIIFB as of March 31, 2024, was ₹20,041.52 crore. The CAG stated that the State has undertaken the payment of principal and interest of these loans. Entrusting the audit of KIIFB accounts to the CAG would empower it to undertake a comprehensive audit, including certification of the accounts, ensuring that KIIFB’s financial statements are prepared in a true and fair manner, the affidavit stated.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The court disposed of the plea, noting that the petitioner’s grievances had been substantially addressed by the State’s take on conducting the audit.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (13 NOV)

📰 KIIFB accounts should have been audited by CAG, says Kerala High Court

📌 Published: 13 Nov 2026, 09:23:28 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: In a public interest litigation, petitioner argues that the guarantees furnished by the State government to KIIFB against borrowings bypassed the limits set by the Centre and created 'off-Budget borrowings' that threatened the State’s fiscal stability and required mandatory CAG oversight

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The previous State government’s decision not to entrust the audit of the Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board (KIIFB) to the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) is more than concerning, observed the Kerala High Court. The Division Bench of Chief Justice Soumen Sen and Justice V.M. Syam Kumar stated that the previous government should have allowed the audit, especially with regard to the “enormous discrepancies” noticed in the preliminary report. The court held that transparency must be maintained in the accounts and functioning of the KIIFB since it was funded by the State, which furnished guarantees for its borrowings. The court also expressed displeasure at KIIFB’s adverse stance against the CAG audit. The court noted that the present government had resolved to restructure KIIFB and as per the recommendations of an expert committee, have the CAG audit the KIIFB accounts comprehensively. The court was considering a public interest litigation by P. Anilkumar of Kasaragod, seeking a CAG audit of KIIFB accounts. The petitioner argued that the guarantees furnished by the State government to KIIFB against borrowings bypassed the limits set by the Union government, effectively creating 'off-Budget borrowings' that threatened the State’s fiscal stability and required mandatory CAG oversight. An affidavit filed by the CAG in this regard showed that the outstanding balance of loans taken by KIIFB as of March 31, 2024, was ₹20,041.52 crore. The CAG stated that the State has undertaken the payment of principal and interest of these loans. Entrusting the audit of KIIFB accounts to the CAG would empower it to undertake a comprehensive audit, including certification of the accounts, ensuring that KIIFB’s financial statements are prepared in a true and fair manner, the affidavit stated.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The court disposed of the plea, noting that the petitioner’s grievances had been substantially addressed by the State’s take on conducting the audit.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Fiscal (Adjective)
राजकोषीय — सरकार की कुल कमाई (टैक्स) और कुल सरकारी खर्च (बजट) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Budgetary, Financial, Revenue-related  |  ✖ Ant: Non-financial, Private
Comprehensive (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Comprehensive' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Certification (Noun)
प्रमाणीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Certification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "KIIFB accounts should have been audited by CAG, says Kerala High Court", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. In a public interest litigation, petitioner argues that the guarantees furnished by the State government to KIIFB against borrowings bypassed the...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'KIIFB accounts should have been audited by CAG, ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'KIIFB accounts should have been audited by CA' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'KIIFB accounts should have been audited by CA' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "In a public interest litigation, petitioner argues that the guarantees furnished by the State government to KIIFB against borrowings bypassed the..." (Hinglish Arth: एक जनहित याचिका में, याचिकाकर्ता का तर्क है कि राज्य सरकार द्वारा KIIFB को उधार के खिलाफ दी गई गारंटी ने केंद्र द्वारा निर्धारित सीमा को दरकिनार कर दिया और 'ऑफ-बजट उधार' पैदा किया जो खतरे में है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "KIIFB accounts should have been audited by CAG, says Kerala High Court"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The court disposed of the plea, noting that the petitioner’s grievances had been substantially addressed by the State’s take on conducting the audit.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The court disposed of the plea, noting that the petitioner’s grievances had been substantially addressed by the State’s take on conducting the audit." (Hinglish Arth: अदालत ने यह कहते हुए याचिका का निपटारा कर दिया कि ऑडिट आयोजित करने के राज्य के फैसले से याचिकाकर्ता की शिकायतों को काफी हद तक संबोधित किया गया था।)
